(walking to the other side) Anyway, they recently reopened that drive-in, dredging up all these unpleasant memories for me. So, naturally, I built this. (He gets trapped, and trips, causing the huge device to fall off the rocket-powered jet skiff.) Oh, really?! Really?!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus! Your timing﻿ is impeccable. And by impeccable I mean: Completely peccable! (Laughs) You are just in time to witness my latest scheme. Behold, my Drill-Inator! I will bore a tunnel to China, build a toll highway, and make millions! So, as they say in China: Arrivederci! (Perry uses his own drill machine to drill into Doof's Drill-inator and begins delivering punches)

Name: Doofenshmirtz:
Dialog: (he drives up to the entrance in his truck.) Yeesh, what a dump! (enters into the motel; mockingly) Well so much for Mr. Big Shot Super-villain. (walks over to the man at the front desk) Uh, yeah hi. I'm looking for someone named... (Checks piece of paper) Mr. "The Regurgitator." (The man rings a bell, and the front desk slides away to reveal a secret elevator. He steps inside the elevator curiously [**Instrumental: "****I'm Lindana and I Wanna Have Fun"**] and then it goes down to the lab. He exits into a hallway and sees a blue button labeled in red text warning.) Hmm. "DO NOT PUSH". Eh. (He stares at it for a few seconds before he pushes the button and is sucked into a vacuum tube, screaming all the way down. He lands hard on the ground in another room.) Oh, my Heinz henie! Look at this. All this technology, a giant vacuum tube, and they can't afford a throw pillow? (notices The Regurgitator nearby) Oh, hello.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I started throwing them in a drawer years ago, and I-I'm sure there's probably one wire you could pull like a... (Camera pans back to Perry) like a load-bearing wire that would just make the whole thing unravel. But how do you find it? (Camera switches back to him) I figured it was just easier to use it as a trap, so I did. See? Recycling.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? They have those. See? Nobody remembers them. You know why? Because of the hot dog vendors! Oh, how I hated them! They had it all! They had chrome-plated carts and endorsement deals, fancy blimps! And what did we have? Only superior workmanship, finer meats, and exotic spices.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Backstory! Backstory! Backstory! (Breaks his pointer.) The backstory is what drives an evil scientist. It is the "Why does he do what he does?" of the "What does he do?" (Accidentally throws a broken half of the pointing rod, causing a cat to yowl.) My point is, at its best, evil science is like undergoing deep Freudian analysis with a theremin constantly playing in the background.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Oh, this is rich! I-I see what's going on here. You, you really think that he's your pet, don't you? WRONG! He's using you! You're just his cover! He's a secret agent! Here-here, let me prove it. (he looks up) General Platyborg, come down here at once! He'll be here in just a second, and then...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And that's our new logo. Foreboding, yet comforting. So basically, if you want us to put the Earth back in its proper orbit, you have to meet our list of demands. Number 1: the minimum height to get on any rollercoaster will now be this high. (puts his hand three inches over Dr. Diminutive's head) (Diminutive puts Doof's hand on the very top of Diminutive's head) I-I mean that high. Number 2: pretzels.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've got to get off this island. What I need is a BO-AT, or boat as I'm now been told it's pronounced. (notices Perry, who's loading bags of coconuts onto a boat) Oh, look! A BO-AT- A boat! (at Perry) Ah, Perry the Platypus. I've decided that our efforts would be better spent if we work together to get off the island. Here, l-l-l-let me help with it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It makes me so happy to be surrounded by so much evil. Oh, look! It's your autobiography. It's always been a dream of mine to have you read it to me. (He pauses) Oh, wait, wait, wait, wait wait! (Pulls out a teddy bear) Okay, now I'm ready. (laughs) Come on! Don't be shy. Paragraph 4. "Upon an evil winter's heart." Go ahead.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Grr. You see? See, that's what I'm talking about. Ever since those condos next door started allowing pets, it's been driving me bonkers! All day and all night with the barking, barking, barking! (pulls the lever) Oh, that is why I created my latest masterpiece of evil... giant Dog-Biscuit-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Dr. Gevaarlijk already? (Opens door) Oh, oh, it's you, Perry the Platypus. I don't have much time today. You see, my old evil science professor is visiting, and we've always had a rather strained relationship. (Puts down a chair) I think it's best expressed through song. (Presses a button on a remote and the chair traps Perry) Tell me what you think, but no pressure.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, Perry the Platypus, with a push of this button, we will move out of the automobile age, and usher in THE AGE OF THE BO-AT! I'm driving on water! Look at me! I'm BO-ATing! Woo-hoo! Living the dream! Perry the Platypus? How did-- I always forget you are a semi-aquatic mammal. (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz in the face)

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, of course, of course. This time I know I've created something evil enough to warrant your full attention and anger. The Concoction Brew-Inator! A diabolical machine that produces a potion (Turns the Concoction Brew-Inator on) to turn a normal man, (The Concoction Brew-Inator turns off) like myself, (Grabs the cup) into a horrible monster! (Drinks the potion) Now... tremble before me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The "song of the summer". Who decides it's the song of the summer?! Vaporized! I know, I know, today's inator's a little basic, but I'm purposely starting off slow. You can't just dive back into the deep end of evil without warming up. You'll pull a muscle, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Well, first of all, I just want to state for the record that this island was not my first choice. I wanted Skull Island right over there, but it was already booked for Jacob Bernstein's Bar Mitzvah, and so all that was available was... Pink Unicorn Island.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (In a sing-song manner) I'm controlling Perry the Platypus... and... uh... slap yourself! (He pushes a button on the remote. Perry slaps himself) Haha! (He pushes the button several more times, forcing Perry to slap himself over and over again) Why are you hitting yourself? Why are you hitting yourself? Why are you hitting yourself? Why are you hitting yourself? Hahaha! Hahaha! I can make you do anything!!! (Gasps as he gets an idea) Oh, oh! Eat that gum off the sidewalk!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! The Dynamic-inator is finished! And I couldn't have done it without you, new partner. Now if you'd be kind enough to point it at my face and blast me, I'll be the most fascinating and charming person in the Tri-State area! And then maybe we'll go to a movie or something.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You don't stand a chance with that tile still stuck to your feet. (Perry jumps, hits Doofenshmirtz's knee and runs) Oh oh, my knee again, really?! (Doofenshmirtz chases after Perry. Perry comes behind a wall, forces one of his feet off the floor tile and uses it to trip Dr. Doofenshmirtz into a window) Wait wait wait wait! Time time time! I need a bathroom break. I'll be right back. Okay? Don't do anything until I get back, okay? Don't touch a thing. I'll be right uhh... Ooohh. (Doofenshmirtz realizes his bathroom was changed into a pot and a light bulb, Perry jumps out of the Gimmelshtump-inator)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus. Hello. Have you come to see my new hobby? Scale model reproductions of actual railroads, train depots... look, even scale model litter. Shameful. My father bought one for me when I was just a little evil, but you know, he wouldn't let me play with it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait, wait! Whoa, whoa, wait, what, n-no trap? No monologuing? I-It's like you're no longer interested in a fully nuanced relationship! Okay, okay, behold, my turnover-inator! And n-no, it doesn't make delicious turnovers, but it could. It could. There's an attachment.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We're back, my loyal "Shmirtzies", all... ten of you. And, as I was saying, O.W.C.A. would be nothing without me. My evil helps them exist. (A bell dings.) Wai... Wait. What's this? BeefyMustache55 is calling me a hack? All right, you're going live! Oh, I shoulda known it was you, Francis.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Unfortunately, my Translator-inator only worked in one direction. So I was not able to tell the whales what I thought of them. Until today. Watch this. (mimics whale cry) See, I taught myself whale song. I just told him he's fat, and he has barnacle breath. (Whale squeals) Come on, come on, who's diabolical? (Perry gives an annoyed face)

Name: Doofenshmirtz Recording
Dialog: Good morning, Perry the Platypus. I had to step out for a minute, but please, help yourself to some gnosh. Eggs, vitamins, ice, or leeks. I have no idea what you platypuses eat, but whatever you do, don't destroy my new evil -inator. (Perry takes a nearby sledge hammer and go to destroy the -inator, however, Perry's feet get trapped in braces) A-ha! You're trapped! A-hahahaha Sucker!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Prepare to be blitzed by my inexplicable, new found martial arts mastery! (He shows off his new found talent, but accidentally kicks off his shoe) I hate to ask Perry the Platypus, but have you seen my other-- (Perry is seen rubbing his head, with Doof's shoe lying beside him) Oh, there it is. Oh yeah, that-that's what I was planning to do. Perry the Platypus, looks like this is the end for you. (He lines up his -inator to hit the platypus. However Perry throws Doof's shoe at him, causing the -inator to fire at his building, and Doofenshmirtz to flip over the edge of the building, having him hang their by only his knees) Just not nice! (The top of D.E.I. lifts into the sky)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Anyway, when I do my man making dive, you can bet that nobody in the Tri-State Area will be looking. Sure, it'll be tough for people who happen to be driving, plus, brain surgeons might have a problem too. But it's really a small price to pay for me becoming a man, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz (cont'd.)
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! How did you escape my net? It was the mouse, wasn't it? Get out of the way, Perry the Platypus! Don't make me drop this giant magnet on you! Well, then, as a lazy tailor would say, "Suit yourself." (Flips the switch making the magnet fall on Perry, but Santa Claus picks up the magnet) But that doesn't make sense! It's the middle of July!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm worried about her, Perry the Platypus. Hey! You were going to blow down my door! (Perry sets the bazooka down, but accidentally fires it leaving a big hole in a Warholian picture of Doofenshmirtz.) Oh, great! See, this is why I can't have anything nice! Anyway, c'mon, let me show you what I've been workin' on. Y'see, it all started when I was just a small boy back in Gimmelshtump.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, what's up? Oh, are you here to...? Oh, no, no, no, no. I'm running a little behind. I'm still in the middle of basic plotting and scheming. Plus, I-I...can't give you my evil scheme monologue because I write that last. Sorry! That's just how I roll.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very good, Perry the Butler. The trash chute is right down the hall. (Notices Agent P's fedora lying on the ground) Hey wait, you forgot... (Gasps, picks up fedora) Oh, look at this thing, huh? Such memories! All the adventures, the excitement, the pummeling, the thwarting... Oh. You know, I'm feeling rather sentimental about it. (Tosses Perry's fedora off the balcony) Oh, well!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen, muffled) Welcome, Perry the Platy— Off, off! (A pile of sheep uncover Doof dressed as a shepherd.) I bet you're wondering why I'm depressed as a traditional Drusselstinian shepherd, right? Well, that's because sheep are a part of my latest dastardly plan! Also, I've started taking up knitting. I made this adorable sweater for you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Huge Hands Hans is getting away! Not this time, freak fingers! (Doofenshmirtz chases after them) Just you wait, Huge Hands Hans! You can run, but you can't hide! You know, he can run, but he can't– (Perry's ice tray smacks Doofenshmirtz across the face) Ow! Wait a second. How did you--? (Perry has the remote between his flipper feet) Oh, I see. That's it— (Perry, with the remote control launches back at Doofenshmirtz, making his tongue stuck to the ice) That's not fair! (Doofenshmirtz lets go and the ice shatters, knocking him out and letting Perry free) Oh, that's it, it's on now! (As Perry and Doofenshmirtz fight, the arms of the robot swing, matching Doofenshmirtz's movements)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Snatches Carl's wrist communicator and placing it on the table) We'll have none of that, Mr. Squirrel Man. Besides, you're too late. Ever since Perry the Platypus quit your agency to become my butler, I have been freed up to create my ultimate inator, the Vaporizer-inator! With my mind now clear, I stumbled onto a scientific fact.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But I hate homework! I'd rather just play with this snowglobe. (Another anomaly appears and sucks the snowglobe out of his hand.) Oooh! Oh, man, this is serious! I thought for sure my machine would've turned itself off when it disappeared, but it's still creating rifts in the space-time continuum! (pushes intercom) Melanie, bring me another snowglobe.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! Hey, no. Shoo! Shoo! Get out of here. Go-Go find another symbiotic relationship! Anyway, now that we've... Hey, hey! What do you... This actually feels great. Oh, I see why you like it. A-Anyway, and I'm going to power up the inator now. (pushes a button on the inator) Here we go. Powering up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Seriously, Perry the Platypus, was it really necessary to destroy everything? (Perry jumps off the destroyed inator and chatters. Doofenshmirtz backs away leading Perry onto a giant black "X" in the middle of the room) N-nn-n-n-now, now, that's a good trollish gigantic platypus. (Doofenshmirtz claps twice activating a giant cage that drops on Perry) Ha! Let that be a lesson to you: Never stand on a big cartoony "X"! And now, I have a little appointment to keep with the mayor. (Doof exits laughing. Perry chatters)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, Perry the Platypus, say goodbye to blinking detour signs! Forever! (Laughs maniacally; The Shrink sphere blasts and bye bye go the detour sign) Yes! I'm an evil genius! Ha ha ha ha! Now I have to wait 4 minutes for it to recharge, which isn't so bad. I think I'll go with pelicans next. What do you think Perry the Platypus? Pelicans next?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, I'm taking that puppy home with me, 'cause I'll have a greater Inator this year. Not a grater, it's...I-I'm not gonna bring a block of cheese and make nachos for you guys. It's-it's greater in the sense that it's better than it was last year. (pause, walks away) That's what I mean.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (talking to a Perry bobblehead) You see bobblehead Perry the Platypus, I have created a powerful -inator that will deface anything it contacts! Including my brother Roger's statue that's being unveiled at today's festival. It's going to humiliate him! Isn't it genius, bobblehead Perry the Platypus? (flicks the bobblehead)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And then I thought, why be a brigadier general when I could be a major general? I mean, why not? Right? I'm a modern guy. And then I thought, maybe I'm still shooting too low. Why be a major general when I could be a lieutenant general? And then I thought, why be a--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it looks like we got all of the zinc from this area. It's time to move on to the next quadrant! "Quadrant." "Quad-rant." Quad—It's—It's—It's a weird word when you think about it. "Quadrant." "Quad-rant." (Perry resumes filing the bars.) Quad—It's—See-See? Now it doesn't even sound like a word.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, looks like I'm stuck down here. Guess I'll have time to figure out what "big laundry" mea—Oh. (sees a huge pile of dirty clothes) Oh, that's right. It's Tuesday. (gasps) I know! (runs to the bathroom) I can get out the same way Perry the Platypus did! (Toilet is heard flushing and water comes out from under the door.) Oh! Oh! Oh, that didn't work at all! Oh, now I really gotta do the laundry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, well, well, look who's here. Perry the Platypus. All shackled up and no place to go! Uh, I think we made too much potato salad, Norm. I-I guess we'll have to give everyone a 2-ton take-home container. And I still think you should have added more green onions.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sure, let me demonstrate. (Fires laser, shooting at the evil investor) See? It doesn't affect people at all! (the evil investor's head swells up) Except maybe a little swelling, but don't worry, it will go down. You know, probably. Now, watch what it does to this miniature monster truck! (Fires laser; Evil Investors talking at once) I don't know where it sends them, maybe another dimension.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Or technically, I guess, turn it on its side. Y'know, it just doesn't sound as good. You say, "I'm gonna turn this city upside-down", people get that. But ya say something about, "I'm gonna rotate this city 90º"? That, that... that doesn't mean anything to anybody.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I remembered who you were, but I pretended not to cuz last time we worked together, you showed me up a little and... B-But right now, you are the only one who could make a good droogen strudel. So, will you work with me? For the good of the Tri-State Area? Please?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (with a bandage around his head) Ah, Perry the Platypus. So glad you could "gum" by! I mean, I knew gumbody would visit, but it's gum. It's gum. You're in a gum trap. No, really. Don't. Don't break out so fast. I-I-I-I put way too much effort into that trap. Took me six days to chew all that gum.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it doesn't matter because I'm in control. Okay, turn, and... let's go outside and see what this baby can really do! And let's make this snappy, I gotta pick up my daughter by 5:00. You remember Vanessa, right? You know, you blew me up at her birthday party.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Surprise, Perry the Platypus! (Giggles madly) Okay, (Presses elevator button) enjoy your trip! (Giggles again) Oh, oh, the look on his face. That was priceless, (Giggles and sighs) Oh, here he comes back again. Alright, try not to laugh, okay serious. Ahaha, did you enjoy the other floor—Wait, Perry? (Second elevator door opens revealing Perry) Perry the Platypus? (Goes inside the elevator) Wh-Where did he go?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, see? Fun with sound. Behold, Perry the Platypus, (Presses the remote button) my Invis-inator! (The Invis-inator fires) And why would I need an Invisibility ray, you ask? Well, you know when those cute, little Fireside Girls come by to sell their-- Their cupcakes, or their-- Or their raffle tickets or whatever?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Narrating with the clip) The stress of running a family weighed heavily on him. We were so poor that one day our beloved lawn gnome was repossessed. Who would protect our zatzenfruit garden from witches' spells and wood trolls? From a tender age, my father decided that it would be me...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, Perry the Platypus, I be-I bet you're wondering why I'm cowering outside my lab. Well, day started like any other day. You know, I- "how am I going to take over the Tri-State Area?" But- And I suddenly remembered a movie that I'd seen long ago at a drive-in.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, all of my inators work! It's just that, you know, I...I don't use them properly. I have poor planning skills. (takes out blueprints) But it was me. I have the blueprints right here. (The villains all look in amazement.) You see, yeah, just ignore the coffee stains or whatever that is. (sniffs) Uh, I think that's nacho cheese.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So long, Perry the Platypus! Next time you see me, I will be the indisputable ruler of the Tri-State Area! (flies off on his inator) And when I say "indisputable", I mean totally disputable! Wait, no, no that doesn't work, I mean...uh-uh-putable! I-I mean puta—no. Eh, the moment's gone.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah! Perry the Platypus. You got yourself in quite a pickle there! See? 'Cause it's-it's a pickle. And you're inside it. Anyway, backstory. (flashbacking) It all started the other day when I was visiting Tony's Deli. I had gotten a bowl of chicken soup, but it had a fly in it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, it's weird that I was not invited to this. I'm a doctor and a scientist. An evil scientist. Not an evil doctor. That would be weird. And now, as they say in Uruguay, point me to the buffet! And... who's kidding how? The buffet's the only reason I came.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sweary the Swan, did you know that the World's Fair is in town? They have all of this amazing new technology. Here, look. It's all represented here, on this commemorative coin that I-- (Sweary the Swan bites Von Doofenshmirtz's thumb) Ow! Now look what you did! You made me drop it. Pnorman, go find that coin.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: 8...9...10! Ready or not, here I come! (Takes hands away; sees Norm hiding behind a pole, which is revealing) Huh? Oh! No, no, no! It's called hide-and-seek! You hide, and I seek. I cannot seek if you don't hide. So you go hide yourself. Ignoramus. Go, go, go. Let's - Let's try this again. (Recovers eyes) One, two, three...ten! (looks over at the crates) Now, where is he?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What does that matter? You can't open your mouth. Here, grab Perry the Platypus. Isn't this place fabulous? I found it through an international lair exchange website. It's even got its own rocket. Y'know, I think I might've gotten the better end of this deal.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Or even better than that, I can chip Perry the Platypus! Haha! This is amazing! This is, uh, like a platypus-find-inator that I didn't even have to think of or build! It's, it's like getting a freebie! Man, I need to hit Slushy Dawg more often. Sorry, thighs.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, now I just have to set the spritzer, and the timer, and whoomp!, there he is! My brother, the warthog, mayor no more! (maniacal laughter)  Yeah. (sighs) Y'know, it's not the same without Perry the Platypus. I can't believe he ditched me. One lousy award and he goes all diva! Pfft!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Self-destruction? S-Self-destruct... Wait, wait! That's it! I remember now! They took out my self-destruct button! (he pulls it out) I don't know why I put it back in, but here, I'll just rewire this, like so, and there! (he clips in a wire and turns it on, it forms a portal) It's working! It's working! It is functioning properly!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I figured as long as I invented the thing, I might as well use it to whip up a little evil. (Perry chomps on leg warmer while Doofenshmirtz is talking) I set it up right over there next to the creden– Ow! (Crashes through magazine cover; Ray charges up) Hey, you know, it cost me a lot to have that printed up! Oh! (The laser fires and now Doof and Perry are dancing together; **Instrumental: "Aloha 'Oe" [****Leroy & Stitch arrangement]**; to the camera) To add insult to injury, the platypus is leading.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, what an unexpected sur- (Perry moves to punch Doofenshmirtz) Oh, whoa, wait, wait, wait! You're trapped! By societal convention. Look, we're in a fine dining environment, everyone knows not to thrown a scene in a fancy restaurant. That's right. You're trapped. Sit down.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voice over) Hey, guess what, Tri-State Area? I, Heinz Doofenshmirtz, have seized control and am now your supreme leader. Seriously, life as you know it is over. (Shows him speaking to a crowd) Thank you and remember: Doof you, doof me, doof us! (In a small box on screen, he appears saying) I'm Heinz Doofenshmirtz and I approve this evil message.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And here's the best part, Perry the Platypus: I get a cash refund deposited directly into my pockets. No banking necessary. (A cash register is heard dinging as several coins appear in Doof's pockets.) The only flaw is that the refund comes in pennies. Y'know, sometimes, I don't really think through the functionality of these things.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, Perry the Platypus, as I make myself abominable. (Doof presses the button on the -inator's remote. The -inator's beam bounces off the igloo and hits the marshmallow trapping Perry, causing it to burst and splatter all over Doofenshmirtz.) Ooh, it's all marshmallow-y and hairy. Not completely unlike summer camp. Apparently, you gotta aim this thing a little better... (the -inator shoots a beam directly at Doof's rear end) Whoa! Owww! Hmmm, something's not right in the hinterland. (his bottom suddenly becomes large and hairy, causing him to fall on the front of the sled) Yikes! Oof! (the igloo slides off the mountain top and hits a rock, causing it to break; Perry flies into the air and grabs the scarf trailing from the -inator)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, wai-wai-wait, these droogens look awfully chocolatey. Does that mean... (Doof tastes a piece of Shriveled Man's legs.) Mmmm! (He tastes some more.) Oh, this Shriveled Man is chocolate! The droogens are gone! I'm... My plan worked! Whoa! What is this weird feeling? Is this getting a win? 'Cause I'm gonna get used to this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Those are my keys, aren't they? (On the phone) No, I-I don't have my card. Yes, the keys are still in there and-and it's running. (Engine shudders to a stop.) Okay, now it's not running; now I need gas... Forty-five minutes huh?... (Sighs) Well I'm not going anywhere. (Puts phone away) Eh, well at least I can get my -inator. (Aims the -inator.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's my omni-directional amplifinator. It will blast my scorching guitar licks in all directions, ripping through the vacuum of space to summon the alien armada that will help me conquer the TRI-STATE AREAAAAAAAA!!! I don't know why I always say that loud.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Talking loudly) Ah! Sweary the Swan! How completely unforeseen is your--Uh, hang on a second! (turns off a large machine behind him) Ah, that's better. Sweary the Swan, how completely unforeseen is your presence here! And by that, I mean, completely foreseen! (Sweary attempts to bite von Doofenshmirtz) Hey! No bites. I've got a little something for you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh what a mess. Curse you, Sal Tuscany! (smashes the CD) Well, I should probably call Uncle Justin and thank him for the gift anyway. (on the phone) Hello, operator? I'd like to place a call to... “Barneo?" I thought it said Borneo. Wait, where's Barneo? The North Pole??? Wait a second!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh, I thought it would be more than that. I guess I could get a candy bar or something. Anyway, I've been studying all my previous schemes and I figured out why they always seem to fail. Let's see if you can figure out what they all have in common. Look!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, what a mess. But don't worry, Perry the Platypus. OWCA's got plenty of money now. They'll... (snaps fingers) They'll fix this place up before your host family even gets back and they'll, they'll replace all this junk with...y'know, pretty much identical junk. (Harry gives him a look.) What?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But today, I will finally get my revenge! You see, my brother, the honorable mayor Roger Doofenshmirtz, will be unveiling a new piece of art for the lobby of City Hall. Hence the Stain-inator, hence revenge, hence, uh... (Perry slowly wheels himself and his trap to the edge of the jet) no more hencing. That's about it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know what I'm noticing a lot of? I blow up more than the average guy. (Perry notices a ceiling fan near his trap while Vanna is on the phone and starts swinging toward it) Do they have blowing-up insurance? I should get some of that. And if they don't have it, I think they should make it, 'cause I would buy some. Oh, baby, what an emotional workout!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, werewolves alone must account for like, 20% of that! How can I compete? Then I realized; if I could rotate the moon, then the dark side would always be facing us, bringing all other evil to a standstill, and making me the only evil game in town!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, a few more tweaks and I'm ready to double down on some negatives! (Perry escapes from his trap and hits Doofenshmirtz on the head with the chair.) Wow I— (Perry jumps on Doofenshmirtz) Now that double negative did not make a positive! Ow! Oh, you are gonna get it now! (They run into each other but miss. Doofenshmirtz lands on the controls.) Oh no n-n-no! Now it's stuck in random fire mode! Don't know why I put that mode on there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He laughs) Hey, nice move, Perry the Platypus, I got to "hand" it to you. Here, let me give you a "hand." Hey, hey. I'm gonna crush you with my big mechanical "hand." Ha! Well, I– I guess that one was just literal, but I've got you now. (Candace bursts through Doofenshmirtz's lair, cutting off the giant hand)  Wow. Nostradamus was right! (Perry uses the giant hand to smack Doofenshmirtz into the trap he was previously in)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very clever, Perry the Platypus. I was trying to ignore you, but you forced my hand. (Pushes a button and traps Perry) And now...I shall relax with a nice, tasty deli platter. Oh-ho-ho, where are my manners? (Gives Perry his share) Here you go, Perry the Platypus. Care for some pepper? Just say when. (Continues to pour pepper) Anytime.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The fox hops over the log...the rabbit crawls under the log... (ties wires in a bow, closes compartment) okay, got it! Now, to send -- (falls off) Ahem. And now, to send my daughter to the movies! (horror music plays) Nah, see, it's just doesn't work in this instance. You know what, you guys just take the rest of the day off.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, sure. Big Black Boots Boris the Bully. (clip starts) He was always kicking sand in my face. When I was in the sandbox: sand. My first date: sand! Balancing my checkbook: sand! The beach-- Oddly enough nothing. But I couldn't relax, because I kept waiting for it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) I was able to complete wrangling a pig, and the Humiliating Stumblegimp Dance of Contrition. But then I couldn't do the generational kickball thing, cuz, y'know, my parents don't show up for things. Anyway, honey, I must enthusiastically warn you of...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, so the, uh, Key to the City ceremony's not starting for a while so, uh...we got some...Oh, you know, I-I just realized that I'm...I'm wearing a white lab coat and I'm leaning back against a black tire. That's... (sighs) I think I might have to go change.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Observe! With this, I can implant the target image on their tiny, little brains in a flash! (Zaps the machine at the pigeon, making it lose its feathers) It-- It works better from a distance. Anyway, today at Town Hall, they will award the key to the city to My-Goody-Two-Shoes-Brother Roger. Oh, how I loathe him.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're from Greenland? Do you know the punishment for misrepresenting your country of origin to the L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. Organization? Plus your scheme is unnecessarily complicated and doesn't even seem like it would work! A-And that's coming from me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, what are you. (falls over) Ugh! Now watch the ailerons! (He falls into bucket again. He climbs out of the bucket. The bucket falls over and crashes onto the wind amplifier. It breaks, causing Doofenshmirtz to fly into the air carried by a huge amount of water. The water shoots into the clouds, and Doofenshmirtz falls back down to earth. Perry tears apart his trap, jumps off, and catches Doofenshmirtz by his left leg. The parachute goes off. As Perry and Doofenshmirtz fall, the storm clears, but Doofenshmirtz falls off again, and Perry is left with only his left shoe. He lands into a tree, and the tree flings him onto the ground, causing him to roll to Grulinda's party. He stops at a woman's feet, and thinks she is Grulinda.) Oh, you! I almost dumped a giant bucket of water on you and your party. But then there was this whole mishap with the platyp- but I will get you next time! Revenge is a dish best served soggy, Grulinda!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, look at him, he's— He's positively shaking with anticipation at the thought of helping me take over the Tri-State Area. He's— (The robot suddenly begins to transform and grow.) Hoo-hoo-hoo-hoo! I-I didn't even know he could do that, whatever it is. Wow! I'm a better evil scientist than I thought!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And then there's that whole economic downturn and I'm left holding a 300K house in a 10K neighborhood. My accountant just wants me to walk away from it, I'm like, I can't do that. Just because I'm evil doesn't mean I don't care about my credit rating

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay, I missed you several times, and I probably won't hit you anytime soon. I get that. But I must have hit lots of other things, and with a push of this button, those lots of other things will come to my side. And together we will defeat you! (He hits the button)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Actually, I-I-I don't really wanna be an evil dictator anymore. I've got everything I need right here. (He gives Choo-Choo to Charlene-2.) My Choo-Choo, my family, this lovely penthouse, my freedom and... (Cut to outside as Choo-Choo is thrown out the window.) Choo-Choo!!! Backstory reforming... Evil returning... Aw, yeah! I'm back, baby!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We could sail around the world in this thing! We could, we could visit exotic ports, fight pirates! We'd be like a couple of seafaring Huck Finns and the ocean would be our ho–! (The yacht sinks, and Doof's black hair dye creates a smudge in the water. He swims back up.) Or maybe we could wrestle alligators! No, wait, even better: Sports car! (He swims to shore, with Perry following.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Man, you really kick this party up to an 11, man! (Perry knocks Doofenshmirtz to the ground.) Perry the Platypus, what's gotten into you? (Perry shows him the words on his chest.) "Thait I live"? What's that, some new band? (Perry grabs a mirror and Doofenshmirtz gasps.) Oh, "I fight evil"! V-Very clever. You wrote a note to yourself in the future. (Perry jumps at Doofenshmirtz again and begins to drag him across the floor.) I would not have predicted that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, just watch what happens when I zap those people over there. (Perry jumps in his high chair causing Doofenshmirtz to fire off his inator. The ray bounces off a sneeze guard, off a lamp and hits Doofenshmirtz.) Huh? W-What happened? How could I miss? Oh, I'm so hungry all of a sudden! (He munches his way through the Dagwood sandwich on his plate finishing it whole.) Oh, that was great! I...I can cut out the middleman and do all the eating myself! (gets up) I'm going back for seconds. (He digs into the entire buffet. The man who was about to get his helping opens up a bag of chips. Cut to Doofenshmirtz eating other people's plates.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: I don't know, one, two? It's-It's-y'know it's hard to tell with the one eye. Anyway, I don't know why you're being so uncooperative. All I'm asking you to do is make my machine work so I can invade and conquer your world and enslave your loved ones.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Is it just me or is this a serious déjà vu moment? I-I feel like I've totally been here before. Like you were there, the tin foil was coming, and I- "Quickly, we must separate the magnet". E-e-eh. Huh. Oh, well, weird. Where was I? Oh yeah. Aaaahhh! (Resumes trying to move the Magnifinator)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Screams)  I think I just tanned my eyeballs. Ugh. Now, with the push of a button, I will make history! (Laughs maniacally) By the way, do you like my mural? I did it myself, it's a silhouette of me going... (Laughs maniacally; Pushes button) All right, let's see, now. (Ding) Oh, needs a little more toner. Oh, copy jam.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look, that's not even me! It's a traffic cone with a dent in it! I mean, I don't think that's me. (puts down the yearbook and carries his trapped nemesis) On the other hand, Roger has the most recognizable face in all of Danville. He's got that je ne sais quois. And I would know. I minored in sais quois.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, these waffles aren't enough. I...I wish I could just disintegrate them all. (gasp) Oh, right! The Disintegrator-inator! Duh! (switches it on, nothing happens) I don't know what I was—Hey! (flips the switch up and down) Hey, what's wrong? Hmmm. (picks up the unplugged plug) Oh, here's the problem. (He walks up to an extension cord outlet, but the plug is too short.) Okay, I just need an extension cord this long. (Runs off.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I see you've taken notice of all the infomercial products. I seem to have developed an addiction to them. I-It started with the Fruit Dehydrator. Here I've been eating hydrated fruit like a sucker my whole life! (doorbell rings) Excuse me, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, that's much better. I was parched, how about you? We should do this more often, this was nice. Now if you'll excuse me, I'm gonna jet-pack over to my neighbor's balcony and see what's going on with those plants. (jet-pack spurts fire, burning clothes) Right after I change my pants.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, my Juice-inator, my giant menacing machine that I built that will turn City Hall into juice, completely discrediting and embarrassing my brother the Mayor at his 5pm media event. Step One, in my evil scheme to take over The TRI-STATE AREA!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...and it will actually turn City Hall onto its side. Roger will slide out, and I'l run in and take his place. Unless he's lying down, at which point he will suddenly be standing up, and then he will become confused and run away. It's a win-win.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oops. I really meant to hit the self-destruct button. I-I-I'll just get this for you. (Kaboom!) So, uh, you need your parking validated or, uh... Oh, oh, you found a spot on the street! Huh! Lucky you! Curse you, Perry the Platypus and all that. You know.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, Perry the Platypus, this isn't working. I need to become something stronger than a platypus. Let's see, what's-- what's stronger than a platypus? (Gasps) Two platypuses, that's it! I've got just the thing right over here. (Runs to the roof to pull out a sheet covering the -inator to reveal it) Behold! My Double-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But this is crazy talk! I-I'm an evil scientist, not a mad scientist! Th-There's a difference! Subtle, I grant you, but-but, still, y'know, I don't really like the new direction this organization is taking and I think we need a little fresh air. (he walks out)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see, there were only 2 things that made my miserable childhood bearable: my giant pet cockroach, Hoarfrost and garlic ice cream. I love these two things so much I wondered if combining them would exponentially increase my enjoyment of them.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, and-and you need to tie up your food or you could attract bears, (puts all the food in a bag and throws it on a rope onto a tree branch, making the picnic table hang) which would make it extremely difficult to, hang loose and, be groovy. I-I've got lots of other righteous camping tips, but first, I need to get some life vests out of my van.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't look at me like that, Perry the Platypus. I know what you're thinking. I-I'm not some lowly intern. I'm an evil scientist! I'm Heinz Doofenshmirtz, and he should be bowing down to me! (at the Regurgitator) Hey you, Mr. Regurgitator! Let's get things straight!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While fighting Perry) Oh yeah, pretty much. I create -inators, and he breaks in and thwarts my scheme, and it's, it's kind of our thing. (Perry knocks Doofenshmirtz to the ground) Ooh! The Grievance! I saw this at the theaters. I still have nightmares about the greasy little girl who comes out of the base--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Cackles) Welcome, Perry the Platypus. I knew you'd fall for the old kickstand trap. (Scratches an ear) Of course, I didn't know exactly where you'd park, so I've (Camera pans back showing that he had installed more than one button) really got to watch my step around here. But as you see, you are trapped... in a pile of old computer cables.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sniffs) D-Do-Do you smell something burning? What are you doing?! Give me that! Got it! What is this, a tiny magnifying glass? Oh, you think you're so fancy with your high-tech spy equipment. (He crushes the contact lens) What are you going to do now? Huh, Perry the Platypus? Huh? (laughs) (Perry takes out the other contact lens)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He sighs) You're right. I'm sorry I got in your way. y'know, I know you can handle yourself, Vanessa. (He walks away sadly with Perry) C'mon Perry the Platypus. Maybe there's still time for a scheme today. You know? I-I won't even trap you. You can just start beating me up right away.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? Why did I put that button on the... Oh, I guess aesthetically, it ma... (Perry punches Doofenshmirtz, who flies across the room) Oof! You may have escaped my TV trap, Perry the Platypus, but I'm still going to change your channel! Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! (Doofenshmirtz pulls a laser remote out of his lab coat and fires it at Perry. He misses and shoots several holes in the wall; Perry uses a nearby flatscreen TV as cover. Perry grabs another remote from the top of the TV and fires at Doofenshmirtz) Oh, that one shoots too? Ooh! Who knew? (Doofenshmirtz uses a nearby TV as cover as the two fight)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, this much I could've predicted, but I'm having a hard time explaining the giant metal shark. (sighs as the shark is pulled towards them by the taffy) Well, at least we'll go together, Perry the Platypus. (Perry ejects from his wetsuit through the scuba helmet and swims away) Oh sure, I reach out to you and then you use the emergency face plate ejector thing. (the shark crashes into Doofenshmirtz, the taffy, and the -inator, creating a cloud of bubbles)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, wait... Oh, forget it! (He walks into his lab.) All right, back to work. I just can't think of a way to turn a cloud into a storm. Hmmm, maybe I can go online and research it or— Oh, what am I thinking? There's an easier way to do this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (crawling; pants) I said I wanted a sea otter for Christmas, they said I have to pick my present from the bottom shelf of the kitchen caustics aisle at the supermarket so I picked the oven cleaner. I loved that oven cleaner. OVEN CLEANER!! (notices a bus station) Hey, a bus station!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Soon, Perry the Platypus, the sun will be at full strength, and my plan will come to fruition. Unless, of course, it's overcast... (An alarm begins beeping) Eh, but what are you going to do? Proximity alert? Why are there so many people in space? What's up with that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! You have grape juice on your shirt. I can't have my manservant looking like a street urchin. You-You should go clean up before it sets. (Perry gives Carl the fedora back and walks away.) Ugh, it's so hard to get good help these days, even when you ride 'em like a bicycle.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. Look, Balloony's back. You remember Balloony, right? Why is laughing the only thing evil scientists do, you know, "maniacally"? I thought, hey, I should stand out and something else maniacally. I'm expanding my brand.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Ow! Oh! Ow! (Doofenshmirtz comes out of the laundry basket dressed as a bride to Perry's groom. Perry lets him have it, but then jumps away.) That's right, run away, Perry the Pla—aaaaaahhh!! (Doofenshmirtz falls into the giant washing machine. A bunch of monkeys on one side drop clothes into the machine.) Nice try, Perry the Plat— (Another group of monkeys drop in detergent.) Wai-wai-wait, what are you doing? Don't throw the bright colors in with the—Hey that's too much soap! (bulbs as the monkeys push the start button) Curse you, Perry the Pla—I told you no starch!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pants) I-I don't have a ticket but I... I've got to get to Danville to be in a play! I-I've just gotta, I don't have any money, I'm tired and dirty, it's all my fault, I've.. It's always been my fault! I'm a failure, I'm a failure! (begins to cry off-screen) (while crying off-screen) I'm a failure.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it? You-You just want to borrow Norm, my giant robot man? Fine. Knock yourself out. I'm going back to bed. Just so you know, he's a little low on oil. Oh, and-and, Perry the Platypus—(Puts grind guard back in) I don't want to see one scratch on that mathine.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Doreen? Come out, come out wherever you are. I should have...should have brought some bread crumbs, or something to leave behind me, so I could find my way—Oh you know what? Better yet, I should've brought a sandwich, cause I am famished.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Doreen? Come on, quit kidding around. (Gasps) Perry the Platypus! You found the Declutter-inator. Excellent. Okay, shoot me. Shoot me and I'll clean this whole place up. Oh, wait, What-What-What? It's- Oh, it's not plugged in. Hold on one second.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Activate bug eye-bot. (The bug eye-bot activates) Yes, my little robot eye, find Perry's address for me. That's right, Eye-bot, towards the front door so I can see the number. (Gasps) it will be so delicious to know where Perry lives. I can ring his doorbell...and run away! (Laughs maniacally)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah. That's what they sing at the end of the birthday song...Well, y'know, at least they...would have if...anybody ever sang....that song to me. Anyway...Hey, the floating head and little arms thing. I-I tried that back in the '90s.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hit me again. Hey do you mind if I use your restroom? I mean, technically I haven't had any coffee here, but I've bought coffee here and I thought that would qualify. I had a lot of coffee earlier this morning... Heh, okay TMI, I get it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) Welcome, Perry the Platypus. How do you like your trap? That's super quick drying cement. See? (Knocks on the cement) Solid as a, uh... I dunno, some rock-like substance. Cement, maybe! Now, with you safely trapped, I introduce you to the Metal-Unearth-inator! (The Metal-Unearth-inator fires, and a can comes back)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The molten lava at the earth's core completely slipped my mind. (They pull away, just as the lava flows above them.) Oh no! The lava is following us!!! (Perry uses a drill to divert the lava.) The lava is being diverted. You did it, Perry the Platypus! You saved us! (The drill comes back and Perry turns into the upper left and the lava is still pursuing them.) I hate to be a stickler, but the lava is coming again!!! Faster!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But it looked like fun! So with this dry-inator, I'll zap away all the water, and then I can replace it with my Doonkelberry oil. Then I can finally have fun at the oil park, and Roger's not invited! (He dumps Perry into the recycling bin, but the oil drum accidentally steps on his foot.) Ow! Oh! I use that foot for walking!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, and I just sprayed for squirrel men. (Doofenshmirtz activates a trap that Carl runs into.) Well, now, it appears that fate has dumped our mysterious guest like an immense pile of assorted "cheeses" onto the "lawn" of my evil lab. (pause) Yeah, I know it's a strange metaphor, but I stand by it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I think I've gleaned from your expression that you are now going to lead me through a series of bizarre and seemingly unrelated exercises that will help me get my groove back. Does that about sum it up? Good. Let's do this thing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, well, whatever, Perry the Platypus. (as Perry leaves) I got what I want! This giant, metal key that, when I think about it, is probably too big to fit into any of the keyholes that I would ever come across. Which makes me question the whole val -- (gets shocked by lightning)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Watching) What is this? Now, why would an astronaut wear such big gloves? Wait a second! (He gasps) Huge Hands Hans?! It's Huge Hands Hans! He found me out in space! Oh, you're not going to steal a show from me this time, Huge Hands Hans! Nor my Fräuleins!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If Vanessa could only see this place for what it truly is, she would finally hate it and thus benefit from that hate, like me! I can make an inator to make things the way they used to be, and then Vanessa can have her own backstories.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Aw, what a little cutie. What's a cute little love bug like you doing out here all by yourself? I'll call you Mr. Fluffy Pants because you're fluffy and you look like you're wearing pants. Plus, you remind me of my uncle Fluffy Pants.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Get it? 'Cause you're wrapped. In film. Well as you know, films sway public opinion better than any other medium. So I have produced a movie that will convince the people of the Tri-State Area, to make me their leader. Here's a clip.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Every object on Earth, when heated to a certain temperature, evaporates! With this, I'll be able to vaporize things at will, and cause all kinds of mayhem! I'm a genius! (At audience) For realsies this time. (At Perry) Now, to your station, Perry the Butler!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Listen, Perry the Platypus, I know I told if you turned yourself in, I wouldn't hurt your friends, but change of plans. Now I need to hunt them down, which might involve a little hurting. I know that makes me a liar, but hello! Evil! (Perry glares)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Where the heck... hey, how'd you get over there? Don't do that! (Perry pries a board off the sled) Oh man! (Perry jumps off the sled and uses the board as a snowboard, grinding a rail while traveling down the mountain) Okay, now you're just showing off! (Perry spots trees ahead and snowboards off to the right) What? Is there something I should... AAAHHHH!! (Doof crashes into the top of a tree, bending it down) I fail to see how this could get any worse. (Doof's head turns back to normal) Oof! (the rest of Doof's body turns back to normal; now lighter, the tree catapults Doof into the distance) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (trails off)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: In 10 minutes, the show's gonna start, and with you trapped and the Rain-inator at work, nothing will interrupt me! (Perry takes this opportunity to start moving the tube over towards Doofenshmirtz's drain pipe.) Hey, less pounding back there, okay? I mean, you're lucky I sprang for the clear tube, this way, you can watch too!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So just let me get this thing charged up and we'll be on our way. (Doof puts on some shades and covers Perry's eyes and pushes the button and gets the chain.) Ready? (He puts the chain around his neck and gets electrocuted. Perry walks offscreen to get a defibrillator, but Doof comes to when Perry arrives.) Wow, I feel pretty energized! I wanna do something exciting and fun and...and also incredibly stupid! Come on, Perry the Platypus, let's go have an adventure.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm. Anyway, I know we can't all fit in this, but...if we work together, there's a lot of blown up stuff lying around here, and I'm, I'm sure we can jury rig something that will carry, y'know, all of us. Like a well-bonded machine.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you want to see my inators! Man...Man, you've got quite an accent there! Alright, (walks up to an inator) here's what I'm workin' on now. Behold, the Slothinator! It will give me the powers of a sloth...which are super-slowness and super-leaf-eating.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How about a banana split? (He shove a banana split down Perry's bill) Haha! Finally got your just desserts. Good one, right? What are you doing with that pound cake? I was saving that for company! (Perry forces Doofenshmirtz to eat the entire pound cake in slow motion) Oh! Oh wow! Perry the Platypus, I'm getting such a sugar rush! How 'bout you? (Perry is shown to be having a sugar rush as well)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What's that? My inator remote? You're wasting your time. There's no way you'll get a clear line of fire from my place to here, what with all those commemorative hot air balloons in the way. How do they mass-produce those so fast?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look at this, Norm. My brother Roger has been elected mayor! Look at him. He's honest and reputable and, ugh, law-abiding! Oh! There isn't room for both of us in the Tri-State Area! Hmm. Norm, I know what we're going to do today.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) She's right, Perry the Platypus, I've been smothering her. You know, it's just so hard to let go, as a parent. But I'm going to turn over a new leaf though, I can tell you that. No more worrying, no more disguises, (takes off hippie costume) no more rules! (tosses Tri-State Almanac over shoulder)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, Norm, take the dollar, leave the platypus.(He hands Norm the dollar, who puts Perry on the floor then walks out right through the wall) And when you come back, use the door! (to Perry) He gets that from you, you know. Anyway, my plan is to fly Norm all over the Tri-State Area and drop leaflets, then everyone will do my bidding!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (A beam from the heat ray focuses on the Steak Containment Unit) Not the SCU! (Pronounced skʰʌ) Not the- You know, that I'm looking at the sign, I think it really does look more like SCU (Pronounced skʰu). Not the SCU! Come back here! Perry the Platypus, come back. Ooh, something smells delicious. (The top of Doofenshmirtz's building explodes sending steaks flying) Curse you, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, ha! You just wait till I connect with one of these. Then you'll wish you'd never been corned! Get it, 'cause it rhymes with... Hey what's with the fez anyway, we're not even in Egypt! (Perry pulls the tassel on his fez and it flies upwards, revealing a fedora underneath. The flying fez has an automated claw, which seizes the amulet from Doofenshmirtz. With the amulet still in its grasp, the fez flies upwards and out of the temple) You're a real spoil sport you know that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) When you run, the bulb lights up with human power. (gasps) Aha! I can use human power to power my End-All-Be-All-inator! I just have to channel the energy to my power bank upstairs. (Doof opens the window and calls upstairs.) Norm, drop an extension cord out the window, would ya?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. Have you come to sign my cast? (over a close-up of said cast, with multiple signatures on it) Look, I saved you a spot right there. It says, "Save for Perry." Well, it was a bigger spot before I wrote, "Save for Perry," but there's some room there. Grab that marker.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Not realizing what is happening) Off. On. Off. On. Off. On. Augh, I'm hearing a clanking voice, so I know it's doing something. (Realizes that the -inator opens the lobster trap) Oh, the -inator and the cage, they're connected. It's just, opens and closes the... Well I guess that's why I got the cage for free.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, I swear, I've never seen this secret agent-looking panda before. (laughs) Well, there's a panda in my closet and a panda paw print on my cheek. But it's not what you think. We're not enemies, we're just bad friends.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There! That ought to hold you. Lucky thing Mrs. Thompson had some salt I could borrow. (chuckles) Yeah. Yeah, consider yourself "a salted". Ah, man, I'm writing that one down. And now, to business. See that guy down there with the beard?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, relax. The cat's right... (realizes she's gone. Rotates his seat at the fleas.) Take that! And that! One for you, too! There you go! Uh-oh. Where's Harry? Oh, there he is! I see a bright future for that kid. Well, y'know, if we survive today. Oh, and there's Karen. Hi, Karen!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, then I say to him, "That's not a penguin. It's a throw pillow." And so he throws it at me. Turns out it was a penguin and its beak went right into my mouth. And I'm all, "Ew! Their beak is their nose!" Ugh! True story. (During this Perry frees himself using the sun's ray and punches Doofenshmirtz) Ah! (Perry takes the wheel)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Narrating) It wasn't so much of a pool, as it was just a...well let's just say it only had water in it on alternating Thursdays, and leave it at that. Anyhoo, in Gimmelshtump, jumping from the high dive was an important rite of passage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (turning around to talk to her) Have you seen my nemesis? He was just here a second ago. He's about (holds his hand at an approximate height of Perry) yay high and—ha. You know what? No matter. When the guy who's punching you suddenly loses interest mid-punch, it's time to take serious stock of your life. (turns around) (sighs).

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah. Tell your story running. C'mon. Keep it up! Knees higher! Knees higher! Oh, yeah! You've got good form! Look at you fitter in no time, and nothing makes an ex want you back more than a revenge bod! Right? Amirite?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Soon I will show them the havoc created when an acid and a base combine! (Laughs; dramatic music) But first I have to find an outlet 'cause there's a nice little laser show that goes along with it. Alright we'll take this out and put mine in. (Chuckles) Hello!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What! Never! Oh, suddenly you know my characters better than me? Forget it! I'm no sell out. I just crassly calculated commercial appeal in a mad quest for financial gain. No, no m-my artistic integrity and I are out! Peace!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yup. You know, uh, tsk, this is the time where you escape a-and try to destroy my inator. Oh, for Pete's sake, I... (releases Agent R) There! Now, attack! Start thwarting! (Agent R walks away) No... No, no, no, no, don't just walk awa... (sighs) I miss Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you might have destroyed Plan A, but behold! (Another -inator rises from the bus) Plan B! (Pushes a button and the -inator explodes) Which I have just destroyed, so now we're even. But not even I am prepared for Plan C! Haha! (Third -inator rises from the flatbed) Behold! The Be-Gone-Inator! How do you like me now Perry the Gone-a-pus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, w-w-what are you doing with that? Oh, no, my-my-my Eiffel Tower! Gotcha. Uh, hey, Perry the Platypus, I saved the Trifle Tower (Eiffel Tower). No, Perry the Platypus, don't zap it again. I-I-It will make it grow. (cries out) Oh, no, I'm shrunk.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, water. It's like drinking wet air. Now, Perry the Platypus, sit back and listen as the entire Tri-State Area screams the name Heinz Doofenshmirtz and never forgets it again! (Two aerosol cans fall into Perry's trap, and he uses them like a jetpack to propel his way out) Hold it right there, Perry the Platypus. (Doofenshmirtz tries to crush Perry with his giant mechanical hand, but Perry dodge it) Agh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm a man! Not a schnitzel. (Climbing up the high dive) I will prove it right now! (scoffs) Nobody calls me schnitzel anymore! I bet he doesn't even know what it means the little... (He reaches the top) Hey, hey, wait a minute. This isn't as bad as I remember...it's so much worse! (Clings onto the diving board)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for taking time out of your evening to thwart me, Perry the Platypus. You know the old saying, "Give a man a fish, he eats for a day. Give a man a fish-inator, and he can rule the entire Tri-State Area!" Order's up!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, if it worked on that jetpack squad, I bet ya it'll work on my brother, Roger! Maybe he'll take pity on me, and make me mayor! And that's just a hop, skip and a jump from having people give me the whole Tri-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What is it? Oh-Oh, Perry the Platypusss. Uh, hold on one second. (Takes out his grind guard) What? The pressures of an evil life! I need a grind guard. Wait a minute. Why are you here? You're not due to shatter my plans till tomorrow. Oh. Come on in.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And that is how the bad luck setting works. Except, of course, I won't be shooting random blasts off the balcony. Now, check out the good luck settings. A-And, again, I won't be just shooting it off the balcony like this. (He shoots it.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? What's he doing here? He's not a doctor. I don't think he's a doctor. I... I don't know for sure, I guess. He... He is truly an enigma. Wait, Diminutive! Whenever I trap Perry the Platypus, he escapes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look what you made me do! Oh, guess who's paying for this! (Perry ties Doof's hands with the duct tape) What is this? (Perry jumps out) Hey, why did you jump out that-- (Gasps) Oh, you clever, little plat-- (gets dragged out) Well, that wasn't very bright! Now we're both going-- (gets wrapped around the gutter of a plane) CURSE YOU, PERRY THE PLATYPUS!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, my own cubicle. (Agent Kitty joins him and Perry) How nice! I'm gonna put a poster, right here, a kitten that says, "Hang in there." (Doofenshmirtz turns and sees Agent Kitty; chuckles awkwardly) No offense. It's not like I think that's all you guys do, or anything. (Agent Kitty walks off) Oh, great, now he's going to Human Resources.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs) There you go, much better. Now you look like an adorable duck-billed baby. A trapped, adorable duck-billed baby. That's you. (tickles him) Coochie-coochie-coo! Ah, yes, the eternal question, Perry the Platypus, do you even sheep, bro?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: They're almost here. Oh, look, here they come! Perfect! The crescendo of all my— (Perry finally arrives on cue) Ah, Perry the Platypus. You don't stand a chance against my awesome heavy metal gear! (He presses a Wawa pedal and the amp next to him releases a trap.) Haha! Get it? Get it? Heavy metal. Like it's...? Ah.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, uh... oh! (takes the ring) Well, this is so sudden, but... but yes! A thousand times yes! And now that I've married into the family, I can use this mantis army to take over the entire Tri-State Area! Ladies, trap Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let me show you my Paper Cut-inator in action! (He steps on the edge of the toilet paper, causing Perry to spin very quickly, then shoves some paper into the Paper-Cut-inator) First, we get a piece of paper, and then load it in and--oh! That auto-feeder. It scares me every time! Okay, Danville. Get ready for some serious minor cuts and abrasions!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I rushed across the street to get my brother, Roger. He was in the middle of his favorite meal. A sloppy joe, greasy french fries with ketchup, grape juice, coffee, and chocolate pudding. And I insisted he come at once.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (To the Lumière brothers) No, no, no, you're not getting my best side. But here, let me show you my worst side! (Von Doofenshmirtz's swan eats the camera and Louis with it) What? Sweary the Swan?! (Sweary the Swan shows up, driving Phineas and Ferb's chore-doing machine directly at Von Doofenshmirtz) Ah, you want to play swan chicken, huh? (Sweary rams into von Doofenshmirtz, then backs up for another go) Oh, no—get back here! (Sweary uses the chore-doing machine to fire corn into von Doofenshmirtz's robot's mouth) Oh, no, he's using the old foie gras maneuver!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Finally, Perry the Platypus! All the other animal agents were here on time before they got captured. I'm just saying. It's embarrassing. Anyway, join your friends in the inhospitality suite! (tosses Perry into metal container) Ha ha! Oh, and Perry the...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh! Ooh! We can call ourselves Double Doctor Squad! Oh, no, that abbreviates to D.D.S, and I don't want people to think we're dentists. Ooh, how about Doof 'n' Diminutive Squad? No, no, same thing. Name TBD. Let's go!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughing) I have you cornered! This time, I will hit you with everything I've got! (sets the machine to MAX Power) Say goodbye, Perry the Platypus! (Lasers zapping, Explosion. Doofenshmirtz are now an old man and old...platypus man) (Elderly) Wait, wait, wait, that's not right. (Thud; chuckles) Perry the Platypus, just- just look at yourself. You really let yourself go.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (putting an arm around her) Oh, Honey, that's (smiles and points at her) very perceptive of you! (a slapping noise is heard and Doofenshmirtz turns his head) Yes! (turns back toward Vanessa) So, let's just put a pin in this. I'm kind of racing against the clock here. I know it seems like I'm putting you second, but it's only so I can put you first eventually!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) I mean it's not as weird as counting counter-topped whittling crabs to get rid of leg cramps, but still, you get the idea. Granted we had a lot of sheep for accounting purposes, but it just never really worked for me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A chipping gun? L-L-L-Like a tracking chip? Wait a minute, just so I understand this correctly, this is an apparatus that will plant a tracking chip into an animal, allowing anyone to know where they are at all times?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Man, that was difficult. It used to be so easy, just like filling out a piece of paper and dropping it off. All right, Perry the Platypus, you can do your thing now. I've got the rest of the afternoon off. Apparently.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That was your last highly-improbable judo maneuver Perry the Platypus. I will now evaporate-innate you into non-existence! (The Paper Pelican flies by covering the sun) Oh no! My… My power source! Oh, great, now I can't see a thing! (Perry runs and kicks Doofenshmirtz off the building) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Any last noises, Perry the Platypus? You know that little chirping silly noise that you make? (Perry chatters) That's the one! (Laughs; Perry swings over to safety, burns the rope and reaches for a purple "Caution" button) Wait, don't touch that button! No, no, the other one. (a black and yellow caution button) Yes, that one! That's the one you should not touch!!! (Gasps, Alarm buzzing)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus?! (traps Perry in a roll of toilet paper) Ha ha, ha ha ha! Amazing what you can do with toilet paper! Which you'd know, if you were a real plumber. In fact, it's amazing what you can do with all kinds of paper! (showing several stacks of paper in the background) And no, I'm not a hoarder.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? What? I didn't do anything wrong today. I just built an Inator to pick up my daughter. But, hey, as long as you're here, why don't you join me for my evil exercise show? I've got a spare headband.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Comfy, Perry the Platypus? I've prepared something special just for you. You see, until now, every attempt to eradicate you has been foiled. Then I came across a... (He interrupts abruptly with the sound of someone Slurping) Excuse me, who are you and what are you doing here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) So you're a superhero, huh? Don't you have some sort of power to get us out of this? (Perry pushes a button on his utility belt) Hey...Oh, wow! You've got...super wire cutters, huh? What, were they nail clippers that got bitten by radioactive pinching shears?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But, but, vogueing was my idea! I started to say "vogueing" and you just cut me off right before when I just got "vo" out. Y'know, I— (to Monogram) What did you think I was gonna say? Vociferous? What other words start with "vo"?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, I can't believe you removed this shopping cart from the supermarket parking lot! You must be feeling so evil! (Laughs) Oh, look at the time. I've got to go pick up Vanessa. Mush, Perry the Platypus, mush!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) Now onto the rest of the Tri-State Area! Oh, and Perry the Platypus, you know what the best part of my plan is? I can do it from the comfort of my own living room! With my favorite flat-screen TV and recliner. (Sits on recliner) Ah...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, uh, oh, oh I get it. Nemesis confrontation, huh? Yeah, yeah It looks serious. Uhh one of those "it ends here" kind of things. Whoo-ee Not fun. Okay, well-well don't mind me, I'm just playing through as they say.

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Seen as a fairy) What? You're not so much trembling. Wait, wait, wait, wait! Come back! (The mob leaves. The last person in the mob closes the door) So you're not an angry mob right now, but... I bet you're slightly irritated, right? I should get points for that! I should get points for that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, oh, right, right, you don't talk. Here, here, I'll help you. (grabs Perry's bill and makes it seem like he is talking) "Ah, Perry the Platypus, what an unexpected..." Well, I am really gonna have to carry this whole show, aren't I? Anyway, normally, it looks like this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, as much as I hate joining forces with good, I need to take my responsibilities as mayor very seriously, if I plan to abuse the position later, so... (He presses something on his desk) Melanie, have you gotten me the phone number of The Beak--?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Shh shh shh shh shh. You see, what I'll do is I'll zap myself with good luck and then I'll go zap Roger with bad luck, then I will ascend to become the Mayor of Danville and then I will rule the ENTIRE TRI-STATE...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Luck is called "stinkelkrampen" in Drusselstein and I never have any of the good kind. Turns out that every object has a positive or negative energy field. I harness that positive and negative energy and created...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as they walk off down the street while Perry watches nervously) Who would've thought that after all these years, all I needed to take over the Tri-State Area was a grammar-school goon. A ham-handed half-pint. A knee-high ne'er-do-well. A pint-size palooka. A pushy prepubescent.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (shooing some cats away) Shoo, shoo! Get out of here! It's not a real fish! (at Perry) As I was saying, the De-Evolutionator will blast past the Pacific Ocean, bounce off the satellite, and completely blanket the Tri-State area, de-evolving everyone!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) ...so I went out to get one. But then, Beverly told me I couldn't have it because they only make it in the winter. No matter how I begged and pleaded, she stood firm. No Minty Wink Eggnog! Because it's not winter!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A-ha! I-I wanted to say something clever about "cat got your tongue", but I haven't worked it out. You see, when we were small children, my brother Roger was always better at the whole manners and etiquette thing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I will not be attending the ceremony, but my pigeons will be there to rain on his parade! (Laughs) You see, Perry the Platypus, my brother Roger is at the top of a very long list of people I despise. (At Vanessa) Vanessa, music please.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow ow ow ow ow. Oh yeah? Take that! (Perry's hat flies in air) Haha, oh no no, not the fore, not the forehe-- (takes breath) I don't know if you noticed or not but I was boxing champion in my middle school back in Gimmelshtump and I got a few moves in... (Perry punches him in the stomach. Doofenshmirtz falls in the inator and Perry jumps onto him)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While pushing a shopping cart) Okay, I've already got the chicken wire. Let's see. Oh, here! (Hands a list to Perry, who's sitting in the child's seat) You-you...take the list and cross things off as we go. Should we get something for later, like uh like one of those big pickles or a three-bean salad? (he bumps the shopping cart against another one)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woohoo! Time to boogie, baby! Whoo! Whoo! My hustle's out of muscle but I can still shake my brick house or whatever the kids are calling it these days. (a kitchen timer dings) Norm, get the doonkelberry pie out of the oven, would you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Enjoying the shade Perry the Platypus? It's your jetpack! I found it stuck in the mouth of a fiberglass dinosaur I mean how often does that happen when you really need it? Climb aboard. Come on! Come on! Hahaha.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, I- I forgot what comes after the bridge. (Electricity fizzing) (Gasps) Peter the Panda, what are you doing? (Electricity fizzing) You're disassembling my Freeze-inator ray? While—While I' singing about my feelings? You! You're dead to me! You're dead to me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hang on, sweetie! (to Perry) Well, I guess it's just like the old saying, "You turn a guy into a gorilla-lizard, and he carries your daughter up a bell tower." It never really made sense to me before, but now I guess I... (Johnny pushes a bell off and it lands on Perry with a long DONG!)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I figured it all out. A fish in the hand is worth two in the inator, but a fish in everyone's hands means they can't stop me from taking over the entire Tri-State Area! (laughs) Because their hands are full. Of fish!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughing evilly) My neighbor's cat is totally shredding her drapes again. Too bad I can't see the OWCA from here. But it should be over by now. Pack up the -inators, Norm. Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated has a new headquarters!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If we do nothing, there's a hundred percent chance that the time pocket will dissolve and it'll destroy every— Y'know, there's a whole illustration I can do with a paper towel and a hook, but I don't have time.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: I spy with my one little eye, a new Tri-State Area that's one dictator short of a dictatorship. (he pushes a button and the Other-Dimensionator rises on a platform) Well, that's all about to change. Pretty soon I'll be ruling over two Tri-State Area's, a virtual Six-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (As the Butler-inator takes measurements of Perry) When my Butler-inator is finished with you, not only will you have a perfectly-tailored uniform and wig, but you will actually think you are my butler! You won't even remember that you fight evil for a living!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, you—you're early. I haven't even started yet. My-my daughter should be here any minute with the blueprints, though. Oh, there she is. (At Vanessa) Good morning, Vanessa. You remember Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'll take that. (takes folder) Uh, since my parents didn't show up to my birth, I'm not technically a citizen and I was never able to complete my citizenship test when I was your age. So I'm doing it now is what I'm saying.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You want culture from the old country, you go to the old people. A note? (reads the note on the door) "Heinz, in preparation for your arrival, we've taken a vacation until further notice. Give our love to Nessa, please don't call. - Mom"

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey brothers and sisters, I'm back with this industrial size first aid kit, and this state of the art security system. Not to mention-- (he gasps and grabs a fork from the unammed goth boy) Too sharp! (He dulls it down, then returns it to him) Righteous. (shoos a bird away from Lacie and puts a quarantine box on her hand instead) Quarantine! (puts helmets on Johnny and Vanessa) Acorn helmets. Better safe than sorry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz (current)
Dialog: Ow! You know, I don't come to your house and– Wait, these don't have any chlorofluorocarbons in them at all. These aerosol cans are completely harmless! Wh-what was I thinking!? Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look, I know what you're thinking. This could be dangerous with traffic and all. But have you had room temperature tuna, Perry the Platypus? That's the real danger. That's the collapse of society right there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha-ha-ha! So nice of them to leave the keys inside. (Perry stops at a red light) That's what you get for being the good guy. You have to stop at all the traffic signals. (laughs) Uh... Oh, no! What.... What is this? (Gets caught in the tornado) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I am NOT in love with Sophie! I am not! Oh, you're gonna get it now, Perry the Platypus! (puts on paper hat) Boom! (no effect) Well, that doesn't do much. I'm gonna get you with the Paper-Cut-inator! (trips) Flypaper? Well, it doesn't matter! Look!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Walking back to Perry and his inator) Well what about that? She didn't hear me. I'm still a great dad. And the sitcom cliche has been resolved. I guess I didn't need this inator after all. Say, here's a thought. How about if I blast you instead?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Sighs) Perry the Platypus...my head is killing me. This-This is all a wash anyway. I'll turn on the ray and you'll turn off the ray, thwarting my plan. Let's just get it over with, all right? Ray on. (Doofenshmirtz fires the -inator, but the beam bounces off a mirror, two men were carrying; Perry turns off the -inator and releases the magpies) Ray off. Good.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It was my idea! (turns on the TV) Oh, there he is. And he's fighting a giant puppet girl. What? There's something very familiar about the way she fights. Wait a minute. (The puppet punches the camera and the screen goes to static.) Perry the Platypus?! (Gets off the chair) That does it! I'm going down there!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
