Dialog: No, but he doesn't actually, you know, talk. So, you gonna tell me why you kidnapped me? (no response) Um, hello! I know you're still out there. I can see your eyeballs. What's with all the silence? It's very off putting.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, let me guess, Mr. Goody-Two-Shoes, we're going to return everything I shrank, right? (Doof sighs) Even the Roman Small-iseum? Hey, look, I finally figured that one out, huh? I-(Perry smacks his hat) Ow! Oh, curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now that the bees are out of the way, let's try this baby out. Just a little spritz. (He activates the Aroma-inator and gets more than just a little spritz.) Uh...okay...needs a little adjustments. (The doorbell rings) Oh, that's right. Charlene's coming over to get Vanessa's headphones for her. (He walks over to the door with the headphones and opens it to reveal his ex-wife.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz (cont'd)
Dialog: (like a cheesy tour guide) Mount Kilimanjaro is actually comprised of three volcanic cones: Kibo, Shira, and the one that we're about to crash into, Mawenzi. Cool, huh? (Doof struggles to get to the button until finally pressing it.) There! Oh. Oh, that wasn't the release. Who knows what that did?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: One small note, sweetie. You don't have to read the stage direction. Anyway, you get the idea. Kick here, punch here, bada boom, bada bing. Oh, no! Look out! He body-slammed me into my self-destruct-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, the Other-Dimensionator! Actually, this is the Other Other-Dimensionator, the Other-Dimensionator is back in the other dimension. (2nd Dimension Doofenshmirtz glares) Okay, step 1 is push this button. (pushes it, it powers up) Step 2, stand back in awe! (it starts up, but then shuts down) Awww...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I may be starving and dying of thirst, but at least I've got my hovel. What has he got? Nothing! He's a platypus. They've... They've got like... webbed fingers and no opposable thumbs. Practically flippers.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait! How did you do th-- (backs up against a pole) Hey, where did that whale come from? Oh, this is the worst party ever! (Perry escapes on a red balloon while Doofenshmirtz screams) My birthday cake! (Escapes on the helicopter blades with his cake) Goodbye, Perry the Platypus! At least I still have my cake! (Cake splats onto Doofenshmirtz while the bats squeak and charge at Doofenshmirtz) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (All that can be heard from him were shouts of pain)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Elected officials of the Tri-State Area, look to the skies in horror! (The "aliens" arrive) You are being invaded from space by invaders from space! And I, the King of the Aliens, am here to accept your unconditional surrender!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait, You saved her and now you're running off with her like...? OH! I have very mixed feelings about you! (to Perry) Uh... Perry the Platypus, how did you get here? I-I need a ride. Could you guys help me out?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Man, I've had off days before, but this is a lulu, even for me. I-I never thought I could get so sick of myself. Oh, well. You know, at least with a disaster of this proportion, things can't get any worse.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: With these Doofenplants, I will take over the Tri-State Area! I made them omnivorous because carnivorous just wasn't evil enough. I mean, "carnivorous"? What? They can't hurt plants? What's that all about?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, Perry the Platypus, you don't mind if I say goodbye to Peter the Panda, do you? I-- I just feel weird how everything happened. Hey uh, Peter the Panda, I just wanted to let you know that uh, I feel—Ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My sweet misguided Francis, your jobs wouldn't exist without us! (reading the comments) Let's see, "fight it out"... What... What's a "simp"? "Settle it over a soccer match"? That's so random. Hmmm. Whadaya say, BeefyMustache55?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you see, I'm part of a U.S., Canada, evil scheme exchange program. I come up with a scheme, and this other Canadian guy comes up with a scheme, and-and we switch. I-I do his scheme and he does mine.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, man, why did I save all the manual labor on my newest inator for the hottest day of the year? I might as well be doing hot yoga up in this piece! Can I get a "what-what?" (no response) Norm, where's my "what-what?"

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, yes, but... but I souped it up. It's now my travel-size-inator, and it will shrink anything I want dow to travel-size so it will fit in my bag. And then when I get home, I just reverse it and voila!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No!! What have you done, Perry the Platypus? I'm getting less evil! (crashes into and smashes the Backstory-inator) No! Significantly sooooooo!! (returns to normal) Darn it, I really liked that shirt. (Perry hang glides away from the building) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! Okay, so I-I'll see you tomorrow, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So let me explain my new evil scheme. A while back, my doctor put me on a low-carb diet, but I still can't lose those last ten pounds. (Lifts his shirt up revealing his rather large gut. Puts his shirt back down.) Every time I get close to my goal, there's this knocking at the door.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, what do you say we open the up the roof and activate the Sphere-Attract-inator? Then I can get a good nights rest before all the crowds arrive to see the world's biggest ball of--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm not speaking metaphorically. Perry the Platypus actually came in wearing his little fedora and destroyed my inator every single day last sum—Hold on, I think I'm having a breakthrough! I think maybe—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (On his hovering platform) It won't be a beautiful day for long. Not after they all start telling the truth about each other. I'll start with that hotdog guy down there. Wait 'till the world hears what's in those things. And fire!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's right, go on! Your services are no longer required. The lighthouse is gone, and there's nothing you can do about it. So you might as well run back to Major Monogram and tell him you lost this one.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pretending Vanessa is still there) Oh, uh, yeah, thank you. I am the greatest dad ever. Thank you for noticing. ("hangs up") Okay, first things first. Use my dry-it-off-inator to remove all the water, so I can then replace it with my Doonkelberry oil.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm gonna beat the rap, you know. I've been working on a rap-beat-inator. I just don't know if it works in France. I mean, have you seen the electrical outlets here? I wouldn't even know where to start.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey!!! Who are you calling foolish you ingrate?! Boy, one successful bid for world domination, suddenly he's full of attitude! I guess I should've expected that from a guy with a SQUIRREL FOR A HEART!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa, thanks for coming with me on this cruise. I... I've been needing a break from evil. It's so much more than a job. It's a lifestyle. That you can take anywhere. So behold! (unzips his fanny pack) My travel-size-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! No! No you're nerds! Get away from me, I'm not like you! I'm... I'm cool! Or, I was going to be cool, when I shot myself with the -inator, which is now destroy... uh... curse you Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, you melted their wax, but you can never melt what's inside—pure evil! (The two robots leap out, only to fall in the sphere making it explode] Ehh. I should have seen that coming.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aww man. I left the electrical tape in my other labcoat. (He notices what Norm is looking at) Oh, now I get it. Y-y-you've got a thing for that girl robot. Ah, she's not bad. I think you got a chance with her if you play your cards right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How did you get out of the trash, you drop-out bohemian? (To Perry) I'll be right back. I've got some deleting to do. That's right, tremble, my rejected friend. (accidentally presses the "Delete All" button) Oh no! I pushed the "Delete All" button by mistake!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus?! How did you get in here?! Oh, never mind. Ha ha! Behold! Well, it started as a chipping gun, but now it's my platypus-finder-inator! You missed the... the whole rebranding process.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, but then I would have to drive to a store, and find a parking space, then you have to choose from, like - dozens of styles, I- It just seemed like so much work. This will be much less complicated.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Yeah, you know what, we're totally cool now, I'm-I'm just going to go back to my home and live out the rest of my days with my Choo-Choo. Okay then, ciao! (he steps through the portal) Ah, home, it's good to be... (the 2nd Dimension Fireside Girls (also known as the Firestorm Girls) march up) Uh-oh.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on CB radio) Well, let's see. I'm eastbound with a smoky on my 20, on a cab over Louie with... You know, I'm gonna level with you. I-I don't know where I am or what I'm saying, really. Is-Is there a code for that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, that wasn't as successful as I'd hoped.... (grabs jet-pack and puts it on) but at least I can beat a hasty retreat before I'm too humiliated! (He revs up the jet-pack and it shoots into the sky, tearing his clothes off and leaving him in his underwear and socks. The underwear is patterned with Agent P heads. Agent P notices this and gives him a dumb look) Huh? (laughs nervously) For your information, I had these way before I met you. (jet-pack shoots by and he walks away) (Halfheartedly) Okay, see you tomorrow.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, (Laughs) No, not really. But follow me. (They walk to the kitchen) I-I do something even more impressive over... There. Eh my brand-new... Blender-Inator! (Opens the lid and puts a Granny Smith apple in the Blender-Inator) Spelling doom for even the toughest of apples! (Turns it on) Bow down to me, Granny Smith!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wai-wai-wait! Or... go with me here... I make everyone else a moth. Cuz, y'know, like in a city of men, I'm like a four at best. But in a city of mothmans, who knows? I could be like a... like a six!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah, we're gettin' there now! Soon I will preempt my brother's documentary marathon with my own live video! And there's not a thing you can do about it, like... li... like all those other times.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And since my lawn gnome was taken away from me, I will destroy every lawn gnome in the entire Tri-State Area! Behold, the Destruct-inator! (He pulls a curtain, revealing the giant machine) And now, Perry the Platypus, to activate my creation! (pushes a button and opens Perry's trap) Noooo! (Perry hits him)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I see you, Perry the Platypus, now kick the door… (Perry kicks the door and the trap, a large TV, activates) Haha! Gotcha, Perry the Platypus! Hee hee hee! I saw you coming on my video surveillance system! Ah, if I had a nickel for every time I trapped you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, say "goodbye" to splashy-pool time fun, forever! Even my power source is greevil. Look, look! It's solar! Do you mind Perry the Platypus, this is-this is really a two-handed job. (He hangs the phone up on Perry. A panel in the floor rotates Perry to a potted plant, then back to Perry, now free) Ah! Seriously- (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz in the face, knocking his into his -inator, and firing it in an unintended direction)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Oh, look, it's the kickball field! And Vanessa! Time out, Perry the Platypus, for emotional reasons. Look, look at my Nessa! She's having fun in Drusselstein! (sighs) I never had that. It's nice to see.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (original)
Dialog: Oh nice... nice one. Catch the villain in his own trap. That's not ironic Perry the platypus, it's...it's cliché, that's what it is. It's just plain lazy on your part. Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Friday was always Cruise Night and everybody would come out to see the hipsters and their cool cars made from cannibalized parts left over from Drusselstein's many foreign occupations. But for me...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa! Vanessa! Alright, alright, party's over! I've had it up to here with you me's! Y'know, I'm really getting sick of the sound of my own voice. Now I understand where Charlene was coming from.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pouring oil on the floor) Okay, twenty-third time's the charm. I totally got it all covered now. (walks over to Norm) Hand me that box of angry weasels, would ya, Norm? (Norm hands it to him and Doofenshmirtz opens it, then the weasels attack him) Ow! Ow! Ow! O-ow! (closes the weasels back in their box, and reveals his face, covered with injuries) Yes, they'll do. It's the latest Perry the Platypus trap.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I finally spotted it, when... (With binoculars, Flashback Doof spots a gopher take the key and run into its hole) I could tell he was laughing. You know, that way gophers do. And there was no way I was going to go all the way down there to get the key. I've got a schedule to keep.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Stabby Barf Pain? Just when we were sure we only had four seasons, suddenly there's a fifth. Anyway, we'll have to take the bus because maniacal parallel parking turned out pretty much as expected.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You know, I don't even know what I was thinking with the whole "evil robots" thing. Actually, when I look around, I-I'm really embarrassed. Here, let me clean this up. (he pulls out a remote labeled SELF DESTRUCT) Look. "Self Destruct" button.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, you came back and saved me! Thank you, Perry the Platy... (He begins to breakout.) Hey... wha... what's this? I'm having an allergic reaction to these stupid plants! Curse you, inadequate immune system!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And let me tell you, transitioning to adulthood was painful, but, actually, I guess a good indicator of things to come. (in a flashback on screen) In Gimmelshtump, jumping from the high dive was an important rite of passage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How is this possible? I took every precaution! I had the Rain-inator, I had you trapped in a - what the? (Perry, standing next to the gushing remains of the Rain-inator, salutes and hops into his hovercraft.) ¡Maldito seas, Perry el Ornitorrinco! Man, this is gonna cost me a fortune on my water bill.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You did it! You saved us, Perry the Platypus! You sa—again, again with the déjà vu. You were up there, I was saying, "You saved us." And then, hm, and then something came from– (The tin foil ball crashes into the building) Curse you, déjà vu!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (reading) "Bring Your Nemesis In for Bragging Rights and a Special Prize!!!" That's easier said than done. I catch Perry the Platypus every day, but like suppressed flatulence, he always manages to escape.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: See? One last trick up my sleeve. It's me! I'm the trick up my...own sleeves. Cause I'm-I'm in the sleeve, get it? (they look) Ugh, pearls before swine. (he pulls a lever, the bot aims back a punch) Hope you got your 3-D glasses, cause I'm comin' at ya!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right, you broke it. I consider myself thwarted there. This is not how I wanna—Whoa! A huge cloud with a face! You don't see that every day. Wait, wait. How could I use this for evil? Hmmm...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs evilly) Yeah heh, anyway, sorry I can't tell you my evil scheme, because I... I don't know what this does yet. I'm still looking for an on-off switch. Life was much simpler when I worked as a lawn gnome.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is, uh, it's kinda weird, actually. I'm usually thwarted by this point. Hm. Well, I guess he's not coming. (he turns it on, a portal forms) And now! Behold! The mind-blowing first images from beyond our dimensional reality!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If that's you, Perry the Platypus, I'm not doing anything evil. I— That is definitely not Perry the Platypus. (runs like crazy) If you... If you plan to eat me, I'm all gristle and very gamy! I'm not good at all!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! I'm going to have my own show, on television! And then, all of these fans will be so enamored of me, they will do my bidding. (Laughs) It's actually happening! I am going to rule the Tri-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, you know, any, any kind of adhesive, anything. A sticker, adhesive bandage, uh... (He pulls the mustache off the Monogram Robot) Oh. This'll do. That's it, the Re-Good-inator, it's finished. Wait, wait hold on. Behold the Re-Good-in...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh. We're starting here now. Hey, it has been brought to my attention that I should tell you guys there's a 55% chance this will work, but a 45% chance that it'll destroy reality as we know it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How completely unexpected! (climbs down the ladder) And by that I mean, it really was actually unexpected. (walks towards Agent R) Well, you have a hat, so you must be an agent. I guess that means Perry the Platypus is not coming, so... (takes a controller from his lab coat) A-ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right, here it is. (continues reading) "Charismatic, inventive, beloved, should be leader of the entire Tri-State Area. My dear... Uncle Roger, the Mayor"? Wait. What? Why would she choose my brother over me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, if I can get everyone in town to exercise, I can tap into all this free electricity, store up the surplus and use it to take over the Tri-State Area! I'm gonna need a lot more treadmills.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I-I don't even know what you're talking about. (turns to the fedora-less Pery) Who's this platypus? Why am I handcuffed to him? And where is Perry the platypus? (Liam just ignores him) So to recap in order of importance, why am I handcuffed to him?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What is he doing up there, just flying around in circles, uhh. It gives me the creeps! Well, it worked out in my favor anyway because, turn, close latch, I'm finally ready to begin my scheme!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello? Where am I? Oh, it's all gastrointestiney in here. Hmm... Brain. (gasps) I'm inside a dog! (Pinky wakes up in surprise then glares) Perfect. Now I can pee all over the Tri-State Area! Ha ha ha ha ha! (sighs) Oh, what am I doing with my life?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah, this is where all the years of studying evil science really pays off. (Doof looks behind him to catch a familiar sight.) Ah, Dr. Diminutive. I won't say it's good to see you, but it is, it is hard to see you because you're so small. (laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You think you're so clever, Perry the Platypus. But for the first time in my life I can actually use a self-destruct button that I have installed! Prepare to be vaporized, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Focus, must finish Inator. (hears applause) Wha... what's all that noise out there? I don't get it, what... what's there to applaud? My fog machine should've obscured everyone's Inators. What could they be...

Name: Younger Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Cool, I'm fourteen years old. Ha, ha, I totally beat you, dude. Now all I got to do is take this DVD to the Film Festival, and then I'll, like, have a lot of power, and stuff. And I'll like–

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's working! It's working!! And so much better than I thought it would! (Perry throws his fedora, which breaks apart some heating tunnels and drop onto the switch) All my life, everyone told me I couldn't make a mountain out of a molehill, well, everybody, take that!... (Doof gets electrocuted) (yelling)-whoaouch!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: With the De-Evolution-inator back in my hands, I can reverse the settings, and I'll have the most highly evolved brain on earth! (hits himself with the De-Evolutionator, only to have his head swell up, making him fall over) Now that I'm so smart, I don't think it was such a good idea.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, did I win? (He takes off his helmet, which splashes more water onto him.) Oh, wait, no! Curse you, Paolo Vanderbeek! Y'know, that just doesn't roll off the tongue the way "Perry the Platypus" does. Perry the Platypus, Perry the-Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Pericles the Platypus! I-I dunno what "Perry" is short for, so I'm just trying stuff out. 'Til you tell me any different, Pericles the Platypus, that-that's your name. In the meantime...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It was at that point that Norm and I decided to come out here. Plus the bat kinda looks like my cousin, Narthelliot, which, as you can imagine is weird for me. Isn't that about right, Norm?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, my luck may be back to normal but at least I still have an entire trunk full of delicious almond brittle. (Opens a can and fake snakes pop out.) Ugh. Mental note: Never accept canned confections from a guy in a clown suit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as the sled goes off a ramp) Aaaaugh!! (Perry climbs up the scarf and lands on the front of the sled as Doof's feet grow big and hairy, causing his shoes to fly off) Oh, my feet! Now it's working. (several more pops are heard as Doof becomes completely abominable) Hey, not bad. A little hairy, but not bad. Now, to deal with you! (Doof grabs for Perry, who darts under his legs) Gotcha! Hey, where'd you go? (Perry tugs on Doof's back hair) Oh, there you are. (Perry beckons Doof to come closer) Yes? (Perry punches Doof, whose head causes the Abominable-inator to point upwards) Ow! Ow, Oh, stupid thing! (Doof attempts to adjust the -inator, but it hits him in the head again) Ow! (the -inator fires)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You almost foiled my plan! (Perry is seen ensnared by pink sticky string.) Luckily, I had an extra can of sticky string to subdue you with. Oops, I forgot to plug it in. I always wait 'till the last minute 'cause it takes a lot of power. (plugs it in, only for the electricity to go out in Danville...)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello, and welcome to L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N.'s first annual... (The agents' cheering is still heard. Doof speaks louder.) I said, L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N.'s FIRST ANNUAL DISSERVICE **AWAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAARDS!!!** So, who's ready to have some fun?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, look how cute you are! All snug in your cozy widdle trap. (chuckles) Why the chef's hat you ask? It's the cheapest way I could find to trap you. Hey, times are tough waiting for my alimony check!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know you can drop the whole "bad guy" spiel. (Mitch's robots strap Doofenshmirtz onto a metal panel) I'm actually willingly going along with this, in case you hadn't noticed, but, you know, okay, you're a bad dude, cool, whatever, I get it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We should be over Grulinda's party any minute. Then it's soggy revenge time! (part of water from giant bucket falls off) Whoa! It's windy up here. If that keeps up, I don't have enough water to dump on her. (Perry thinks for a while, then bumps giant bucket on purpose. He does this one more time.) What? Did you hear that? (Perry just keeps quiet)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I took the liberty of going through your address book and inviting all your little friends, including a nice fella named Johnny. He had hearts by his name. I think I know what that means.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't remember inviting him. (To Perry) No, wait! Perry the Platypus! No, no! Please! Don't turn that dial to the "Doofenshmirtz mobile and Evil Investors away-inator"! (Perry flips switch) I have to rethink my dials. (Car disappears)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow. That could have gone better. (Perry walks up) Oh, there you are, Perry the Platypus. Oh, you... You saw that, huh? Yes. Of course. (Pause) You think I'm evil, right? (Perry smiles) Thank you, Perry the Platypus. (Camera pans to Perry and him looking at the moon) Thank you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Now on top of the caboose) Oh, man, I never have a grappling hook when I need one. And I totally looked at mine this morning when I was getting dressed. Right there on the dresser. Oh, I hate it when that happens.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello, Perry the Platypus! I take it for granted sometimes what a professional you are, especially after dealing with that guy they sent instead of you yesterday. So how was debate camp?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The best part is the pop-up ads will never go away. There's a little button that says "Click here to close", (Camera pans to Perry) but guess what? It just opens another pop-up ad! (Camera switches to him) (Laughs) Pop-up ads. Best idea ever.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It is you! My father will be so happy! Well, maybe not happy, but anything is an improvement on surly and dismissive. Let the father-son healing begin! (He arrives at the old Doofenshmirtz house and takes Perry out of the baby carrier.) Wish me luck, Perry the Platypus! (Perry smiles and gives him a thumbs-up.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on phone) Yes, Mother, I know I promised that I'd spend some quality time with my brother, but, golf? Really? I mean... No, I am not a big baby! I- I am not! Oh, there he is now. Goodbye, Mother. (hangs up)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) It all started when I was a child, back in Drusselstein. There was this mean girl named Grulinda. Every day she would pour water on my head. (Young Grulinda laughs after pouring water over young Doofenshmirtz's head.) No matter where I was, (Young Grulinda again pours water over young Doofenshmirtz's head and laughs.) or what I was doing, (Young Grulinda again pours water over young Doofenshmirtz's head and laughs.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now see, I can release you and it doesn't matter. The entire world has forgotten all about that humiliating video of me on roller skates. And I won't be needing this anymore! (He throws the Delete From My Mind-inator on the floor, breaking it. He then runs out of his room.) I'm free!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, in the future we won't sit and read newspapers in the morning. Instead, giant robots will control us in human death matches. (Camera pans to Perry, who is putting poker cards on the table) Well, that gives us something to look forward to.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) No! No! Not that! Anything but the fake red licorice! It tastes like... (Doof grunts. Perry stops walking and figures he has to save Doof.) No! What possessed me to make such a horrifying inator?! (Perry jumps on the DVDs and hops onto the inator aiming it. He lands on the floor and hits the remote. The inator hits the vending machines. A giant nickel rolls by and the machines run for their lives.) Well, I guess now we know what scares vending machines.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've got it ready. It's filled with crossword puzzles, and a big, fat, house cat that will lay on my belly and warm me into my...senior years. (Pause) Anyhoo, where was I? Oh, yes. Evil laugh. (laughs manically)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? Weapons!? (angrily) Oh brilliant! Like nobody ever thought of that. I mean, you destroy the Tri-State Area and what are you ruler of? Rubble! And where's the panache? The je ne sais quoi?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really? Really? W-why does everyone just stampede to that conclusion? O-Other people wear lab coats you know. Why, why don't you say, "Oh look a rocket scientist." Or a veterinarian?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great. (sighs) Great instinct turning me back into a human, Perry the Platypus. And frankly preferable to that whole "make everyone else into mothmans" thing, (puts on the aviator cap) 'cause, ya know, "reasons".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, that's enough. Wait, no! It's too much electricity! It's gonna blow! Okay, gym's closed! That's it! You're all buff enough! Stop... Stop pedaling! It's too much! It's too much!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'd like to help you out, Norm. Really. But look at my tongue. (his tongue is blue) See? Look at that. My doctor said no more raspberry icicle-pops until the blue dye flushes completely out of my system.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I was just passin' by, you know, communing with nature and all, like, you know us, us hippies do it, a-and I thought, you dudes might want a few groovy pointers from an old pro.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Gasps) Oh, so you had an Age Accelerator-Inator proof suit! (Laughs) Well, I have a little surprise of my own. (Fabric tearing but it's just his underwear) Heh. Well, It's already 4:30. I think I'm going to bed. Curse you, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, if it isn't Perry the Platypus! And when I say "isn't" I mean "is". I know you're into martial arts. But I prefer the confectionery arts myself. (A gingerbread house falls on Perry) That's gingerbread house trap. (Peeking through a window in the house)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (To nobody in particular) It's not like I wanted to go to the desert. He-He just jet-packed into me and dragged me along. No animals on the bus, it's not my rule. It's-It's company policy. It's not my fault.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Stop! (panting) Hm. That's an interesting shape. It looks famil-- (steps on a soda can) Aah! (sighs; sees the "Anti-Gravity Fun-Launcher / Anti-Gravity Evil-Launch-Inator) Wait. An anti-gravity evil launch-inator. I found another one. Heh. What are the odds? (turns on his phone) Norm, get down here. I need help.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I know it's gross, and my jaw is killing me. Anyway, behold my Face-Plant-inator! It doesn't make people fall on their faces. It makes plants with my face! My face on a plant!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now watch as the smell of dirty diapers (The growth elixir lands in his hand without realizing this) pollutes the very molecules that surround this building! I just snap it (putting the growth elixir in the machine) into place and set the range for, say, 200 yards (setting the range selector to 200 yards) around the building.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus! As usual, your timing is uncanny! And by uncanny, of course I mean: Completely canny! (Button beeps) So, Perry the Platypus, let me introduce to you my assistant, Vanessa.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really? It says "do over" right in the name. I-it does the day over again, but I haven't worked out all the kinks yet. Matter of fact, I gotta work out the kinks in a lot o' these.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the...I guess he doesn't really get credit for this one. He was just playing tambourine with Swine Flute. It's not really.... (sighs) Well....Sort of anticlimactic for me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See, this is what it's like having a teenage daughter. You're never cool enough. Anyway... (With a gleeful look) Why are you hitting yourself? Why are you hitting yourself? Why are you hitting yourself?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And don't worry about your lack of training and experience, because I have an ace in the hole. (pulls out a raygun) This - the Misbehave-inator. It, uh, well, it does what the name implies. Watch this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right! Nice one! Oh, let me help. We gotta have some weapons around. Wait wait wait, what does this lever do? (pulls the lever several times) No, no, no, that, uh, it doesn't...it doesn't seem to do anything. (Cut to reveal Perry's seat hitting him, revealing what it does.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I have to renew my evil business license at Danville's Embassy for Evil today. You can come along in case I need someone to vouch for my evilness, which I think—I think you can do.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, Perry the Platypus, that dress sort of suits you. If you know, you just accentuate the positive as they say... Um, I'm going to stop talking now, I'm moving into a weird-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait! Why don't you help me? That way I can finish faster and you can defeat me faster. It's-It's win-win! Let me grab my coupons. We'll start by shopping for some supplies.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Step three: Infiltration. They'll take them completely by surprise. They'll just walk right in the door past that giant lava lamp, and... Why would there be a giant? (record scratch) IT'S A TRAP!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, wait a minute. I've been going about this all wrong. I should be zapping you with the Least-Likely-inator so you'll lose! But first, I gotta get this sandwich out of the way.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, it's time to go. Luck and cover. (He shoots himself with the inator and chuckles.) Good stinkelkrampen tickles! (gasp) Look, a penny! It's working! Aw, man, tails! Well, you know the rules, Heinz. Turn it over for the next person.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What happened? Something just happened. I-I smell bitterballen. Where are we? (Perry lifts his hands off his eyes.) Hey, not bad, I can totally go for a mid-afternoon nosh. (Perry hops onto the Teleport-inator and looks at the self-destruct button.) What are you doing? (Perry turns the knob to the "home" setting.) CURSE YOU PERRY THE -- !

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You never meant to work with me, did you, Perry the heartbreaker? Yes, go. Go back to your agency with their...Their uncool acronyms! Just remember, we once had something special!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (drifting away on the puppet) Okay, well I guess I'll see you both later. Unless I miss my guess, I'm on my way to...Norway, so, uh, take it easy, Dennis the Rogue Rabbit and uh, curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, first of all, that's a little sad. But, second of all, technically, you would be third banana. It would go: Kelly, and then me, and then you. And, I would be second banana.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (from inside) He's getting closer...he's looking into her eyes! (Perry attaches a grappling hook to a passing airplane.) He's opening his mouth! (Perry ties the other end to the Rain-inator) He's forming his lips to start to articulate the syllables! Tell her, Juan! Tell her why you love her!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Peter the Panda? Oh, that was a good shot of me. Oh, and that one. That one, too. And that one, that one was terrible, my nose looked all crooked, eh, it needed scribbling on it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, why don't you have a seat in my waiting area? Read some magazines! Sorry they're all in Spanish, I--I steal them from my neighbor. You know, evil never rests.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a minute. First of all, he's my nemesis! And you can't get rid of him now. Where's the fun in that? You-You need to explain your whole plan to him. Don't you have a nemesis?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So-So you know when you walk around in socks and rub them on the carpet, you get that little static shock? (He comes out from behind the screen) Behold, the new uniform of pure evil! I call it the socky-shocky-suity.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, so everyone pay attention to this. This is what I was talking about. The DNA of a human is only a few base pairs from that of a monkey. (Johnny's left arm becomes a lizard's arm.) Or... or a reptile for that matter.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, look at us! We're fighting over the remote like an old married couple! Hahaha. It's not cute. And I have a remote too; I'm going to get my own talk show!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And we're back. The Inator Corporation was generous enough to send us a giant check for $23. Thank you, Sid and the guys. You do an important job. (pause) That brings our tally up to...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? It just -- vanished? What's wrong with this thing? (looks at the microwave timer, it says "3:00") Oh, the microwave was on the "baked potato" setting, so I guess everything is just gonna last for three minutes. My bad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I'm aware that I look like someone's grandma, but I've taken up gardening because it was supposed to be relaxing. But instead, it brought up a lot of long-buried memories.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Climbing into the helicopter) He's a platypus, not a beaver. Hiya Banny! Pardon me, official exchange buddy coming through. (To Bannister) Yo, bro. Back so soon? My evil plan usually takes all day. How'd you do it so fast?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know Perry the Platypus, I...I didn't realize this trap would be so heavy. City Hall is still like a few blocks away, you don't mind if I just leave you here, do you? Hello?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Exactly! Ever since that stupid billboard went up, my panoramic view is completely ruined. I used to have this perfect vantage point for enjoying the delicious misery of others.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (reaching for the bottom button) This one should be the right—Okay...I....got it! (Perry gets released) Quick! (Perry jumps onto a cage and steers the skiff away from Mawenzi. He falls backwards and gets trapped...again.) You know, Perry the Platypus, I just— (Gasps) A golf course! A golf course has a lot of traps in it! That's what I shoulda said.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, Danville, get ready for a carbon footprint you'll never forget!! (The Carbon-Footprint-inator stomps onto the faucet, but the gum gets stuck to it.) Hey hey- What? Oh, see? This! This is why I hate nature! It's always getting stuck to your foot! Yech!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as Buford drops a gob of spit on the plastic model of Baljeet's house) You know, I'm kind of surprised that we haven't had a visit from my nemesis yet. (Switch to show Perry hiding in the rafters, looking deeply uncomfortable) I-I'm sure he'll be along. I can't wait to see the look on his face when he gets a load of you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But, after I launch this baby into orbit, my problem will be solved! Then, I can go on to eliminate all the other annoyances that make my skin crawl! Like, uh...nature! (Laser zaps) Beauty! (Laser zaps)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Are you trapping me? But we were getting along so- (Perry motions towards the turbo switch) The turbo switch!? Are you kidding? I-I can't control this thing at that speed. O-Okay Perry the Platypus, if you think so... (Perry throws the switch)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That mystical melody is now in my very hands. And once I learn to play it, I can summon the aliens to me and I will become overlord of the TRI-STATE AREAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!!! (takes off his gloves) That's it! That's it! That's it! (takes off his lab coat and shirt) I've had enough of you me's! (Doof is now in his underdrawers.) Alright, you freaks! Fresh meat! Yippee-ki-yay, you pharmacist freaks! Yippee-ki-yay!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, what is this? Perry the Platypus in a death trap? What the—When did L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. get so evil? And wh—Hippos? Wait, aren't sharks more traditional in a death trap?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heh heh. Uh, I neglected to mention they've also developed a taste for wood, and paper, and Vanessa's pleather boots, and basically, anything I've put in front of their mouths.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now we have a two-ton ball of tin foil traveling two hundred miles an hour directly at us! Quickly, we must separate the magnet from the Magnifinator before it is too late!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoa whoa whoa! That was not nearly humiliating enough! Where was the part about bowing and pulling your shirt up over your face and juggling piglets? Where were the piglets?!

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oops, gotta go. (Chuckles) (Runs to Castle Phineastein) Evil! (Knocks the handle) (Evil laughing) Hyah! Got your nose! (Laughs) I got your... I... I... I really do have his nose. (The platypus monster is seen without his bill) Oops. Heh. Okay, okay. Well, we'll just put this back. (The platypus monster is seen with his bill, but slanted) There you go. Good as new.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah-ah-ah, Perry the Platypus. Park policy states that you can't enter without a wristband. Luckily, I always carry extra wrist-oriented ornamentation. Here, admission for one.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, I'm glad you're here. I'm just in line for the high dive. You see, it reminds me of the high dive I knew as a kid at the Gimmelshtump Public Wetness Maker.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A junk yard? Wh-Why can't they have their party in a nice place, like the Caribou Lodge? You ever been to the Caribou Lodge, Perry the Platypus? They have a nice spread there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: To the basement! (a man walks up to the buttons and attempts to press up) Aah! Quit it! Fresh! (looks at the buttons) Alright, let's see, garage, basement, catacombs, pessimistic humanoid underground dwellings...Ah! Here it is: gift shop and secret vault! (Pushes the button.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, Perry the Platypus, (Giant Candace is seen out the window climbing up as he walks by with Perry, somehow not noticing her or feeling her vibration as she was climbing) I found a way to distill the smell of dirty diapers into a concentrated liquid form, (He shows Perry a beaker filled with blue liquid.) which I will spread throughout the festival using my Smellinator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, so what? Big deal. So it missed its initial target. A minor setback. (Perry puts his finger on one of the bratwursts in the pile.) No wait! You'll disrupt the pile's equilibrium! (Perry takes the bratwurst out, nothing happens.) Well, hot diggity do— (All the bratwursts fall onto Doofenshmirtz and crash through the building and go down the streets with the Hot-Dog-Vendor-Revenge-inator.) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait! Star-crossed-love? Wait! Wait! Vanessa, was this your secret boyfriend?! This guy?! The guy with the enormous nostrils?! (to Monty) Hey, you've got a bat in the cave there, buddy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hello? Hello? Here, a selfie will make him jealous. (snaps a pic) Time to make my life look more glamorous than it is. Mmm! (sips his drink) Oh, cabana boy! What's his name? Benny? Ben? Benjamin? Benjamin!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Essay? (takes paper) Oh, Vanessa's applying for college! (sighs) They grow up so fast. (reading) "The Most Positive Role Model in My Life, by Vanessa Doofenshmirtz." Se—See, look, Norm. She wrote about me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How are we doing in the back row? Can you see okay? Alright; away we go! (turns the knob on a controller to "de-evolve", but nothing happens) Oh, for badness sake! What now? (climbs up to the lens) Oh, I see. It's.. it's just a little smear on the lens. If I just... (wipes away the smear)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the... (his phone rings) Hello? Oh hi, Vanessa. Yes, that was my -inator. Listen, honey, I'm in the middle of something, hold on one second. (at Perry) ...PLATYPUUUS! (at Vanessa) So, how was class?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Full steam ahead. Chugga-chugga, chugga-chugga, whoo hoo! Oh, hey, there. Is that the Doofenshmirtz choo-choo? No, it's not! You will all be late for your jobs and be fired. (laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) I am so tired. The jet lag is really hitting me now, I just... (sighs) (beat) I should probably get up. This floor is just so comfortable. Is... Is this pine? (beat) Two more minutes, that's all.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright so I'm on a runaway train in a tunnel. Afraid of the dark, I- probably also afraid of runaway trains, never really given it much thought. Doesn't come up that.. (They leave the tunnel) Ahh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Buuuut, ya know who isn't a loser? The Tri-Governor! I just need to win that office and Vanessa will want to (starts walking towards his Do-Over-Inator) stay with me! And this (pets the Inator) little baby's gonna help me get it right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't believe it! An-An entire army of mes! Ha ha! (runs to the elevator) Oh! For once, I'll actually be able to take over the Tri-State Area 'cause I'll have, you know, the volume. Ciao, baby!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think the turbo kicks in when it revs abo— (Perry gets another worried look on his face) Whoa! (The car speeds through an intersection and crashes into a dumpster.) Oh, oh! Oh, it's okay, we're fine! But we do seem to have picked up a passenger! I'll shake it loose up here at the turn. (Doofenshmirtz and Perry turn, while the dumpster continues on.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Seriously? Y-you have an entire chamber reserved just for extracting things? That, that really comes up that often in your life? The extraction of things from other things.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) Errgh, this is all your fault! If you hadn't broken my inator, I could reverse all this! Listen, I'm gonna go try to fix the droogen strudel, you go stall those emissaries.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for everything, Perry the Platypus. And don't worry, I - I'll pay for the dry cleaning on your Rumpkinhossen. All right, see you back home! I'm taking the trebuchet. (Perry blasts away on a jetpack)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Narrating) I quickly discovered that although I loved painting, (Shows young Doof ripping his painting in half) my muse was sometimes... inaccessible. (shows him lying on bed, depressed) Then one day, just as I was about to give up in frustration, inspiration struck.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, here we are! (chuckles) Right up close! You sit here, Perry the Catypus. (laughs) I just came up with that. That totally makes up for missing the "cat got your tongue" thing from before.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Anyway, today is the day we reveal to the Tri-State Area, the existence of the League Of Villainous Evildoers Maniacally United For Frightening Investments in Naughtiness!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Time to start my Turkey Takeover! Commence random firing! (the Turkey-inator hits the following items: a passenger train that turns into turkey wings, a mailbox that turns into a turkey wing, which is eaten by two mail carriers, a cooked turkey, Perry's trap that turns into a turkey leg, in which Perry is led to escape) This is great! With Perry the Platypus out of the way, I can finish my sentences without getting punched in the-- (Perry punches him in the face mid-sentence)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, Perry the Platypus, this ship is gonna expl— (notices Perry fighting robots) Oh, oh, never mind. I'm on it. I'm on it. Oh, I guess I just have to press this blue button. Uh, Balloony, what are you...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woo hoo hoo hoo! How's the dye job holding up, Perry the Platypus?! Isn't this great?! If I had known it was this much fun— (Doofenshmirtz smashes into a yacht.) Hey, this is one of those fancy sailing yachts!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (praying) Please I wanna live I wanna live I wanna live! (lands on something. Zoom out to reveal it's the blimp.) What? I'm alive! Woohoo! (Part of the plane lands on him.) Ow! (More parts of the plane fall on him. Followed by a nail, which deflates the blimp) Curse you, Perry the Platypus, even though you weren't involved in this scheme, whatsoever!!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, you are too late! (He pulls a lever, activating the Magnetism Magnifinator) Quake in your boots and watch helplessly as the unimaginable electromagnetic forces, pull the eastern seaboard, thereby reversing rotation of the--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no! I just had the place cleaned. Curse you, Perry the Platypus and your destructive, fruit-loving simian friend who doesn't know how to use the door! Curse him, too!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (grunts) Ooh, I hate you, you little green -- (the arms punch him and disappear, he punches himself) Wait a minute, wait a minute, wait a minute. I don't have to do this anymore. (at Perry) Well, we still have you surrounded, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I heard it ring the first time, so I was standing right by the phone. Oh, by the way, could you pick up some blueprints for me on your way over? Thank you, sweetie.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. Come on in, take a seat. I'm just looking for the right… Channel!! (laughs; He pushed a button on his remote and the chair's arms trap Perry.) Now that you're nice and comfy, I can prattle on about my improbable pet peeve.

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's not a cucumber, Pnorm. I'm sorry about that, Sweary, he has problems identifying objects. Pnorm, that's a swan, and we're going to tie him to the railroad tracks.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've attached rockets to the lighthouse, so when I push this button, it will fly to the other side of town, the ships will follow, and then I can finally get some sleep!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Y'know, chasing's not much of an option with my pants full of pennies. (Cut to inside to reveal Doof's pants pretty much about to explode.) Ah, well, live and learn. (An inator beam fires, Perry uses a picture of Doof to deflect it and it fires at Doof. His clothes disappear, but his underpants and pennies don't.) 'Least you hit my clothes and not me. I wonder what happens if a person— (Another beam hits Doof.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no, no, oh, get back in there! Wait why isn't..? What? Perry the Platypus? I swear, of all the aquatic mammals I hang with, you are truly the most uncooperative! (As Doof is saying this the dang DVD just goes in and out and in and out because of Doof and Perry's insistent button pushing)

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I know! I'm just as surprised as you are! Put her there, Jameson! Psych! (Laughs) (Jumps a few times) At last! A whole new world of evil has opened up to me! You know what this calls for, don't you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I may be an evil scientist, but it doesn't take a degree purchased from the Internet with your ex-wife's money to know how special and important you are to me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, he's such a cute little kitty. That's right. That's right. He wuvs his tuna fish. Yes, you eat that and I'll be over here working on my latest project. (pushes a button; chuckles) I'm painting.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! It's a.... it's a man. It's a deformed, tiny...turquoise man. Vanessa, take some of your friends here, uh, uh, Ponytails, Spikey Head, Tweedle-Tie and go get Johnny.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Stymie meee! Foil meee! Hey, what about the fact that I held a petty grudge against an inferior mammal all these years, huh? (Perry glares, lowers his jetpack, and hides behind a dumpster. He flies past it on his hovercraft. Perry looks done with everything..and then DOOF JUMPSCARE.) Thwart me, Perry the Platypus. (Perry quickly flies away on his jetpack.; once again following the platypus) Aw, come on!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (looking like Teddy Roosevelt) Mm, guess the animal setting wasn't such a hot (Perry the Platypus (currently impersonating a gorilla) punches Doofenshmirtz) Ow! Wait. How did you punch me? The hologram was so much taller than you. (Perry picks him up) Ah! Ow! It defies logic.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heh, any day now. Hey, where are you going?! (Perry goes into the bathroom and slams the door.) Oh—Oh, I see. (The toilet is heard flushing) That's—That's the hot wings working there. Ha ha ha. (A knocking is heard. Pan left to reveal Perry outside the lair.) Hey, how did you—?! Oh, you got out through the—I—I see.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Even with musical accompaniment, you just don't get it. Ugh! I'munna have to spell it out for you: It's not my fault that you and Peter are having problems. It's yours!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He is! No, you've just got to see him in action. He-Here. I'll let him go. (Presses a button on a remote and the chair trap releases) Go ahead, (Puts the remote away in his coat) Perry the Platypus. Thwart my plans. Come on. (Crosses his arms) Let me have it! (Pause) Thwart away, big guy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Silence! Wrong! You're wrong! Do you know who that is? It's only Roger Doofenshmirtz, the mayor of Danville! So shut up! What do you know; you're only a crossing guard!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Careful. Careful. Everything depends on getting the mixture precise. (Becky drops the liquid into the beaker. Doof stirs it with a straw and drinks it.) Mmm. Excellent. Now that's how you make a Shirley Temple. Hey, Muscles, how's the antidote coming?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no! Oh no no no! (The inator hits Doof's good foot.) OW!!! NO!!! Oh, my good foot! My good foot! OW! Ow ow! My bad foot! Oh, my good foot again! Oh, no, my bad foot—Oh, this is really a vicious cycle!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (talking to Vanessa on the phone) So you just took it from the little girl and left her there crying? Wow, that is evil! Honey, I am so proud of you! It felt good didn't it? Yeah, we can build on this. (The last line of **Not So Bad A Dad** is reprised as episode ends.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now where's the best view? Grassy knoll? Book depository? Ooh, a jungle gym! I don't know why they call it a "jungle gym". It's not very jungly, but I do love a slide!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, now to relax and keep my heart rate slow and steady, you know, 'cause too much excitement would cause my heart to beat too fast and short out the Bum-Bum-inator.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's not a doll, it's a stand-in. Pretendy the Practice-pus, see? I wonder if Perry the Platypus practices with a fake me? It would be nice to know he cares enough...(tennis ball eye falls off the stand-in)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, here's the odds. Save the day: 55%. Destroy the universe as we know it: 45%. But do nothing at all: a hundred percent chance of the end of time. So whadaya say?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, but you are too late. .... (Perry attenpts to turn it off but Doof smacks his hand away) Wait! Wait, don't touch that! .... Stop it! Stop it! (Perry tickles Doofenshmirtz) Stop it, I told you! Stop it! I said, keep your hands off of that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sorry, sweetie, but apparently, there's a lot of stuff I have to attend to. Look on the bright side, you can brag about your dad to all your friends until I get back.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for coming along, Perry the Platypus. You know, having you around just makes me feel, you know, safer. In this circumstance, Back home is exactly the opposite.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah. If anyone happens to see a canyon that looks sorta grandish, just speak up. Or maybe not speak up, maybe meow up, or squawk, er, whatever it is that you do, up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Listen, before I rebuild the machine, I've got some errands to run. You guys should come with. (Red Skull hisses) Is your head gonna burst into flames or am I thinking of somebody else?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, I-I-I-I can't stay anyway. As-As we speak, my nemesis is upstairs trying to work free from a trap that... So even if...if you wanted me to stay, I, uh... (she shuts the door on him) Bye.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs evilly) I've got you now, Perry the Platypus! This is the most sophisticated trap I have ever invented. (Chamber shows Agent P trapped) In fact, it's so escape-proof that- that I couldn't get that guy out.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sell a state area? That just leaves a Bi-State Area! I'm not taking over some lousy Bi-State Area! Oh! (to Emissary 2) Please don't cancel the contract! You're making a big mistake!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What, that? Oh, that's my first Inator. Good story. I'll tell you all about it tomorrow. Well, I should probably get back to my latest evil scheme! (Slams door with a foot) So long...sucker!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold that thought, sweetie. I've really gotta go and improve Perry the Platypus's trap. (starts walking away) B-R-B! (stretches back) That's uh, that's "be right back". It's hip today to talk in acronyms. (walks away again)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) Today just isn't my day. It's Father's Day. It's the hardest of the greeting card company holidays for me. My issues with Father's Day began back when I was a child.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, here we go! The energy ball is growing and... (He presses the button and the ball drops onto the platform.) Ah. Alright, time for the unstuckinator. (A giant boot crushes the inator. We pan down all the floors of the building as the energy ball goes through every one of them.) You know, in hindsight, I probably shoulda done this in the basement.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, hello! Anyone there? Marco! Y-you're supposed to say Polo! There better be a satisfying explanation for this when it's over or I'm gonna be merciless on my blog!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Don't open the Metropolitan Oval Aquatic Trench! (moat opens up) No, no, no, no, no, no! Hey, look! It spells "MOAT". I never noticed that before. Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, you know what they say. Any landing where you don't get stabbed with a fork is a good one. And I didn't get stabbed with a fork. Any of you guys? Hello? Harry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Coughs) Not one word, Perry the Platypus. You have to at least give me a chance to do my thing, okay? Good. Okay, here we go. Where is it? Here we go. (Deploys the trap on the other side of the room, nowhere near Perry) There. I trapped you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm so sorry, Perry the Platypus. I would never have brought you here if I'd known about the whole death by hippos deal. That is... That is not my style. That is...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I gotta tell ya, there's a lot of risk involved, but we've discussed it over, like, three loops already, and I think this is our only option. Are you with me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Uh, ha-ha, now I'm very embarrassed about all that "coochie-coochie-coo" stuff. Wait, wait. Where are you going? Bring back my Misbehave-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know that's funny, you know, even while I was attacking you, I was thinking; Why did he tie himself up in a dark closet with us? Wh-what kind of a plan is that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, not so tough without your mace. (Perry glares at him) Now, I have the upper hand. (Perry takes off the helmet) Prepare to meet your doo- (He holds up the shield after Perry throws his helmet at him.) You throw your helmet at me? That's so lame, Perry the... (Perry starts throwing helmets at him.) Ow! Ow! Ow! Ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Shoo, shoo! Go find your own inator to put your gross pigeon feet on! (walking away) Have you seen pigeon feet? Well, don't start now, trust me. You can't unsee them. (sing-songy) Disgusting.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But I'm getting way ahead of myself. I have to tell you about yesterday for any of this to make any sense! It all started with an establishing shot of my building.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoops. One pizza delivery boy, comin' up! I don't know who that was for. It was just such a good line. It would've been a shame to hold it back. It's uh, oh hush.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, what's the point? I'm just going to sit here in the dark and rethink my life. (He flicks the "light switch" off and the Gigantinator reactivates.) Whoops, heh-heh. Wrong switcher. Y'know, I—I can see how that would be confusing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, man; you know, I built a Move-A-Bunch-Of-Inators-inator at one point. This would have been a really good time to use it. I don't know how that slipped my min-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm not sure I can handle a party of this magnitude! (At Perry) Either way, we've got enough power for the inator now, Perry the Butler, you-you'd better tend to the guests.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I've come up with a whole slew of products and services that I can advertise and my Pop-up-inator will (Snaps fingers) put pop-up ads virtually everywhere! I'll make millions!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, let's see, the Declaration of Independence, the Magna Carta, the Deed to the Tri-State Are—I mean the Mayflower Compact? Ha ha! (goes in the elevator with the "Mayflower Compact" and disappears) Goodbye, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback) Norm, don't just stand there! Do something about this bat! (The radio is thrown, and misses.) Really? That's your solution? Throw a radio at it? Whoa whoa whoa! (cut to Norm about to throw a crowbar) Don't throw that! That's imitatable.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A good guy? Me? I can be... Well, I guess I could. I-I could be a do-gooder, doing good, just for the sake of... doing good, or, er, what exactly do good guys do?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, coochie-coochie. You are my little coochie-coochie. You are my ticket into the Danville Dog Show, and together, we will make them pay for all I have suffered.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, come on! Do I get to land one or not? (Perry hits him in the face with a pillow.) I take that as a no? (Perry flings Doof and he hits a wall. Doof spits out some feathers.) Talk about "down in the mouth". Get it? It's, uh... Ah, whatever. Meet my friends, (holds up couch cushions) Poly and Ester! (He throws "Ester" over at Perry.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: W-Where did he go? He was standing right there about to foil my evil plans and now I'm...and now I'm totally free to go forward with my heinous project! Woo-hoo!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woo-hoo! Yeah! Woo-hoo! Woo! Woooo! I did it! I saved you guys and now we're safe! (some alligators land in their raft) Except for the fact that it's, you know, raining alligators. And secret lairs.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Help, Perry the Platypus, help! (The plants squeeze Perry out of his trap) Yes, yes, Perry, you got it! That's it, you're free now, now come over here and... wait! Where are you going? Perry the Platyp... (Doofenshmirtz gets slapped by a vine)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Here they come, Perry the Platypus. Here they come, all of my minions. (He laughs) (A bar of soap and a toothbrush come to his side) I c– I– I could've sworn I hit more threatening stuff than this. Really, really pathetic.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Well, maybe if you had, you'd have done better. Since you have neglected to take over YOUR Tri-State Area, I think I'll go over there and give it a shot myself.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I love it when a song ends right as you reach your destination! Not to mention the free cans of almond brittle that I got during the chorus. (Cut to inside City Hall.) Well, hello, Roger.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, do...do I know you? (Monogram puts two fingers on his nose where his mustache once was.) Major Monogram? Francis, what happened to you? Look...y-y-y-you're a washed-up mess! This whole weather thing is your fault, you know!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sniffing) Well, doesn't smell any different. I wonder what went wrong. (Perry kicks Doofenshmitz who lands on the table carrying the dirty diaper smell beaker, which he catches) Oh, here's my stinky poo-poo stuff! I thought I put this in the Smellinator. (Perry kicks him again, throwing the formula away) **NOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!** (Perry puts all the fish agents in a plastic bag and makes his escape)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! (stammering) Wow, I look just like my grandfather, Jose Doofenshmirtz. I mentioned him before. It's... it's a weird story. I'll tell you later. You know, after I shave.

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (via answering machine recording) Hello! You've reached Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz. I'm not here right now, or am I? Muhehehehehe. Oh! And if you're calling about the piano it's already been sold.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, Norm, it occurs to me that though I've never had a son, there is someone I can always count on to be there. Someone I've begun to think of as family.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Fine. Let's see... this is about a quarter cup... and there's two cups in a pint... that would make... I'll have nine-hundred ninety nine more of these please.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, I'd do anything for you, pumpkin pants! After we dismantle this thing, I don't know what I'm gonna do with myself. I've got no experience being a good guy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Man, it's dark down here. (hits over something) Agh! Uhhh! Turn on the light, Heinz, you're not a bat. (turns on the light) Hey! It's Norm's old head, the original prototype! I wonder if it still works.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, the Least-Likely-inator! All I have to do is zap someone with this baby and they can't help but do the least likely thing to their nature. (activates the Least-Likely-inator and a red ray comes out of it) Ooh, touchy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh? You see? You see how dangerous it is out here? You got to help me over protect my daughter. Please? Please? Please? Oh great! I know just what you can do!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I did it! (Cut to Perry, who looks up at the coffee cup. He continues offscreen) And now that my super dad status is intact, it's time to take care of business! (Perry hops over to the table and grabs the cup.) And by business, (Perry takes the lid off the cup) I mean evil. (Perry pours the coffee on the creamer block, melting it.) It's time to set my sights on City H -- (Perry kicks him, he slides down the inator.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (scratching his head) I-I-I don't know what just happened, but I like it. Now, with you safely inside the cage, (pushes a button on a remote) I can unveil my new device of doom. (the inator rises from the floor) Behold, the Metal-Destructinator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I wouldn't want to be getting one of those rejuvenating sea salt scrubs right now. The stinging would be unbearable! I-It just takes a little while to warm up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) ...and I've been getting royalty checks. The extra money is fine and all, but it really chafes my hide (shot of Doofenshmirtz observing the equipment being used) that something I invented is being used for good! Ughh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The Tilt-inator is set with an automatic timer, once it's activated, even I can't stop it. All that's left to do is open the bay doors, (Doof sighs) this may take awhile.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm still working on a real evil application for this, but, for now, I'll settle for serving people live fish without consent. That's a little evil. Toodles!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) We preempt your normal programming with the first annual Telethon of Evil! (cut to studio) And now live, because it's evil spelled backwards, your host, Heinz Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: This is a message for other dimension Perry the Platypus. If you turn yourself in, I promise not to hurt your little friends. If you don't, all bets are off.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's see what embarrassing truths that woman who's holding that unusually large hand mirror has to say. (He fires, but the rays bounces back and hits Doofenshmirtz) Secretly I'm very lonely. Where did that come from?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Good boy! I love this new guard dog software. It's about time, Perry the Platypus. I was beginning to think you'd found another evil scientist to fight. Oop!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh, you know, I don't have the energy for this. It's still early, do you wanna go grab some lunch? Come on. I skipped breakfast this morning. (he and Perry walk out) You like eggs?

Name: Bad Future Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Quiet! I need to address the populous. Attention, underlings! People often ask me: "Doof, how does it feel to wield such absolute power?" Well I'll tell ya.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Where'd you get that? Could I... Could I have some? (pauses) Wha-Wha-What, the line? (erases part of the line) Oh, no look, I was just kidding about- Look! Look! Look! I-It's not a real line.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Silence! Are you suggesting that I attempted to gather the leaders of the Tri-State Area but the best I could do was a crossing guard and my building super?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow. But it's too late! While I was napping, enough grease dripped off my face to fill the Junk Food-inator. Nothing can stop me now! Hoo, I gotta sit down.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Until tonight! (He laughs) And when the sun rises in one hour; see, right over there; Then everyone in the Tri-State Area will see my enormous hand shadows on the moon!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, okay. My name is Heinz Doofenshmirtz. (pauses) Tadaa! I'm sorry, I don't know have the whole… Where are those lights coming from, by the way, when you do that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...is your allure. Yeah, yeah, I know. So-So do you tell Peter the Panda your plans before or after you trap him? I just...I'm always interested in process.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait! I can't- I can't fight you when you're dressed as a girl. It's so...como se dice... awkward. Look! Shoes on sale! (Perry/Candace looks where Doofenshmirtz points. He tries to run for it during his/her momentary distraction, but he/she takes out an MP3 player out of the purse and throws it at him, rendering him trapped in the now comically long wire.) Curse you, Perry the teenager!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's enough looking! I'd love to debate you, but I have some pressing business to take care of, like remaking the Tri-State Area in my own, twisted image! (Laughs maniacally)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ew, gross! I smell like...salad. (Mumbling; slips on vinegar; lands in the volcano, which then "erupts") Say goodbye to this pair of lederhosen. Hey, I'm unhurt! Yes, I am invincible! Wait, wait, wait, wait! Where are we going?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, I don't want your baby. (at Perry) You see, Perry the Platypus, the unfair advantage good-looking people have? (becomes conceited) Heeeey?! (at a man) If I ran for Mayor, would you vote for me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, don't be silly, Francis. I'm also here for a classy dinner with my daughter and her new boyf— (recognizes Monty) Wait a second! (to Vanessa) "Nostril Boy"?! Is he your new boyfriend?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, yes, I'd be obnoxious if I wasn't so charming. Anyway, I have one more inator to complete and I've got to do it fast, so I could really use your help.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now let's see. Take over the Tri-State Area speech, and water, in case I get parched during my maniacal rant. Hee hee. Loud-inator. (He gets up on a literal soap box and turns on his loud-inator.) Check, one, two, three.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, hold the phone. I-I could be useful. What if you need a kidney? Or-Or a stand-in for boring functions you have to attend, or-or another kidney?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I represent the League Of Villainous Evildoers Maniacally United For Frightening Investments- (Doof's light goes out) Ah! Philistine! That-That was a perfectly good Charleston!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hi, Francis, it's your old friend, Heinz Doofenshmirtz, calling to gloat about my brilliant unguessable scheme to scientifically turn a cloud into a storm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, this may not be the best time to tell you, but I actually flunked jungle gym in grade school. I-I just couldn't get the hang of all the climbing and...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, found it! Okay, I just have to take three steps back. One..two.. (trips backwards and falls off the building as the inator activates) OWWWWWWWWWWWWW! WHY DO I KEEP STACKING BUCKETS?!?! CURSE YOU, PERRY THE PLATYPUS!!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'll be honest, I didn't understand anything you said. But look at us. Who are we to stand in the way of young love? (to Francis) I'm sorry for being a giant man-baby.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But never again! Behold! (Removes tarp) The world's largest baking soda volcano! I mean, it-it's got to be the biggest one here, right? It's gonna win. (Pauses) I feel confident.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! Mr. Fluffy Pants! (he grabs the cat just in the nick of time) Wait! Wait, wait, wait! Oh, that was close, Mr. Fluffy Pants. You almost... (screaming) You know, I think you're more trouble than you're worth.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, I have the power to bla, bla, bla, supernatural, bla, bla, et cetera, et cetera. But first I'm going to New York; we'd kill on Broadway! (There is a loud explosion in the background) What the...!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Fine, fine. You have somewhere more important to be. But don't you want to know (Perry jets away) why I want to destroy the adult diaper factory? It's a terrific backstory!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, take that! And that! (gets head stuck in control board) Oh! Oh, man, that's disgusting! Still, it can't be the first time someone's got their head stuck in a turkey.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, I-I have traps, but th-they weren't necessarily for you, y'know, specifically, but... Look, enough of your excuses! I challenge you to a dough duel!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh! Don't you guys see what's going on out there? Game over! Your plan failed! There's no figgy pudding! There's no Christmas! You can all just go home!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait wait, why is this turned on? Shoo! Shoo, bird, shoo! (The pigeon flies away.) Huh. I hope my Uncooperate-inator didn't cause any problems in that little building over there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, the mime-inator! With this baby, I'm going to trap every mime in the Tri-State Area in their very own invisible box! I know, huh? Fun with irony!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Narrating) I was out picking up a few things, and as I was walking out of the store, I tripped on something. As I fell, out of nowhere this kitten landed in my bag!

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: Oh, look! A little arm that can move around on its own, (the arm frees Perry) It's-It's got its own volition. I did not expect that. Wait, you dummkopf! Look what you've done! (the arm attacks him)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Boy, it's just gorgeous out, huh? A perfect day for ruining a City Hall lobby art dedication. You know, if-if you're into that kind of thing. Which I am!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (activating the inator) Hey, Perry the Platypus, did you know that the plural of "sheep" is also "sheep"? Isn't that boring? What about "sheeps", or "sheepuses", or "sheeples"?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, Perry the Platypus, why don't you say hello to my new pet crocodiles? Susan and Susan. I named them after each other. Now, prepare to be delicious!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, your hat has a pressure release valve? Wow, so that's what the inside of a platypus smells like? Could've gone my whole life without knowing that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Jekyll Doofenshmirtz puts the screw on a machine) (Narrating) He was obsessed with being (Jekyll Doofenshmirtz screws the screw into place) the most evil scientist of his time. Back then, to be considered truly evil, you actually had to have an angry mob after you.

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, that is why I chose Japan over Paris at the last moment! That makes perfect sense. There is no other ulterior motive behind it all, so, you know...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Back when I was just a little schtumpel, my father came home with a brand-new spitzenhound puppy that he won in a game of Poke the Goozim With a Stick.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: People of the Tri-State Area, you may begin quaking in fear at your earliest possible convenience- (Doofenshmirtz's light goes out) Wait, really? Were-Were you even watching that move?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Asking for a shoe in size ten, maniacally. Going to the bathroom, maniacally. That was... That was a failure of epic proportions. You don't wanna know.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well yeah, of course. But come on, if I knew he had a nemesis. I-I would never want to be the other evil scientist. (sees Professor Mystery's -inator) Ooh! An inator! So what does it do?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Unfortunately, the car had one major design flaw: The back bumper was a surplus dynamite plunger and the gas tank sat directly under the driver's seat.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, little Miss Osbourne, (coming back onstage with an inator helmet on his head and a remote) prepare to say hello to your doom (Agent P appears on one of the rafters above the soundstage.) at the hands of—or, I guess in this case, in the head of—the man who is not your co-host! (Perry holds onto a rope with one hand and holds a mirror in the other.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The letters of "A Sal Tuscany Christmas" spell "Santa Claus" with an embarrassing leftover "Y". Let me see that picture. (He sees the CD cover; Sal Tuscany is revealed to have his facial hair superimposed over a familiar white beard.) Sal Tuscany is Santa Claus?!?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, Roger, prepare to suffer the bad luck of the dra— (Roger gets up from his desk) Hey, hey, hey! Hey, wait! Wait a minute! You're s'posed to stay still for a good inatoring!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Lying on the ground) Wait, wait. I-I was just about to break out the bubble machine! (Perry flies out of the building on his hang glider with Carl hanging from his feet as Doofenshmirtz yells after them.) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! And you, too, large squirrel man creature hybrid thing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, if I had a nickel for every time I was doomed by a puppet, I'd have two nickels, which isn't a lot, but it's weird that it happened twice, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (emerging from the coat room) Ha-HA! You'll never get out of that straitjacket. Why would anyone wear that to a New Year's Eve party? I guess maybe if you were a magician, maybe...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah. I'd say that's probably the first time anyone has described my being abandoned by my parents and raised by Central American wildcats as "lucky".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, Francis? I've been playing this whole time. Are you gonna step up or do you wanna just let me know what shaving cream works best with your skin? (laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, down on all fours! I know that fighting technique. (gets down on all fours) It's Singapore Crab! I learned it in Hoboken. (moves back and forth; stands up; imitates a crab) Oh, yeah, I'm gonna side walk all over you, baby.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on, Balloony. This is us. I'm just so glad to have you back. But watch yourself, Perry the Platypus! I got maniacal fighting skills now! You saw!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
