Dialog: (reading) "To the most evil dad in the whole world, Happy Father's Day. Love, Vanessa." Aw, a gift basket of switches and self-destruct buttons. (pushes a self-destruct button) That's my girl! (smiles)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Stop! My brothers! And...others. Uh, gaze at last, upon my appropriately Mongolian military regalia and know that you must now obey my every command!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, I never really know where these beams go, but I... I like to think it's a Mysterious Force for evil doing something bad to someone somewhere.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Seriously, leave my lunch alone! Anyway, after Professor Banister gets the moose, it's going to ruin Canada Day, or you know, whatever. Crazy, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It is working! (laughs) It is functioning properly! (Perry chatters, getting his attention; he gasps) Perry the Platypus? You defeated my bubble of pure evil? Ooh! (he traps himself and Perry in a bubble and land in the river just as the dam falls apart) Oh, no! What? (Perry uses Doofenshmirtz's nose to pop the bubble and escapes) Is my nose really that pointy?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, well, I made one, and now you're in an invisible cage. And so you don't get bored, I put in an invisible tin cup in there for you to play with.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: What? You're blaming me? I-I-I've been locked up in here with Choo-Choo. Isn't that right, Choo-Choo? Yes. Yes, it is. See? H-He'll provide an alibi.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Nice goin', Norm! (Cut to backstage where Doof is having a talking-to to Norm.) And the next time someone asks for volunteers to host the L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. Service Awards, say your own name, Mr. Blabbermouth!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's see if I can rub this guy the wrong way. (He laughs as he rams a car.) Nice bumpin' into ya! Maybe it's time to use a little elbow grease. (He pushes a button and some grease spews out of the back of his car causing the car to slide right out of the race.) Alright, smoke 'em if you got 'em! (Black smoke spews out of the exhaust pipe.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hm. Wait! That's it! Okay. Split up and start dancing like you've never danced before! Whoever gets on camera first can deliver our message of evil!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, now, mine are bacon, apparently. (shakes his hands) Look, I'm shakin' bacon! You like that? It's a callback to something I didn't even hear! In your face, logic!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I bet you're wondering where my Inator is, right? C'mon, guess? Guess, no? No? You're not gonna play-A-alright alright fine. Don't play. It's Norm!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woohoo! With all the cash I'm raking in, I'll be able to take over the Tri-State Area in no time! (A woman gives him a book, which he signs.) Thank you very much. Nice doin' business with ya.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no. Wait. It'll be all right. (he turns over the cushion) I-I was planning on replacing this old couch anyway. Now come on, let's light this pop stand, or however it goes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Consider yourself trapped. Allow me to explain my diabolical plan. You see, my brother, Roger, the mayor, is hosting a beauty contest that will...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I did it! I...Not strictly according to plan, but I...Still, I have disrupted the ceremony. WOOT! WOOT! See? Everything works with the woot-woots.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, Perry the Platypus, I see someone. You'll understand the power of my sad eyes when you see them in action. You ready? Watch this. Excuse me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on the flying platform) Be careful Perry the Platypus, you're awfully close to the edge. Oh! Let me help you back. (laughs as Perry is sent from one side of the platform to the other) Oh. Oh I can't quite- Whoops! I'm just messing with ya.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Drury Lane. Why would anyone buy a house on Drury Lane? It just sounds so, it sounds dreary, even though it's not actually "Dreary", it's "Drury".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! Trapped ya! You'll fall for anything, Perry the Platypus! (mockingly) "It's gonna blow!" (normal voice) As if-As if I would know ahead of time when something's going to—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? A bathroom break? Next time go before you come… (While he's talking, the camera reveals that Perry's in the bathroom. After smiling mischievously, he leaves it carrying the now filled spray bottle.) Okay, how about some macaroni salad? (Perry holds up a spray bottle) Antacid? The only effective defense against deli foods. (grunts as Perry tackles him in the stomach)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? Some kiddie TV show? Oh, the signal must have gotten switched. (Presses buttons) Urgh! Oh, now I've lost the picture entirely. (Pause) Hm. I hope it doesn't go rogue.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I've had time to think it over and we need to put the world back. I, for one, do not want to live in a perpetual winter! (pushes Rodney) Scoot over, Rodney.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Drusselstein! This way, Perry the Platypus. (Doof and Perry get up and the cat meows. Cut to outside Ye Olde Pawn Shoppe.) Okay, so the gnome tracker located my father's long lost lawn gnome at this location. (He opens the door and gasps.) There it is! (He picks up a lawn gnome, but it talks.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You're through, Perry the Platypus. Through! Now it is time for Platypus Flambé! (Laughs maniacally; To Vanessa) Vanessa, did you bring the little wooden head the termites made?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (looking at a book) This is all wrong! Look, it says here that the Humiliating Dance of Contrition is now 85% less humiliating! H-How would they even calculate that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no! Wait, wait, wait, wait! He's just about to do something. Wait for it! (Perry chatters) Hmm. I guess it's just a platypus. I could have sworn that was him.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I know you've heard that one before, but...twice actually...but I really think that this is where my relationship with my father went awry.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Once I zap Roger, nobody will recognize him and his unveiling will be a failing! Y'know, I'm... I'm gonna switch it back. This is too disturbing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, what are you doing here? Besides getting trapped! (laughs) You've been double-trapped by Dr. D. Squared. Yeah, that's still not right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...and once again, just as I was about to take over the Tri-State Area, Perry the Platypus hits the self-destruct button, foiling my evil scheme.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (The elevator goes up.) Well, that doesn't really make a lot of sense. (The elevator reaches the top floor, which is just a view.) Why did she make us come all the way up here if the clue is down— (The elevator drops like the Tower of Terror ride and drops back into the moat. A hippopotamus rises from the moat.) Wait a second! (Approaching the hippo, which has another clue in its mouth.) Gimme that thing!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I might have a little bit of a pro— (falls down and ends up in the water. He gets on the raft but is surrounded by alligators.) Get back, you, before I get all Creole chef on you! (to the trainees) Come on, you guys! Jump! I gotcha! I gotcha! I got— (the trainees jump into the raft)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you're not gonna need friends. You're gonna be on top of the heap! (Sighs) It's lonely at the top, but, you know, it's the top, so it dulls the ache. (He walks away. Buford looks surprised)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, I'm—Yes, I am! I am a doctor! Thank you. Thank you. A lot of people just stampede straight to "pharmacist" for some reason. I don't know why.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in a supermarket checkout lane, loading his presents onto the counter) Whew! Hey, what's with the total lack of Christmas decorations this year? A-Are you guys just being lazy or what? (reaches to pick up his presents, but is hit by the Transport-inator's beam) Wait, wha-, wait, my packages! (Doofenshmirtz disappears from the checkout counter)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, it, uh... It could've been worse. Uh, don't..don't all thank me at once. Knowing my talent has served my fellow agents is thanks enough.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a minute! Who's that boy you're with? He looks vaguely familiar. (Perry pushes a button on the gas tank) Say, isn't that— (The tank explodes sending Doofenshmirtz into orbit) AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!! (a man passes by him) Uncle Simpkin? He's looking well.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pauses broadcast) Wait, w-w-what's going on here? Is it Christmas already? What happened to fall? I'm totally unprepared. I-I got to get my yuletide on, and fast!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What, what is that all about? I mean he's using a typewriter. When was the last time you saw someone using a typewriter? Wha-What is this, 1987?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hate working out, but also hate paying for it? Well, come on down to Doofnasium, where I will personally motivate you to pump out iron for free!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh! Take that! And that! (Gasps) Perry the Platypus! I, uh, I uh, uh... There's no one else here. I mean, w-what are you doing here, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But Vanessa, what if there were a blizzard or an earthquake and -- and you with no one to take care of you, not even kindly ocelots, like I had.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no! (Laughs) Uh, that would be me. I'm Strudelcutie4427. Nice to meet you. Uh, this is my pet platypus. He was just going outside for a nightly walk.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, good grief!! It doesn't matter what we're called. What's important is that we get our evil message out to the people of the Tri-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow. That is scary. I tried that robot thing once, too. I hid the self-destruct button on the bottoms of their feet, so noone could reach them.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. Just in time. (pulls cart) Our flight is about to leave. Behold, the Stain-inator! What's it for, you ask? I'll tell you on the way.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Norm) Okay, see that cute popcorn machine over there? You just gotta walk up to her and say something smooth. Now, do you remember your opening line?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, if we're enemies again, does that mean… (Perry drops him) Aaaah! Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (tumbles before finally landing on a throw pillow) Oh, now see there, a throw pillow. You, you guys do it right!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a minute. Disqualified? OHHH! It can't possibly be that bad, let me try it. (eats meatloaf and moans) Yes, someone's gonna have to...call the...paramedics, I think.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great. Now I have to scour this whole place and find the Pizzazzium and probably have to wrench it out of the hands of some random shopper.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hello, Perry the Platypus. Could you be a sport and shut the door? It gets really drafty in here. Give it a good slam. Sometimes it sticks.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So if you'll excuse me, I have to get back to my search for Doreen. Maybe I'll get lucky and find the Declutter-inator, too. (Yelling back into the clutter) Hey Doreen? Marco!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaaahhh! (Perry loosens the tape's film and successfully lands) Aaaaaaaahhhhh!!! (Lands on a soft mattress; Below...) Whew! What an unbelievable stroke of luck! (The mattress folds in half) Oof! I'm okay! I'm still better than the... (gets stepped over by the robot) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Turns to Perry) In all fairness, Perry the Platypus, there was nothing in his profile about, you know, naming his boomerangs. Even I find that a little creepy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wa-wa-wa-wait! What about the neighbors? (exits) They're really crazy. (Comes back in jumping around with his pants on his head.) Look, I live next door and I've got pants on my head! And, uh, (takes out a comb and puts it under his nose like a mustache) I'm Italian. See?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't worry, guys, we'll- we'll get this all straightened out. Va- Vanessa! Vanessa... (the guards drag him away) No no, you can't take me, I don't have anyone to curse!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (muffled) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (at a coconut and a pelican) Listen up, both of you. Let's get one thing straight. I am supreme ruler of this place and don't you forget it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, how about this one? (He pushes a button which frees himself.) Good. Okay, well, at least I can still go on with my plan. (He manipulates the propellers in a vertical position. He raises the Tri-State Area once again.) I should go pick up my dry cleaning before it gets too...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh! It wasn't even set in reverse. I don't think it hit anything, y'know, disturbing. But... Oh, look! There it is, Perry the Platypus. Look!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I don't even remember what this does. (He pushes a button on the Inator, and a green beam shoots out of it) Oh, that's right, it just shoots a beam into space. No wonder I lost to a baking soda volcano.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) So, through the use of pseudo-technology, I created this elixir, that, when sprayed on an individual, actually transforms them into a warthog.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: After putting all the final touches on my All-Purpose-inator, I took a step back to admire my handiwork. Victory was finally within my grasp.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alllmost ready, Perry the Platypus, just a few more adjustments. I'm putting an extra ratty setting on the Underwear-inator. So embarrassing! (Perry takes a contact lens out of his eye, holds it up to the light and proceeds to cut through the net)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, where'd you go? (Camera pans to Agent R, who's eating from the trash) Oh, no! You're getting coffee grounds everywhere! Oh! This is so much smoother with Perry the Platypus. I'm just saying.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You think you've beaten me, but you haven't, because I can turn the Invis-inator into a Disintegrator, with just the simple (Pushes a button. The ray prepares to fire) push of a button!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sorry for the lack of inflight meal or entertainment, Perry the Platypus, but one cannon can only go so far, so I set up a worldwide network.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait. You're not trying to hack into the ray-gun system, are you? Wait, what am I worried about? You'll never guess my super-secret password.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You don't communicate, you know that? Y-You don't share. I-I know nothing about your private life. Perry closed off...... Closed, that's you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Depressed) Oh, Dr. Gevaarlijk, today was supposed to be the day that I impressed you (Walks away) with the enormity of my evil schemes and finally earn your respect.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, what the heck. Before we start, there's a whole buffet set up here. Please partake, I was expecting someone who seems to be running late.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: As soon as I get this honey off of me, I- (Candace's hair hits Doofenshmirtz, sending him screaming off of the platform and onto the pole where Candace once was.) Is this hair? (Perry is still on the platform and manages to disable the Very Bad-inator. He escapes on his glider.) Oh, no! Now I'll never know what the Bad-inator does! Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Curse you, Perry the Plat- Oof. Bleah. (Cut to inside where he's tied up and mops are shot into his mouth by the automatic tennis ball launcher.) Curse you, Perry the Plat- Oof. Bleah. Curse you, Perry the - Bleah. Why did I buy so many mops? Oof.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I hope you're ready for the big show, Perry the Platypus! [plugs the blue plug with the green wire) Because Evil Incorporated is on the air!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I suppose you're wondering why I'm wearing lederhosen. (Pauses; Perry glares at him) What? I've the legs for it! (Stretches right leg on dashboard) Eh? Eh? Eh? (Lowers right leg) Anyway, it will all become clear soon enough!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no! Oh no no! Not again!!! (bang!) Ow, my head! (bang!) Ow, my head again! (bang!) Ow! Now I forgot math! (bang!) Ow! There goes social studies! (bang!) Oh, good, they're back! (Doofenshmirtz's head crashes into the giant bolt revealing the cogs, which loosen and cause Foamtown to roll away.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) What's this? A Sal Tuscany Christmas... Score! What a perfect way to enjoy the last several hours before Christmas officially doesn't come.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I bring to you... Doofania! Where there will be no brothers trying to make me look bad. No. I will be the ruler of my very own evil empire!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, stay with me. It makes sense. Back in Drusselstein, the kids would all go to the local oil park, like a water park, but slipperier.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (groans) Oh, I forgot to hit the reverse switch, so it just made me even smaller. (to the mantises) Wait, hold on. Shouldn't we at least try couples counseling first?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa! Yes, yes, I know, you, you'd like to move in with your mother and you want to intern at OWCA and my being evil creates a conflict.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) You're not very good at thwarting. I...I should hook you up with my nemesis Perry the Platypus for some pointers. It's an art form for him.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's start with genetics, the building blocks of life. Your genes determine what you will be. A...A turtle or a bird or... For instance... (plucks a hair off of Johnny)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What is that ringing so- is that Eb above high C? Oh, for crying out loud, Perry the Platypus, really? Really? You're thwarting the ill...? (Begins hacking up a lung)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, well, I might have pressed it by mistake. But at least I didn't push the release button I installed inside Perry the Platypus's cage! (Perry presses the release button with his foot and escapes his trap)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, No, No! I've been good! Don't put me in your gundersack! Not the gundersack! Ahhhhhhhhh! The Kinderlumper! (Doofenshmirtz sits up in bed, breathing heavily, then gasps.) That's it! Der Kinderlumper! (Doofenshmirtz chuckles evilly as he comes to a evil realization.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See? All you needed was a reboot. (Perry slams a platypus hat on Doof) …Wait! What is this? What happened to all the lights? Wait, it's coming loose. I think I can get it off.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (Agent P looks around, trying to find where the voice is coming from. He finally shrugs then leaves; deciding that the mission is over.; Instrumental version of Perry's theme) Wait, wait! Where are we going? Is that sea water I smell? I hope I'm not on a boat, (the delivery boat departs) 'cause I get sea sick.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, what a surprise. And by surprise, I mean not a surprise at all. Anyway, let me show you what I've been working on.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, hold your tiny horses! I just remembered. My inator had a reverse switch this whole time! I dunno what I was thinking.

Name: Doofenshmirtzs
Dialog: (Cheering)/Geronimo!/Whoopee!/Santa Claus!/Native American icon!/Hey, there's the mall!/Well, that was fun!/Ooh, what fun!/Oh, I landed in a puddle.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It takes a lot of power, so I can only fire it once, but don't worry. (Leans on his ray) I have it planned down to the last-- (The ray is pushed downward. It fires a laser and it hits a dam. The water starts flowing from the dam) (While looking through binoculars) Oops! (Chuckles) No more songs about dams?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Sighs wearily) Well, Planty the Potted Plant. You have proven yourself quite the adversary. Why don't we just...call this one a draw? (Plops himself against the door) I'm kind of pooped.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Did everyone take note of his reply? (walks behind the inator) Totally lackluster. But that's all gonna change. Okay, Billy, now hold still. (Fires the inator on Billy) Now whadaya see, Billy?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Woo! Oh, boy, that was great! Hey, I've got an idea, let's go get some ice cream and spoil our dinner! I mean, who's gonna tell us no huh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hello, Vanessa! Let me introduce Rodrigo to you. He's starting evil science school in the fall and I'm mentoring him. I'm in mid-ment.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Every day, when I go downstairs to get my mail, my neighbor, Tyler, is down there spoiling the ending of every show to my other neighbors.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) Are you sure we haven't met before? You look so familiar. Something about your platypus-like beak. Hmmm. Can't quite put my finger on it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very clever, Perry the Platypus, but let's see how you do against the hard stuff. Parmesan, give 'im a taste of your crystalline texture.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah. Listen, you're an actor, so act. If anyone slightly bumps into you, fake an injury. Do a, do a whole soliloquy, just sell it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Charlene Doofenshmirtz. She's my ex-wife. I-I guess you guys have never met. That kinda takes away the drama of the reveal. But it's her.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Pfft, don't worry about me making money, mister! I've-I've got a complicated plan. I—Like I'm gonna take advice from some guy in a diner. (Perry bounces in his high chair out of the diner.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, to recap, my entire fragile self-esteem is totally dependent on your performance today at the dog show, but, y-you know, no pressure.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I...I did it. I did it! Ha ha! Who's the loser now, huh?! L-O-S-E-R! Who's the loser?! You are! Let's boogie! That's right! Let's boogie!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? I'm just gonna assume it's you, 'cause I don't hear any talking. Anyway, I was wrong. Please come back and thwart me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it was just a simple Repulse-inator, y'know to, to make Roger ugly, but then, there was some sort of power surge and this happened!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't really remember much about it, I was pretty young at the time, but- ooh! Ooh-Ooh! (The tube connected to the helmet Doofenshmirtz is wearing begins to bubble) I can feel it tingling; something's coming out!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's the trap I was gonna use on you, but my evil license expired as we previously established, and I don't wanna pay all those fines.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Vanessa, it would be good for you to get in touch with your roots. Who knows? You might even come up with your own tragic backstory!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, you can keep the 401(k), but the daycare you're gonna have to pay for out of your own pockets! I-I-I've made enough concessions here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, the welds aren't really bonded on this machine, so, y'know, try not to move around too much in flight. Grand Canyon, here we come!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, ha ha ha! Laugh it up now! A-And when your friends ask what happened to Casual Fridays, you can tell them you opened your big mouth!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, what? You were coming here, anyway, and... (He accidentally steps on the button and water balloon is released from the rope holding it to the tower and flies up into the sky) Oh, and uh... As far as flinging that water balloon into orbit, hehheh... (puts his fingers on Major Monogram's mouth again) "I did that."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I never thought of it like that. We'll get started as soon as I pick up some fresh lab coats. These have got scorch marks all over them.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What?! But that's the opposite of what I— They're the good guys! I thought for sure now that I was Tri-State Governor that we'd be okay!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, note to self: Only use the Make-Bigger-inator outside. You weren't supposed to get that big, Perry the Platypus, only 20% bigger.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So just because I miss a few payments, you're selling my building? A-A-And where am I supposed to get that much money on short notice?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no, I'm just kiddin'! I'm kidding! Come on back! Hey, uh, guys, you, y-you forgot the cat. (to Karen) They forgot you. And you're the cat.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I could tell you, but that would be taking the easy way, and you know what they say about that. Ooh, look! Pizzazium Infinionite!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, come on in, come on in. Check the place out. I-I decorated it all myself. Well, mostly. Wait till you see this. Wait right there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And nice to see you, too! (to the class) Y'know, we knew each other long ago, but that's a story for another time. I'm Dr. Doofenshmirtz. (writing on the blackboard) D-O-O-F-E...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, it's mine. See, I told you I never lost it. It was in a box in my pantry labeled "VHS Tapes". Go figure. Anyway, you can have it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, that's unfortunate. (takes the dish off) Uh, hopefully, the DNA in the petri dish won't combine with... (Johnny starts growing a lizard tail) Oh! Oh! No, see, it's... It's happening already.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? You're just in time. (Pulls out a remote) Just in time to be trapped! (Presses the remote button. A crashing sound is heard. Perry looks around for the trap) Didn't Major Monogram tell you I was working on an invisible ray?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! It's almost full! Come on, people! Ha ha! I have the power! Time to fire the End-All-Be-All-inator! I almost have too much power!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen of the press, kindly put a cork in it. So you've probably figured out that the Earth has moved away from the sun.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, well, let's see. (Looks to Perry who rubs his belly) We could rub our stomachs (Perry opens his mouth and points to inside of it) and point to our mouths and later we could roll our eyes and put our head in our hands.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, w-what was that? (Perry jumps out of the scuba mask and the bars drop off.) Huh? You were trying to escape?! After I shared my wings with you! Well, granted,  I did trap you like a monkey— (Perry punches him.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? (Chuckles) Thank goodness, I-- I thought you were the guy with my hot wings. In two more minutes, my order will be free! Yes!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, Planty the Potted Plant, since you're just hanging around.... (chuckles) Let me demonstrate the brilliant evil-losity of my latest inven...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why is dating so difficult? I'm not finding any matches, even with my Swipe-inator going full— Oh, what! Oh, wait! I just got a match!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, I can't believe they built an airport in Drusselstein. They used to just kick us out mid-flight. I'll just hail a horse if I can—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know I've had it with you, Perry the Platypus. You never, never let me have the last -- (Perry pulls Doofenshmirtz's parachute, sending him flying off the plane) AAAAAAHHHHH CURSE YOU, PERRY THE PLATYPUS!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Enough of your blabbering on and on! My little nemesis is out there all alone. I-I can't believe it! Stop the bus! Stop the Bus! Stop-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ohh, did I say traveler's- Uhh, no, no... I do wanna spend time with you... l-look, look. I'll drop the water balloon right now and... (gets kicked by Perry)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, bummer. Anyway, as a musician, not as a co-host, mind you, I'd like to get in on this little songwriting thing you're about to do.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I see what you're doing. You're messing with my head. Trying to get into my mind. Walk around in there, rearrange the furniture...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm building a Re-Good-inator, solely from parts from this plane. Do you know how many evil scientists could actually accomplish this?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very effective, don't you think, Perry the Platypus? (Sips drink, then spits it out upon realizing Perry is here) Perry the Platypus?! (at some pigeons) Get him! Stop him! He's headed for that clearly marked exit!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's a good thing I had this old Cooler-Off-inator. All right, where'd that cloud go? Oh! There she is! (fires the inator) I'm gonna make it rain, baby!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, all I really want for Christmas is the ability to hate Christmas. Is that too much to ask? (knock on door) Hmm, were you expecting someone?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughing) Listen to those fools, as they worship their candy-colored race car man. How about a little demonstration of my deflationary prowess? (Fires laser)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Weaving from behind a giant pink kangaroo) Now you see me. Now you don't. Now you see me. Now you don't. Hehe. (Perry punches him, and Doofenshmirtz falls down the stairs, and slides across the ramp of the trap) Hey, whe-where'd ya' go? (Perry bounces up to the catches mitt holding the anvil) I've got you now Perry the Platypus. (Doofenshmirtz bounces up to get him, but smashes into the anvil, which then falls on him.) Ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, there they go with the whole "pharmacist" thing again! I-I should become one, that-that would show 'em! I'll become a pharmacist!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on CB radio) No, no! It's not Miss, it's... it's Misfortune. Like, like one word. It's like... It means bad luck. One word. So, uh, where are you?

Name: Jekyll Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While being slammed on the floor) Really, really, I don't have your nose! Wait wait. Time out. Allow me one little drink before we continue. I'm-I'm-I'm parched, okay?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! Isn't it great? It's like old times. I... Like I always say, "If you love something, set it free. If it comes back, trap it!". (laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey buddy, watch where you're... Say, you look fabulous. (a brief clip of **"Fabulous"** plays) Haven't I seen you somewhere before? (Perry chatters then flees the scene) No need to get huffy, you ran into me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, so now that we got the basics covered, we can get to the fun part. Let's start with trapping your nemesis. (Cut to Perry with a nametag lanyard on taking notes. He gets trapped by the lanyard.) Nametag, you're it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Finally, I am the Grand-Taker-Over-er! It's better than I've dreamed! Ironically, and... Oh, oh! I have a little hat and everything!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, "thwart"! Yeah, it makes more sense. I'm thinking maybe you should go see a speech pathologist or a-a-a dialect coach or someth—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, th-th-th-that's not the Stumblegimp Humiliating Dance of Contrition! (he lowers his hands to reveal there's nothing in them and sighs) One day, I gotta ask Norm what he did with my binoculars.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't sell yourself short, perhaps you can be one of my minions! Not an indoor minion, but a minion that keep the coalfires burning.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Whoa! Oh, I get it! This is what it does! Flying through a hoop! That's what I get...for buying a bat...from a defunct...bat circus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "Ah, Perry the Platypus! How unexpected for you to burst in on my nefarious..." (Looks at a script) Nefarious? No, that's- That's too much, even for me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, this is great, Vanessa! Why don't we talk these guys into giving us a tour of Paris? We can go check out the Guillotine Museum!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs sheepishly) Now that I think about it, uh, those two boys made some modifications to my design which may have allowed it to, you know, to work.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, he drives a taxi, for heavens' sake, he can work anywhere. But he expects her to just pack up and move to Vegas. Seriously.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If we weren't in the middle of a runaway train crisis, I would totally be giving you a hard time for leaving me in the toilet bowl.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughing maniacally) Now my ultimate triumph is at hand! Prepare to be hypnotized by a video scientifically created to get stuck in your heads, forever!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh yeah? Well-Well-Well I'm too flustered to come up with an insult, so I'll call you later, and give it to you then. Come on Norm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, it doesn't matter. Anyway, I get it. I understand now.  There's just one thing I gotta do before the whole thing starts over ag—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, gross! You're really going to do it? Perry the Platypus, that's so unsanitary! Didn't your mother ever tell you not to do that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Now, why do we always have to meet in drafty abandoned warehouses? I mean, why can't we meet in a drafty abandoned poolside cabana?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, my Power-Drain-inator! Ooh, that was a cool one! And it was...destroyed by my nemesis, Perry the Platypus. You just missed him.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I must say it's good to hear your voice again, too, after so long! I just came down here to get some parts for a new -inator.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, what you're saying is that I'm good at being evil after all! (calls Norm) Norm, we're back in business! Dust off the inators! (hangs up) Later, chumps!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Pay attention and learn something, Perry the Platypu-- Wait, wait! Where's Perry the Platypus? He's escaping, with the Poop-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: They dare to laugh at the Drusselstein Boomshlaka 320-I? Well, we'll just see who has the last laugh! Norm, fire up the Rustinator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Shot in the butt while covered in honey and hair? What do you know, my horoscope was right. (hugging pole) My beautiful, beautiful horoscope.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (still pouring pepper) Wow, you sure like a lot of pepper. I'm more of a paprika man myself. (Perry blows over the pepper, Dr. D coughs) It will take more than condiments to foil my brilliant plan! (The robot sneezes them out, and they crash through the Huge-O-Records building.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: If I can get a ladder, I can defuse them before they blow up. (Notices the house is destroyed.) Eh. Well, on the bright side, now we don't have to find that ladder.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, for Pete's sake, Perry the Platypus. I told you to go before we left. (at himself) He better bring back some popcorn, that's all I can say.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (holding a finger over Vanessa's mouth) Sh, sh, sh. (lowers finger and smiles) I know exactly what you're going to say and I'm on it, but right now, I need to (looks at the clip board and points at it with a pencil) study Perry the Platypus's every move.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Vanessa! Well, you're looking... uh... Oh, no matter. Where we are going, you can dress up like a clown every day if you want.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But if you and I teamed up and both trapped Perry the Platypus, he'd be twice as trapped and we could split the tag and bag prize!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hah, you don't wear trunks. What is that? A European thing? (gets hit by an incoming wave) Oh, hey it works. I have sand in my trunks and it's really irritating.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh so you're just trying to make me look like a fool. Well I don't need you for-- (accidentally turns on jet-pack) Ow Ow Ow Ow Ow! That. I'll just take the stairs.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, cool it, man. I think I'm getting a raise. Ooh, ooh, y-y-you should give the operation a name, like "Operation: Shared Evil".

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (yelling below) Pierre!! (giggles to Perry) Did anyone look? A-hee-hee-hee! I betcha, like, half the people down there are looking around, like (fake French accent) "Who called my name?" (laughs in his normal voice)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hey, it's me. It's me. I'm back. Perry the Platypus, look, the—oh, oh, it's the chopper cam. (singsong) Hello? I'm back. Hi, hi, Mom. Hi.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! See that? That's called "karma"! You do a little good and the universe pays you back with a whole lotta evil! Right, honey?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I built an All-You-Can-Eat-inator that speeds up your metabolism so you don't gain any weight no matter how much you eat ever.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (inside his giant walking building robot) Ha ha ha ha! When it comes to havoc, nobody wreaks like me! (Perry removes a metal cover of a storage) Whoa! Wait wait, you're not supposed to touch that! (Perry removes a wire) Hey, hey, no fair! (The robot almost steps over the building, but turns around.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (On speaker) (Coughs) Uh...hello, Major Monogram, this is Heinz, it's 7:45 on Tuesday, I'm really sick. So, I won't be able to do evil today. Anyway... (Coughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, look, Old Norm Head. It worked. It functioned properly! Vanessa's all picked up and taken home, with three minutes to spare.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (standing with Perry on his flatbed, balanced on the edge of the cliff) I can't believe nothing worked out for me today. After... I.. I had a A, B, and C and they all... 'course I destroyed the B so...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, left on to Maple Drive, and here we are! Oh, great. There's no parking spot! I should've invented a Parked Car Away-Inator.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Ah, the quaint town of Whiskershire. It's a great place to fly willy-nilly through, manacled to a rocket skiff this time of year.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nothing can stop me now! My alien friends, I command you to— (Steve's monstrous hand grabs the "mushroom".) No! Oh, stop! Aaah! (Perry comes out of his trap) This is not working out the way it did on paper!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know what they have in here, they-they have those tiny soaps, they make my hands look so big, it's like I'm a giant. All set.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's even got an attachment to shoot five things at once. C'mon, Perry the Platypus, there's gotta be something that annoys you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There he is! Welcome, Perry the Platypus! I knew my return to evil would be met with an equal opposing force of semiaquaticness.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The stitching took twice as long as the online tutorial said it would, but... Uh, it's a little big on you, but we can fix that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (narrating) Yet, curiously, I still lost to a baking soda volcano! (clip ends) And what's worse, his poetry lacked subtext entirely. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, we'll be on our way just as soon as Major Monogram drops this water balloon on the entire International Good Guy convention.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, people must call her "sir" all the time on the phone. It must be so em... (Laughs) She's standing right behind me now, isn't she?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A plunger jam?! AOh, I hate those! They always make the Paper-Cut-Inator-- (Hundreds of paper slices fly around Doofenshmirtz injuring him all around) E-E-E-E-E-E-E-Explode! Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heh-heh. Either way, it's nice to get out of the lab for a change and, you know, try to destroy each other out in the fresh air.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it, Perry the Platypus! There is nowhere left to run! You have officially overstayed your welcome! (Perry goes under Doof) Hey! Hey, no fair! (He throws the lid at Perry, but he ducks and it hits a sign that flings the lid back at Doof) Ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So far, not that much luck. Walking maniacally, that ain't happening. You saw. You saw. Neither is brushing my teeth maniacally.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ahhh! Hehe all right, Perry the Platypus, could you just do me a solid and hold this thing up to the street address in front of-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I am loving this! We're all like partners, now! Like-Like Jack and Jill, or Alice and Wonderland! And with a super-cool vehicle!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yep, gonna need some new pants. Well, I fail to see how this day could get any worse. (whistling overhead; at the camera) Flaming cactus. (screams, gets covered in flaming cactus) Yeah, that ought to do it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, welcome to St. Louis! Now do something about this bat, please! (Perry shoots the inator at Derek and it shrinks back to its original size, leaving Doofensmirtz hanging in midair, then falling.) Aah!! Well, at least I lost my fear of bats!! (Doofenshmirtz crashlands into a shellfish restaurant.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great, Perry the Platypus. This is all I need... So what did you want to talk to me about-- (He's suddenly hit by a chair and Perry starts going toward him. Doofenshmirtz quickly tries to scoot away) Oh! Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa whoa!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Being stranded on a deserted island is much easier with a normal sized head. Oh, I got something. (Sees Perry) It works! I found a platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We're moving... to a golden country on the sea, a country created by the greatest mastermind of our time, me. Assisted by Norm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I call him Mr. Fluffy Pants. You know, he's fluffy, he looks like he's got pants. Plus, he reminds me of my Uncle Fluffy Pants.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The call of the carbs was too strong, and I, too weak to resist their charms. I probably shouldn't have built a reverse switch.

Name: Future Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I finally got you, Perry the Platypus. The end game is finally he-ere. (plays checkers) Oh wait, I moved the wrong piece. (sees Future Perry sleeping) I'll just put it back.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, there's that sass! That's what I've been missing. C'mon, for reals, there's gotta be something you want to vaporize, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...so I can take over the Tri-State Area. Somehow. You know, you could put the red king on the- Hey! you're not even listening.

Name: Doofenshmirtz (cont'd)
Dialog: ...and-and the football player, the gorilla, and Lulu Jones, and Blanca Dishon and Director Dipthong. Everybody! Curse you all!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm sure if I thought about it, I could come up with some emotionally-scarring back-stories that are more outdoors-y... (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz) Aouagh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So now, with my giant claw, I will wreak vengeance on my brother, and take away his giant opera house! (Evil laugh) So, what's new with you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! And best of all, without your leadership, it will totally put an end to uh...W-What's the name of your organization again?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No fair! You distracted me with implied criticism! Aha! (he pushes the button activating the inator) Count the sheep, Perry the Platypus! Count the sheep and go to sleep...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You have to leave! It's not safe here for little kids, I mean for practically adults. Flee! Back to the city, away from danger!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't understand, I really thought two heads were better than one, you know, for the thinking. But I can't think of anything!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, he drives a taxi, for heavens' sake, he can work anywhere. He expects her to just pack up and move to Vegas. Seriously.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now I wish I'd made that "OFF" button more accessible from the taffy itself. (sighs; he and Perry are completely trapped in the taffy) I wonder how this is affecting the surface water.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh. But it isn't sandproof. Fancy that. I suppose, since I planned to take it to the beach, maybe I should have considered...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why do they say "Mark my words?" I mean, they-they just mean listen to my words, why don't they just say "Listen to my words"?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! I have to save my daughter. This is a big deal! Oh please? Please please? Oh, please please-y weasy please please? Please?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: At long last I have found one! I have been scouring the Internet and... and garage sales trying to find the discontinued doll.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sounding bored) Who could've guessed it? It's back to normal. And explosion now. (Kaboom!) Yep. Just like that. Curse you, Perry the Platypus. Whatever.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for staying trapped for so long, Perry the Platypus. I... I really needed to vent about Vanessa's essay. This was nice.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (wiping away a tear) The dream is back, baby! Y'know, in restrospect, I should never have used my Droogen-Chocolate-Swap-inator in the first place.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The world's largest ball of twine is on its way! Uh y-you'd better stand back, it's-it's supposed to be huge! (The ball of twine now much smaller arrives) What? That's it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: C'mon, gimme something good! Daddy needs a new pair of shoes, or, y'know, whatever the food equivalent of that is. (to Perry) You get it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Awww, thank you, Norm. I shouldn't have been so hard on you, but how come you were not affected by that strange energy thingy?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just connecting the reverse switch and done. Thank you so much, Perry the Platypus. Step aside so I can zap it back to normal.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Agent Lyla, from C.O.W.C.A.? Is this an international team up? Oh, you must hate that, Perry the Platypus. A loner like you...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, it's finally ready! (Button beeps) Too bad you can do nothing but watch as I prepare to launch my Space Laser-Inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Karen the Cat? Anything? Uh, no? What did you think of the rescue, Perry the— (Perry throws the training manual at Doof) Ow! (Perry takes off in his jet pack) Hey, Perry the Platypus, you're leaving us?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it's easy! (opens the floor revealing Roger at his desk looking up) Because I'm the boss of you! Nyah! (Closes the floor.) Ahh, this has already been a very productive day. (Melanie walks in with a huge stack of papers.) H-Hey, what's all this?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait til Benjamin gets to behold my Bring-Me-a-Drink-inator! Man, there is no grievance so petty that an inator can't fix it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm! What did you do, you big garbage disposal?! Now two of them are ruined! (Sarcastically) W-Why don't you just throw the third one over?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, Perry the Platypus, I will smudge your face with ice cream! (Laughing maniacally; Perry blows whale whistle) Wait, W-what are you doing? What is that? (Whale jumps over Slave-inator, knocking the ice cream out of the cone) Nooooo! Wait!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What is this, is this a hammock? If it's a hammock, it's way too tight. (Liam takes no notice, instead grabs rope and starts pulling Perry towards him, Perry struggles and resists, but is unable to, Liam grabs his fedora and slaps one end of a handcuff onto Perry's wrist) Hello? (sticks one hand out of the 'hammock') Mr McCraken, I think you caught me by mistake!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus... and my own poor planning skills! (notices smoke coming from an oven) Oh, no! M-M-My cobbler! Oh! How can this day get any worse?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He-Hello? Evil scientist speaking! Can-Can I get a camera over here? What? Nothing? Why are they so focused on these dancers?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Looks down and realizes that he is leaning on a sign that reads, "Keep Off The Grass" in red letters) It's all good, ladies. I am a card carrying Danville Botanical Gardens club member. (pulls out card) See? Here's my card! And I'm carrying it! (Esther takes card from him and takes out a laser pen and proceeds to scan the card before returning it back to Doof)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, we'll try this again. Blah blah blah carbon footprint! (Cut to trucker Perry. He pulls the brakes, and the back part lifts, dropping the big banana off of it. The carbon footprint slips and kicks the blimp deflating it. Doofenshmirtz sighs.) I suppose this was inevitable. Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (Crash!)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yoo-hoo, Mr. Pelican, I'm going to shrink you now. Hee hee hee hee. Wh-why is it not working? Something's blocking the-- (sees Parry rattling the antenna) HEY! (he goes to Perry who proceeds to attack him)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A whole Tri-State Area where I am already in charge! (chuckles) Yeah! Hold on, I gotta go check something out. (he goes up to 2nd Dimension Monogram) Uh, yoo-hoo! Hello again!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And... (The clipboard latches onto the lever.) Hey! (Perry punches Doof.) Perry the Platypus?! Take that! (Doof pulls a lever and Perry falls through a trap door.) You won't get out of there in time to stop me! (He pulls the lever on the inator. Cut to a wide shot to reveal Paul taping the inator shut.) What? What are you doing up there?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (shooing the letters away) Knock it off! Hope that's not permanent. Oh, I get it! H-Hey, hey, you guys, come back. Come back! Now, let me just explain.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank you. Platypus power. (His remote begins beeping) Uh oh. Batteries are low. Hmm... (He looks around for a place to recharge his remote) Take five, Perry the Platypus. (Perry sits down on the ground, and Doofenshmirtz runs over to an amp and plugs in the remote) Whew, that was close. (The remote and the amp begin glowing green; he screams) Ow! Oh! Oh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, Perry the Platypus, quake in terror, as I punch a hole through to another dimension! (shows his Other Dimensionator) Behold! The Other-Dimensionator...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I wouldn't call it lousy, per se. A little off, maybe, but... Oh, come on. Harry the Hyena, it was a good rescue, wasn't it?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No you hold it right there. Because I still have this! The Train-Operator-inator! Without it the train would be completely--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus?! Do you even realize how much trouble it is to set a trap?! And for what?! You just jump out of the way!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I gotta get out of this! (hops around in vain trying to escape from the MP3 wire and accidentally hits a button on the panel of an -Inator with plants all over it. It fires) Gah! Oh, my old Shrinkinator. (sighs) I suppose I should've unplugged it before I turned it into a planter.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, that seemed more painful at the time. Oh man, it's gonna take forever to get the gnome back up to the top at this rate.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I dunno. I used the Carb-away-inator, it just goes away. (to Perry) And are you really gonna thwart me for making healthy life choices?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, at the moment, it just stops giant shuttlecocks, apparently, but it-it's supposed to let me go into other dimensions.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I think I've said enough. I still don't get it. If we're the same person, why are you so much better at being evil than me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I get it, I think I get it! The-the light from the moon is just a reflection from the light from the sun! Ah, dummkopf!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow! Great mad scientist weather, isn't it, Perry the Platypus? It's so dramatic! Ooh, the ceremony should be starting now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not to make excuses, but sometimes, it's okay to be a little bit tacky. (He pushes a button and a bunch of tacks come out of the front, piercing his own tires.) Oh, maybe the tacks are supposed to be in the back.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: In my experience you get married, and then subsequently divorced but we don't have time for that. We gotta get you rolling.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) My tragic childhood and all those backstories, I could put up with that stuff. But droogens? That is where I draw the line.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heh-heh! How did I find you? Well, it was easy, with my Platy-Positioner satellite global platypus locator. Patent pending. (Perry kicks him.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Benjamin? Benjamin? Benjamin? Ugh! Fine, I guess I'm gonna hafta work on vacation. What have I got to work with here? Hmmm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (To Perry) Haha! We got him good! And I couldn't have done it without you. (Perry turns Doofenshmirtz's finger towards himself) Oh, why Perry the Platypus... (Doofenshmirtz put the tear he collected earlier back into his eye) See I knew I'd need it later.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Great. (Gives scripts to Norm and Vanessa) I thought we could try a little role-playing exercise. Perry the Platypus, you be me. (to his own reflection) Me, you be Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (chuckles; awkward silence) Uh, wait a second. Hold on. (rummages in the pile) Not this, not this. There was a whole bunch of 'em just a couple of minutes ago. A-ha! Jackpot!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: To the fair, my pets, where the freezing of the Tri-State Area will begin! (Perry pulls down a pipe to direct the bowling ball towards the penguins) Wait, wait, what is that, a giant bowling ball? (screams)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey Vanessa, Pumpkin Pants. Can you come in here for a second? (turns knob, Vanessa enters) Good news, sweetie, I can send you to the movies after all!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, wait, wait, uh, I'm not ready. Let, let me psych myself up. Just a few breathing exercises, then I'll go, okay, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs and dials his phone) Okay, I sorry I was not clear enough, apparently. Find another extension cord, but this time, you hold onto one end of it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, I decided to build the Metal-Unearth-inator to track down and dig up the key so I can fire up my All-Purpose-inator...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) I never got to go in myself, but I remember looking through the fence when my brother, Roger had his birthday party there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, it's something you've always wanted. Something you've asked for time and time again. In my hand, I hold the key to...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This... This is why I have so many extension cords. (dials phone) Okay, now tell me, is one end of the cord plugged into the power bank?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Wow, y-you know, Charlene, you're really on top of things here. Tomorrow, I'm taking you shopping for a new evil pantsuit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Surprise! Matching outfits! It's John Phillips of London Bullywear. Plus, monogrammed jet-packs! Doof and Byoof! We rhyme.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We make a great team, don't we? I think we make a great team, do you think we make a great team? (Perry continues fixing the machine without a glance at Doofenshmirtz) Yeah, you do. I can tell.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Sheesh! She's got a penthouse uptown. You can't miss it. It has "Charlene" written in bright lights across the top of it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a minute, wait a minute. How did you get the sunglasses to go on one side of your face? Who made these, M.C. Escher?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, introducing my Combine-inator! With my Combine-inator, I was finally able to make the Triple Scoop Garlic Roach Cone!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, very resourceful, Perry the Platypus! Using coupons to cut prices! Hey! (Perry jumps on the inator and it activates.) Hey! N-N-Not my baseball card collection! Oh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, let's see, the uh—the Roman Coliseum. The, uh, No-Man-Can-See-'Em-Because-It's-So-Tiny. No, that's not a good-- (Perry escapes out of using Little Ben, get it?, and hits Doof) Ah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (runs through a curtain into a room filled with coats) What is this, the coat room? (Perry launches himself from behind the coats into Doofenshmirtz, who goes flying into a rack of coats; he emerges with a pink hat and coat on) All right, Perry the Platypus, if you really want to fight, here I a... (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz into another coat rack) Ooh, Cashmere. Nice.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! See, Vanessa? I'm not a loser anymore. Now you'll want to live with me at the Tri-Governor's mansion, right? Right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no! My Boom Juice! Heading for Cactus Gorge! (It goes over) Oh. Well, what do you know? My Boom Juice isn't as volatile as I had... (The rig explodes)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No wait! We can dazzle, we can. I will now saw The Amazing Platydini in half. See? See? Platypuses, they're like butter.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just for the record, Perry the Platypus, I was thwarted by Sergei the Snail, not you! You don't get any credit for this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold still! Hold still—Argh! (he shoots the gun at the platypus, but misses) It's a good thing I have this practice platypus, 'cause this is much harder than I thought.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, devastatingly aloof cabana boy whose name I don't quite remember, (He activates the inator.) but I'm pretty sure it's in the Benjamin family!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: (smirks at Phineas) Well, look who just became redundant! Send them to their doom! (Platyborg points to Candace) Yes, her too. (He points to Perry) Yes yes, everyone. Doom, doom, doom, and...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Work? What do you... Oh, you mean them? No, Major Monobrow and Perry the Platypus, they...they were helping me find you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (video off) Not bad, huh? I'm gonna do all my Inator introductions like that from now on! It just so much more professional looking!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, that was interesting. You defaced yourself. (pause) I-I didn't see that coming. To be honest, you have lost me completely.

Name: Bad Future Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh wait, Perry the Platypus. Change of plans; instead of doing that, DON'T. All right, see you later. Remember the oath!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (trapped in the taffy) Ha-HA! I still have the upper hand! (the taffy spinner rotates, moving Perry above Doofenshmirtz) Well, actually you may at this particular mo... (the taffy squishes them together, then separates them again) Chew first, Perry the Plat... ahhh!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, well, I'm out of your blast radius today, so surprise me, why don't you? Try not to be a complete disappointment.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on, Francis, you've been zapped by my Ultimate-Evil-inator. I mean, if it didn't hit you, then who did it hit? (A large barrel comes down and traps them)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'll take that. There ya go. (shrinks an umbrella) I'll take that! Just getting my money's worth! And, ooh, that would look nice in my foyer!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And thank you for washing your hands. Food safety and even-length shoelaces, two things people always take for granted—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But one should never walk the paths of Drusselstein with uncovered Doonkelberry cake, lest the Doonkelberry bats swarm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (narrating) ...onto my rocket skiff and headed off to Roger's beauty contest. We arrived just in time for the swimsuit competition.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No! It's the greasy grievance girl from the basement! No! No! What have I done? Why do you have a grievance against me? (Doofenshmirtz screams and jumps out the window)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, would you look at that! Newton the Gnu is Agent Silent G. Whoo! I have to blog this. (Notices agents walking by with cups of coffee) Hmm, must be a coffee break. (Computer screen starts blinking saying "security breach" and he turns it off without looking)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (annoyed) How many times do I have to tell you that chocolate cake isn't for break— (Norm stuffs the bite in his mouth, Doofenshmirtz chews and swallows) I stand corrected. All right, up an' at 'em.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, no! Oh, why would you even do this? Now I need to open the door and reset the Tilt-inator countdown to fire again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That day I made a solemn vow that Roger would pay for what he'd done. (cuts to them in an office) The next morning I had the solemn vow notarized.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What was that, Swedish? You better not be broken, Norm. You still have to fly around the city and distribute leaflets.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (cuts off Norm) Oh, for crying out loud, Norm! Listen, here's a buck, why don't you go get out of here and get a haircut or something!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is really weird. I, I think I may have gone on a date with that one. I-I had no idea she was a robot at the time.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What the?! Oh, the festival's so loud I can't even hear my own evil jingle! (turns around) Okay, guys, (cut to reveal four singers in a recording booth) take it from the top, louder!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Comfortable, Perry the Platypus? I made that platy-rack so that every limb is accounted for. So, what's it all about?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (cntd.) (voiceover) Once I was terrified, I was able to analyze the fear-based synapses of the brain and extrapolate some wonderful data!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just in case anyone's wondering what happened to old Doofenshmirtz, I'm okay. (The giant tooth lands on top of him) Yeah well okay well, obviously not now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, need a ride? (a rope ladder drops down from the chopper) Oh, oh, oh, wait, I should've said, "Need a lift?" That's what— I totally missed it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My parents were never there for my kickball moment. But you know what? I'm gonna be there for Vanessa. Take us down!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (holds up Mary McGuffin doll) No, your happiness! Remember how you said if I got you a little Mary McGuffin doll, I'd be the world's greatest dad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's no use! It's no use! We are doomed! (Agent P sees a helicopter. He jumps onto the magnet and fires a grappling hook at it. He quickly wraps some of the rope around the magnet. The helicopter flies off, taking the magnet with it.) You did it! You saved us, Perry the Platypu- (The tinfoil crashes through the building.) Curse you, Perry the Platypus! (The Magnifier gets attached by the magnet. The magnet gets attached to the whole rollercoaster, which begins to rumble as it follows the helicopter.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, local news. (turns TV off with a remote) All summer long, we have this standing appointment and suddenly Mr. Big Shot can't be troubled to... (screams; spills his coffee)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just introduce yourself and, you know, ask her what her sign is. And then run the other way if she says Sagittarius.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Doofenshmirtz and Perry circle each other) So here we are, just the two of us at a stalemate. Each looking for something to turn the tide, but what will it be?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank you, Vanessa, but I don't believe I was talking to you. Is your name Perry the Platypus? No, I don't think so.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (takes some) Thank you! Mmm, mmm, I could get used to this good luck thing. It's better than having a genie. That was a mistake.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now...! (the Backstory-inator starts to send the memories back to Doofenshmirtz) I can feel myself getting (his skin takes a red tint and his teeth become sharp) more e-e-evil!! (his laugh becomes deeper and he grows massive and muscular) Feel the doom!! Nothing can stop me now! (he picks up Perry with a claw-like hand and continues laughing; Perry pulls out his wallet and reveals pictures of the two of them, causing good memories to flow through the extraction helmet) Huh? Uh? NOOOOOO!!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Right now, there's an elliptical who needs you. Don't you have some time to spare for these poor lonely treadmills?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It sounds positive for me, and I like that, but who is speaking nicely of me? Wait, was it you, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (quietly, to Norm) That's my chair! The one with the foot control! (out loud) Uh, Francis, maybe you'd like this chair with the sleek upholstery.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Oh, looking for my remote, are you? Well, here. Take it. I don't need it anymore. I am in love!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What do you know? No more Perry the Platypus. Transported to some random location somewhere. (Perry reappears and punches his nose, he disappears.) Ow! What -- (Perry reappears behind him, grabbing his head.) OW!! OWEY!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I want someone to help take over the Tri-State Area and make me their "guy-state area". Yeah? See what I did there?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, now, who could that be? All right, already! (walks to the door) This better be important, or you are gonna get such a mustache...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I have to watch every penny. And the 37 minutes or free deal from the local pizza guy can really make a difference.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (takes off his helmet) If you want a car, (Vanessa takes off her helmet) you're going to have to prove to me that you're responsible, that you can do things by yourself.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! Well, if you're going to crash my party, you're going to need a party hat. A party hat of doom! (shoots one at Agent P, who moves out of the way, causing the party hat to hit a table and the party favors to fall on the floor; he then charges towards Doofenshmirtz and hits him a bunch of times with the party favors)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, sure, Vanessa! Oh no, no, good memories flowing! Aaahhh! Can't stop... pleasant reminiscences! (flashback montage starts) Aaaaahhhhhhhh!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh. Y'ever try to sue a genie? Oh, you're asleep. W-Well, let's try to see what kind of tunes are on the FM dial.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great! A line! (At a boy) Oh, brother! What is this, a model of Pluto? (Laughs) That planet doesn't even exist anymore, you moron!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voice over) She left me for that trash-talking 35-ton pile of blubber. And broke my fragile, 10-ounce utterly-too-human heart.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yes, yes. Please come in. I-I have a very special melody that I'd like to learn how to perpetrate—I mean play. (He plays all open strings on the guitar as his daughter walks into the room.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (muffled) Perry the Platypus, would you mind hitting the self-destruct button? I think my shoulders have to make a big bang.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, you've changed. You used to be so... you know, what's the polite way to say... you know, like this one? (points to mean woman) Ugly.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ex-leaders of the Tri-State Area, I have called you here to help ease the people through this transition of power.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, look how big the sun is through this magnifying glass. (Gets harmed off-screen) Ow! Ow! Oh!...No really, it's huge, you should see it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, little brother, you have had nothing but good luck your whole life, and I'm here to even things up for once!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So, Perry the Platypus. Let me tell you about my latest scheme. The other day, I was perusing the Internet when...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah? Well, no daughter of mine will date the son of my— Y-You get the idea. I'm just flipping what you said.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Snaps his fingers) We're gonna need a turban and a wig. And while I'm out, I'm gonna pick up some bagels. Anyone else want anything?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The keys to a good trap are the element of surprise and, also, if you can work in a good pun. That's always nice.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Cool! But they didn't know it was a hair dryer when you pointed it at them, so...that means you're a little evil!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: True evil is born through pain and loss. You see, when I was a small boy back in Gimmelshtump, I had a toy train.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (looks out his window) Is this a stakeout, Perry the Platypus? I-I see you. Just come up. We'll have a stake-in. Come on in. Come on up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He, he, funny thing. I was flying over your party with a giant bucket of water, and this platypus hit me with a--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh! Oh, no! Everyone is enjoying themselves! E-Even Roger! Oh, my plan has failed! Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And I like number seven, that's my lucky number. (The background starts to ripple.) It all started when I was seven years old, back in Drusselstein—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? He's not my mysterious platypus. I didn't bring him in here! I just—Oh, oh, you mean the cat. (Doof takes a white cat from under the table and leaves.) Yeah, my bad.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, and the rest of you, Muscles, Ropey-Face, Slap-Happy, Buzzy-Pants, stay here and help me with the antidote.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, I'm a scientist. I'm gonna go with him on that. I might have a water pistol lying around. I-I can go get it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The adult diaper factory! I'll be over the target in exactly, ah, (tips the eulg bottle over while looking at his watch) five min— (gasps and watches some eulg hit the back of the plane) Oh, no, that's not going to be good. (The plane comes apart.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All through the cold night as the Spitzenhound howled.... My only companion was the moon. And my neighbor Kenny.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (writing) Note to self, consider pulling off and replacing Norm's head. (Norm captures Perry in a bag) Oh, okay, much better (to Perry) this is a good look for you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, (chuckles) well, thank you. A-A lot of people focus on the, you know, the weak forehead. So you...so you care to dance?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on, commit to the bit. Here, like this. (He kneels down and puts on a fedora.) "Oh, Dr. Doofenshmirtz, you're so evil. How can I ever thwart you?"

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, to launch my creation and begin my reign of terror! Evil terror. (Button beeps, whirring; Ding) Huh? Ah. (ice cream splats onto him) Ugh... Well, this can't be right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, Perry the Platypus, where are you going? I... I could use a non-latex second opinion, I... Please? Please?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey! Aw man, another inator bites the dust, and I'm stuck listening to Jerky McIrritating across the street now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, look, this staple makes a perfect little chimney. I hope Perry the Platypus appreciates all this hard work.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, duh! Of course! You were going for the Slow Motion-inato--. Wait! Wait, no! Don't touch the reverse switch!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pause) Curse you, Perry the Platypus. I didn't even get my popcorn. (realizes) Wait. If they were faking it, what did my ray hit?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm just saying we only look happy because we were singing. It's not a true representation of our relationship.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, be a dear and help a brother out. Can't seem to -- (Perry takes the control board off his head) Oh! Oh, thanks. (Turns around) No! What are you doing?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, now I have to clean this all up! You couldn't just hit the self-destruct button? That would've been better.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah. (Turns to a Visigoth who is standing next to the park bench he and Perry are sitting on) Sorry, Alaric, I thought they were Visigoths. But you're not going to impress the punks. You're free to go.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on. You've got that whole thing up here, it runs right... It's one straight line, for crying out loud!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Pfft! I prefer to inator my way to success...just like I wrote in my book! Available in dollar bins everywhere!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, this long. This long, lessee. (gets out a few extension cords) Too short. Too short. Too long. Way too short! Why would I even have this?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, at least I found the key to the- (his roof explodes) Nice. Curse you, Perry the- (the roof crashes down again) Oh... Why does everything explode so easily? (the entire top of his building explodes)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What's that noise? (the huge amount of water splashes onto the machine, causing Doofenshmirtz to hold on to the handle.) What the heck man? You've been dumping out my water? Well, this had better not not be empty.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (narrating over clip) A painful, but accurate choice of words, Norm. At the age of five, I was forced to throw my own surprise party.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "What'cha doin'?" What does it look like to you? I'm building an evil empire. My very own Fortress of Eviltude.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no you don't, I'm on the American side now, you can't touch me. (Perry throws a punch) O! Canada. (Lyla does the same) Uh! 'Merica. (Perry hits him) Ow! Oh, it's on now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (On screen) Okay, Perry the Platypus, all charged up and ready to... (Pushes button on remote repeatedly, but nothing happens) Oh, great. Now what's wrong with it? (Perry's left arm moves) I didn't do that!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aha! Oh, wait. You're, you're just a regular platypus. I'm sorry. You're completely useless to me. No offense.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (falls down and lands on the ground) It's not the worst date I've ever had. There was that one that kept stabbing me with a fork. Get this off of-- (sees the Bigfoot dummies and runs for it)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All I needed to do was turn the thing on. (Flashback Doofenshmirtz pulls out a key) Then fate played a cruel joke. (Flashback Doofenshmirtz slips on green paint. The key falls off the balcony) The ignition key fell off my balcony!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, wise guy, I'm ex- Oh! (Chuckling) Sorry, madam. Sorry. (To Perry) Her voice was so masculine and growly. I thought it was a man.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I could never maneuver out the front door, but-but I see you're pretty mobile. W-What are you guys doing here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All through the cold night as the Spitzenhounds howled, my only companion was the moon. And my neighbor Kenny.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You should think about that offer! Minioning! It's a growth industry. (looks at the blue copy in his hand) Oh, he forgot to leave me the pink copy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (growls in anger) Mark my words. You will remember the name of Heinz Doofenshmirtz. Hm! (He walks out of the diner, but soon pops his head back in) Could I still get my whole wheat on rye?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaah! I can't believe it! (inhales sharply) You surreptitiously record us? And even more importantly, I'm losing my little girl!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sweetie pie, I'm back! Sorry it took me so long. Who would've thought being Tri-Governor would be so involved?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, you know, different things, but today I'm building a Juice-inator (shows Paul the Inator) It's going to turn City Hall into juice!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Doctor, Doctor, Doctor! Oh, I-I'm sorry. I didn't mean to shout. To honor your visit, I will blow up the moon!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha, hah! So long, Perry the Sucker-pus! Look after my minions! (at himself) Those little traitors! (pauses) Oh, for crying out loud!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Good luck! Heinz is a great name. For a boy or a girl, I'm just saying! Isn't that lovely, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's much safer up here, huh? You might still wanna buckle up, though. It's my first time flying a helicopter.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, it's not even noon and you're already leaving? What... What am I supposed to do for the rest of the day?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, we're taking a break from our usual hostili—you know, I've gotta go back one. Your first name is Francis?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right, put up your dukes! Wait—Wha—what are you doing?! (Perry puts him in his hat.) Hey, this place is nicer than my first apartment.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Sighs) I wonder how my scheme worked out for Professor Banister. I'm sure that Cloud Magnitizer-inator was a winner.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I trusted him and he just cast me aside, like a, like, like an old newspaper. He didn't even wrap fish in me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Can it wait, sweetie? I-I've got a lot of stuff on my evil to-do list to do today. To do today. To-do to-day,

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, see, that's the problem. It's mounted to the deck, and I can't swivel it. Bit of an oversight, I guess.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See, now that's a trap! I even made it based on my own daughter's fashion style. Vampire-pilgrim-scuba-diver.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no. I- I just called to remind you that I'll be picking you and your Visigoth friends up after the dance.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (reading the paper) Gracias, thank you, Norm. (to Perry) Does this make sense to you? Listen. "Someone is secretly speaking on your behalf."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, you're-you're getting paid for this? I'm doing this as community service! I-I gotta do like, 200 hours!

Name: Von Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow! Do you preen your feathers with that mouth? They should call you Sw-- Oh! Oh, I get it. Sweary the Swan!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm dance... (clears throat) "I'm dancing with your wife, pal. You got a problem with that?" Oh, yes, that does sound tough.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on, Perry the Platypus. Let's go home. I talk to you enough, right? Yeah, you're right. Maybe too much.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Maybe the "Giant Cannibal" thing was a mislead! I think the dining set was his! (He hops behind Norm onto their rocket-powered sled.) Go, go, go, go, go, go, go!! (The Snowman makes a huge snowball and tosses it down the mountain after them. It crashes into their sled and they roll down the hill with it.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
