Dialog: Okay, so what's next? I...activate my -inator, okay. Give me a head start here. (Groaning, stands up and cracks his back.) I'll get there, don't worry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, Norm, I've got to give it to you. Under my genius supervision, you turned out extremely adequate work.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, it looks like that anti-platypus security system was a total waste of money. I am so taking that back.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, but you're supposed to bring the food out on the platter. It's... It's okay, we'll work on that part.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, how nice of you to showcase your loyalty to me. You're on... You're on our team, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Seriously. Where's that coming… (Notices Perry in a trap) Oh, look, you've already captured Perry the Platypus! My, you do work fast.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: $23! Uh, let's go to the phones again. (pause) Okay, if no one calls in the next few seconds, the platypus gets it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aagh! Can we not do this on the treadmill? We're just generating more power. Will you stop?! Listen to me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz

Dialog: Oh, come on! (Perry gets turned into a football player) Oh, I get it. Pig skin. Oh great. My -inator has a sense of... (gets turned into a dinosaur while falling to ground) Velociraptor power attack!

Dialog: I coulda helped. I understand the Standard Evil Fortress Infiltration Technique. Step one: Diversion.

Dialog: Ouch! Ow! What is that about? Man, you tie a guy up and he gets all foot-stompy on you for no reason!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Gasps) My professor is here! (Laughs as he walks to the door) Now, Perry the Platypus, you will tremble before the mighty, (Opens door) Dr. Gevaarlijk!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! What a shot! Norm, set me down next to the registration booth and you go get the car ready.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, thanks for your help. I usually hate shopping, but, you know. You make it fun.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, Vanessa. I just need to take a picture of you because ... I love you and I don't need a son.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh yeah, you got game now. (a man with a cotton candy machine stops next to the popcorn machine) Oh, now see, someone else is making a move. You snooze, you lose, Norm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, curse this tin can! Ugh, I'm going to need a jump-start! (Phineas and Ferb;s rocket crashes into Doofenshmirtz's, causing it to begin to fall towards earth) I, uh, no, I guess it won't help now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's not stealing. This cruise was advertised as "all-inclusive", so I'm getting my money's worth.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But my intelligence specifically said that you would be sunbathing, it never mentioned an intern.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Tails? What are they gonna do, wag me into submission? Well, you're too late, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alright, Mr. "Eviler than Thou", just how did you manage to take over the Tri-State Area, anyway?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Balloony! Okay, clown-bots, let's try fighting to save my friends maniacally!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Don't try to wheel and deal with me. I get a big alimony check every month, so money's no object.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, he can wait. So what friend? Is it that girl with the dark hair who has all those dachshunds?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, looks like oil and platypuses don't mix either! Ha ha! There's no way for you to get up here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAH! Someone always finds my self-destruct button! (Sighs) Curse you, Perry the Platypus, blah blah blah.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come back here! (Perry grabs a piece of the inator and bends it.) Oh, what are you doing down there?! (Perry activates it and salutes and gets teleported away. The inator turns into broccoli.) Uh-oh. Aaaaah!! (Groans and spits some broccoli out) Curse you, Perry the— (knock at the door) Coming.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (takes the note) Oh, my little girl is all grown up! This is so exciting, Vanessa! I'll start looking for flights!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not that being tied around a fish is what I imagined for my...-- Wait, what-what'd you mean "we?"

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Poke the Goozim with a stick! Surrounded by lava. (the pathway retracts) My second favorite game is backgammon. Love it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I see. Oh, I see. You're re-dehydrating them. Okay, good. But wait, but you missed this ball!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No no-no-no. No, this. (showing a lever on the floor) This is the light switch! Ugh! (He pulls the lever) I tried to make it as obvious as possible.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, that whole subtle thing wasn't working out for me as you know. Now, hand over that amulet.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I can't believe it! Just moments away from finally achieving full control of the Tri-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "Bring us figgy pudding." (chuckles) Well you could say please. But you know whatever great. Figgy pudding.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (seeing the bobblehead bounce) Oh yes, so you agree. You know, I miss our little talks, don't you? (Doof hits a bump making the bobblehead Perry shake his head) Oh, what do you know anyway? (throws bobblehead out the back window)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's just a Carb-Away-inator, Perry the Platypus. It's not even evil. It... It sends carbs away.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (once again fighting over the joystick) Perry the Platypus, stop it! I-I have to put down this jukebox so I can pick up the Opera House!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh! Oh, it looks so horrible! I can't look, I can't look! Stop! Stop, Perry the Platypus, stop!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, uh, it's, uh, just, uh... (Dr. Gevaarlijk walks away and he stops her) Wait, wait! Don't go. Let me show you this; my very own nemesis.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is what preempted me! Ugh! The newspeople, they're behind this, and I-I won't stand for it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no! What-What are you doing? I worked all... (blubbering) Not the Gloom-inator! No, no! Get off, get off!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, don't touch the... Oh, get away from that, you bad, bad kitty! No, not the Erase-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay, I've been reconsidering and I'm going to give in. I'm totally gonna be your co-host.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? What is it? Oh, great. Now I'm a single-celled organism. Now how am I going to drive home?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus! I've drawn a line in the sand, and you are not allow to cross this line.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's one of Johnny's hairs. It's loaded with his DNA. With this, I can mix up an antidote to...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A beanie propeller cap? Tha... (The propeller spins and Perry takes off) Uh... alright I'll give that to you, that's-that's kind of cool.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But— (Perry gives him the phone again. Doof growls and swipes it from Perry and dials.) Don't gloat, Perry the Platypus. It's not becoming. Hello, Charlene? (Charlene yells on the other line) Yeah, you told me so.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Trophy room? Whoa-whoa-whoa hold on a second, I just hired you to trap Perry the Platypus, not- (steps onto trap, trap snaps shut with Doofenshmirtz inside)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Perry the Platypus, I'm sorry there's nothing to foil, I'm, I'm still down about- (Perry holds up Balloony, who has been patched and fully blown up) Balloony! (An instrumental version of "My Wettest Friend" starts to play to a montage of Doofenshmirtz and Balloony spending time together)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, I suppose I should've put some sort of steering mechanism on it, but, um, live and learn.

Name: Inner Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback) That's enough! Don't overtighten it, like your brain! Now, let's just imagine how it will work.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Something's not right. The corners of your mouth are pointing up. (feeling her forehead) Maybe you're running a fever.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooooh, I just felt a disturbance in the cup-stacking universe. I think my record's been broken.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (coughs) Oh, I sure hope the poor slob who lives here has insurance. That would be... (He looks around to see he is "the poor slob who lives here".) Oh, crud. Vanessa!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Check you out Perry the Bloat-apus. Hehehe! (Doofenshmirtz inflates as well) Well, uh, this is awkward. Seriously, you're gonna-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He was so impressed with my inator, it seems a shame not to have it here for the presentation.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, lemme get this straight: you're a soccer player turned actor turned actor-soccer player?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Make sure you get all these little pieces over here, too. No no, y-you're missing the big one.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, yes! The horse-drawn coach has arrived and Mayor...Wafflesomething is walking up to Roger.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right! By shaking up the other contestants, I will look grounded and stable by comparison!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Eh, so I missed. Oh whatever, I have a bigger bother to be-gone. Goodbye, stupid Roger statue!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it! Run away, Perry the Scaredy– Oof. (With his face puffed up from exposure to the vacuum of space) Oh, I think I need to put on my spacesuit. Uh oh. (The asteroid strike Doofenshmirtz's ship)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ouch, they're really cranking up the evil a notch. I... I think they burned off my fingertips.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah! Well, how about that! Did-Did you ever notice that the hood ornament here is a little dog?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aah! (Perry locks the Drill-inator's target onto the Old Reliable Geyser and jumps off) Wait, where are you going? Aah! (The Drill-inator lands on the geyser) I'm okay, I -- (spins around and gets flung away) AAH! Fie upon you, Perry the Platypuuuuus! (Perry parachutes down to safety)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah, absolutely. There's a guaranteed 55% chance of success, so we're...we're good to go.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Didja have to order for all of us, Rodney? I'm not crazy about this new grilled cheese flavor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Urgh. There, I'm better. Hey. Perry the Platypus, that's it? You're just gonna thwart and run?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay, I'll show you. My Turn-Away-inator and I are ready to go! Ah (presses the button and everyone at the pool looks to the side, away from Doofenshmirtz) That's it, look away.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Noooooo!!!! Ah, man! Now I'm gonna have to use the money I made for repairs and medical bills.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...maybe we could drop by Niagara Falls. It's so close by, and I-I've always wanted to see it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I really don't remember an elevator down here. (An elevator bell dings.) Well, whaddya know? How could I have missed it? (A couple of Shining twins walk out of the elevator.)

Name: Younger Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Dude, chill, it's mine. I don't have to give it to you. (As they fight, Doofenshmirtz unlocks the rapid fire, and sends beams of de-aging from his roof) Hey! Quit it. You're pushing me, dude.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Steven, you came back. That's right, fifteen percent off in the gift shop. Nice going, Steven!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (At the colossus) Okay, you go smash the kids, then we'll take over the world later. As long as I still have... (He is interrupted by Perry, who kicks him to the ground)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I know that's just the air currents pushing you around, but that's still special! Aaah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Tootie McFrutti has arrived on time! In a few seconds, he'll be flattened by a speeding tire.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, he's up at the top, Perry the Platypus. Hold still. Hold it. Steady. Steady. I got you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Also, I was not joking about mistaking you for my dentist. You guys are really... it's eerie.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, let's hope nobody knows it's us. (walks off) Now, get out of my way, you perfunctory party planner.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, you're just in time! Let's squeeze in a quick ride while I monologue.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, Paris! That makes a lot more sense. That's actually where she wanted to go. Good for her.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I noticed in your online profile that you say you like tall men. Is--? Is--? Is that true?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You can come out now, Dennis the Rabbit! (The disco ball opens revealing Dennis in cutesy animal mode.) Aw, look how cute! H-He's cute! (to Norm) Isn't he cute, Norm?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, a joke about the commercial break, yeah, that's how I want to spend my last few seconds.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oop! Watch this! (He leaps on to the -inator, activating it, then jumps into Norm's arms) Prepare to face the wrath of Normenshmirtz! (Normenshmirtz fires laser at Perry) You can't get away from me now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (While hiding behind Perry) He's gonna John Wilkes my Booth! (a beat) What, too soon? Ahh! Getting a little too honest here, Abe!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, thanks for the recap, Maggie. Anyway, you can't just go off and solve this without me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, of course I need—Wait a minute. No! I do not need that! You are absolutely right. Huh.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, didn't you get my letter? Oh, of course not, here I-I'll read it to you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why do I always use so much butter? (shakes the popcorn off, and lunges at Perry, but lies down on the chair Perry was sitting in) Y'know, I'm so groggy. That turkey really packs a punch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Man, what I wouldn't give for that kind of single-minded focus. Hey, what's that over there?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Closing in on the target. (Cut to the plane to reveal Doof reading a map.) With Perry the Platypus out of the scenario, nothing will stop me! (laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, man, not my new flat-screen! (Kaching!) Hey, no way! I paid way more for that TV! (Doof falls backwards and breaks a part of the inator with his back. The machine malfunctions and goes haywire zapping randomly.) Hey, wha? Ow! Ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (As he bends down) What's that? (Perry punches him in the nose) Ooh! Oh, I guess I walked into that one. (He falls backwards, right onto his scale model of Danville, destroying it) Aw, man, I worked all weekend on that! (Flashback of him gluing the buildings to the table)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, none of this would have happened if we had just gone for ice cream like I suggested!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (squeals) It worked! Hee hee! Ooh, time to give Roger a dose of bad stinkelkrampen he'll never forget!

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sarcastically) Really? I hadn't noticed! (to the bees) Alright, bees. You like honey, don't ya? (pours honey from the hive all over him) Come and get it! Come on! (runs off)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This song montage is taking longer than I thought. I hope those emissaries haven't left yet.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, how do you like my new Nemesis Catch-o-Mat? I bought it from the TV. (Perry gives him a look)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Looks like somebody needs another shot of the I-Don't-Care-inator. (The car runs over some parts and the inator slips out of Doof's hand.) What? Uh-oh! That's mine! (Perry catches the inator.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes. Yes, you are. Y'know, you really should use sunblock. Y-You're burned down to the bone.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That's it! That is it! You will rue the day that you demoted Heinz Doofenshmirtz to co-host! (he leaves)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, I don't remember making a Power-Switch-inator, but, uh, y'know, I make a lot of inators!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: None! I don't like 'em the way you cook 'em. You always leave in the shells! Who does that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You've always had one, Norm. I just never told you where it was so you wouldn't pick at it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, uh, it's not a vehicle. It's an evil device. You see, this is what I do for a living. (gets a ticket; changes to a shocked face)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! A birthday party! Perfect. This is next on the list of things I can ruin! With fish!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, what's gonna be the first part of the Tri-State Area (Perry tears the floor tile from the ground - his feet still attached - and jumps onto Doofenshmirtz in the Gimmelshtump-inator) to get the Gimmelshtump makeover?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, just go with it, Francis. (to Kelly) Hey, l-look at this! Strike a pose! Look, look, look, I'm vo—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What the? Oh no! Dream creatures are coming out of the screen! How is this happening? Whoa!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We wanted different things. She wanted to not be married to me. So what's new, Short Stuff?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've got you now, Perry the Platypus! (They attempt to run into each other but miss; Doofenshmirtz punches a chair instead) Perry the Platypus, did you get yourself upholstered?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Being tossed around like a beach ball) Nooo! Wait. Wait. Wait. Is that the Love Sandals? Ohh! Hey, oh, watch the hands lady. Heey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I did it! Did anyone see that? Anyone? Anyone? No one's lookin'. Nobody's payin' attention.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, I don't know, I thought it would make my entrance more dramatic. And it totally worked!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hmm. It's a...it's a couch. That's a bit anti-climatic. I guess it's a nice couch, though.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The spaceships should be here any minute. And then, it will be time to pump up the volume!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, come in, come in. I consider you a VIP, a very important platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, stop panicking, Francis. I haven't even touched the main stabilizers, you know... yet.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait. What is this? Now we have to fill these forms out in the dark? Is that what...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: "I'm Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz, and I like unicorns and rainbow..." Wait, who switched my...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is not at all what I had in mind! Oh! Oh, this really sucks! I mean, literally! Okay!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I dare you to try that again! (Perry kicks him again and the inators roll away.) Well, I did dare him, I guess. No! No! (The first inator falls off) A third of my inator! (Wide shot of the building as the falling inator activates)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAAAAAAAHHHH!!! Ow! I know I didn't make you that smart, but you can't even walk straight? (doorbell rings)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, to summon the Spartan Army! (fires up the inator) Ooh! Here they come! Here they come! They're coming!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nobody messes with my self-destruct button! (He sticks the mop's handle into the inizer and tries to lift it up.) You make a pretty good fulcrum there, Rodney.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, man, you have no idea how much that was worth! (Kaching!) Although, judging by the jingling— (Perry hits him) Ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This is why I'd rather not make friends, they find someone else, and "Bam!" you're alone.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (angrily) No. No. No, No, not mad scientist! I'm not angry. Evil scientist. There's a difference...

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: Ouch! Ouch! Ow! Ow! Oh! Why couldn't I have disappeared before I hit the ground? Curse -- (disappears)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (encased) I really asked for that, didn't I? Oh, now what? Some petard hoisting? Oh, okay. Figures.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, man, everything here in dreamland is so distorted and ugly. Say... (Wide shot to reveal a short green devilish imp that looks like him) you look familiar.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Chicken and waffles! That's why I had "waffles" stuck in my head. That was it. (walks up to the inator) And...now! (fires the inator)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Oh, I remember this baby. Y'know, if I had a clip like that on my pen, I'd never lose it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Time to give it a little test. (he turns it on, it starts for a brief second, then shuts down) Hmm. Well, I just finished it. It can't be broken already.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You realize most of the kids watching this show have never even seen a typewriter, right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, that? I-I planned to do evil today but look at me. I-I don't think it's gonna happen.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Well, yes, of course. He's my nemesis. I have to show him everything.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Shoo, shoo! Go away! Whoo! Now, that was just disturbing. Waah! No, no! Get away from me! (falls into a box)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, we know the drill. We've hosted before. (pointing to Major Monogram) He's good, I'm evil, blah blah blah.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Let's just leave it at I know and I vow to be good from now on so your worries are over.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) When I was a lad, I had trouble sleeping, so my parents told me to try counting sheep...

Name: Young Adult Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The movies are gray, the TV is black, the horses are running, please bring me some food.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus, and also my own hubris for creating an army of me-plants!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't know yet, it's missing a part. But whatever it is I'm sure it will be pure evil!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus. And curse you, too, you awe-inspiring natural phenomenon.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Norm, hurry up with that coffee! I've still got that terrible morning taste in my mouth. (smacks lips)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, o-- Of course not! Uh—Peter the Panda doesn't talk either, he's a—He's a panda bear!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: WHAT!? An electric fan? I knew I could beat that if I just had a little more time! (sighs) Wait! (Stares at the Agent Containment Unit)

Name: Young Adult Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The movies are gray, the TV is black, the horses are running, please bring me some food.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, darling, you haven't even touched your cucumber water. I made it especially for you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, look at these buttons! Wha-What does this one do? (he pushes a button which launches a missile) Whoa! Oh, yeah, this is way cool!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay! Okay! I get it. I get it. My daughter's moving out because she thinks I'm a loser.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, a helicopter fight? These can get really nasty. I'm-I'm just going to go play cards.

Name: Doofenshmirtz Doll
Dialog: Hello Perry the Platypus. (Pulls string again) Sorry I'm not here to greet you myself, but this is...(Pulls it again) a trap.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a second, you're singing? Wai- I know what that means, you're leaving, aren't you?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, him? No, no, he likes it. (giving back the clipboard) Here ya go. (takes the package) I'll take that. Thanks for everything. See ya.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I should really build an auto-aim-inator, because I cannot hit the broad side of a barn.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (while the song plays) Hey, I love this song! I guess I shouldn't be surprised at this point, but what the hey?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, any second, something will explode on me and then we can go home. Yep, any second.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on, don't act surprised. I literally just said we're evil, so we have to cheat.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I want you to know that... you are appreciated, Perry the Platypus, you are appreciated.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, sure, until you wanna hang under something. Then what are you gonna do, smart guy?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He and Perry are tied up inside of a storage closet) Well what did you expect? It was like twenty of them, against one-and-two-halves of us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (in flashback) What? How are we supposed to go over the- OOF! (it repeats as Doofenshmirtz laughs evilly) How are we supposed to go over the- OOF!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, first of all, they're not ridiculous. Convoluted and ultimately pointless, maybe.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: This is Perry the Platyborg! He was once my nemesis, but now, he is general of my army!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) That's right! "Macaw" has a "W" in it! So we can do it! Okay, here, from the beginning.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Twelve pickles! How did you even get them all in there? (leaps at Perry, who kicks him onto the -inator) My Chicken Soup-inator! Nooooo! (A stream of chicken soup comes out and hits the asteroid as the latter passes by. The Chicken Soup-inator then explodes.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right, Norm, let's get this place cleaned up. There's backstory all over the place.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh, turns out that wasn't actual food. But you get the idea, Periodontal the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus! Uh oh. This is not going to end well for me, I'm afraid.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, the electricity's out. Are you... Are you powering that treadmill all by yourself?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (narrating) Ten seconds later, they confiscated the cake; apparently there's a two-person minimum.

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Ugh, now who's interrupting me? Remind me to berate my Indentured Executive Assistant!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Can you get a little more lift out of this thing? I think I just bruised a kidney.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, I had no idea that smoke signals were so complicated! (Perry hops onscreen) Perry the Platypus! What a-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, he-he-hello. Have you seen a platypus around here? About yea high, very trappable.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, something real, like in reality, like a reality dating show! That's a great idea!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: We are talking about women here, right? Okay, now remember, don't forget to stay cool.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I shouldn't dwell on it, i...it's just too painful. I-I gotta stop living in the past.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Okay, I take it back. You're an abomination. Now, attack, my hench-plants! Attack!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Fine! Point it wherever you want, baby. I'll be there. (crawls onto the machine so that it would hit him when it fired) Say hello to the new dynamic... (Perry hits him with an uppercut)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, Perry the Platypus, aww, you ruined it! Where am I gonna get another mountain now? (Perry kicks him again and he goes over)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey I know you! You're that Mitch guy from space. Put me down you best friend stealer!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Online? That, that was an option the whole time?! Well, ain't that a kick in the— (the rolling ball rolls him over to avoid him from completing the sentence) Ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait! You know, this isn't big enough to trap me!...CURSE YOU, GIANT FLYING BUILDING!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Did you know that they're the only insect that can turn their head 180º? (snaps fingers) Mantis fact!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, groovy dudes and dudettes. How's it hangin'? Wanna try my seven-layer bars? Man?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It began in Gimmelshtump when I was a callow youth yearning for a career in fine art.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How thoughtful! They're even going to feed me before we take over the Tri-State Area!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See? A cat always lands on my feet. Wait, nobody move. Here. (takes a selfie) That's goin' on my blog.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? What was wrong with that? I was gonna go for one of those big tubs from Lotsmo.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (cntd.) I'm just going to lie down for a bit. I promise I'll be more evil next time, alright?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, they look just like us. That's weird, right? Come on, let's go save Balloony.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well I'm going up to the top of the tower, I'm sure you two have a hot time together! (He laughs and exits)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That was purely coincidental. But, hey! I hit Roger! Oh, he's gonna be repulsive now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz head
Dialog: Look! Two more heads. Ha ha! Look at Perry and his little arms, aren't they adorable?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Waking up to Perry’s chatter) Wait, what, who am I? Oh, oh, it's me! Perry the Platypus, how did you free yourself?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There ya go, papier-mâché me, don't let anybody tell ya you look like a traffic cone.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh yeah? (Puts his fingers on the Major's mouth as if he's the one talking) "I am Major Monogram. I dropped that water balloon. I have poopy pants." Eh?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I was sure my arm would grow back, but it never did. (taps his left arm which makes a metallic sound) See? Pure titanium. It's a fact.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait. Was that Perry the Platypus? Great. They're probably letting him host the show.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, I hate Christmas. Yes! I hate Christmas! Woohoo! This is the best Christmas ever!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Anyway, you're gonna love it. I was so impressed, I commissioned a whole new jingle!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I was getting to you guys. I mean, without me and them. And the cat, wherever the...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (He is still falling) Oh look, his mustache fell off, and, and I didn't think today could get any weirder!

Name: Platypus-Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Do you ever get tired of lugging this big tail around? ...Well, back at it, I guess.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So this is why you shouldn't make mountains out of molehills. (The mole goes into the ocean.) Curse you, giant mole!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) Look at you! You're just a bottom! (Perry punches him) Oh, it's on now! (Charges at Perry, who throws him over. Doofenshmirtz's body is now half invisible) Oop! Look at me! I'm just a top!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah! That's the first time anyone's actually listened to me! (dials phone) Norm, did you hear that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I guess it probably works better in the dark. Oh look, it's the jetpack squad.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see, when I was a small boy, my parents would never let me watch music videos...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh, I didn't see that one coming. Well let's just see what the players have to say.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, ever since I installed the Away-inator on my helmet, driving is fun again!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not important. Check it out. Perry the Platypus should be coming in three, two, one.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Soon, there will be nothing that can withstand the wrath of Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for bringing this down for me, Norm. For some reason, it runs on solar power.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hear that, Perry the Platypus? That is the sound of smell! Nothing can stop me now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) In Gimmelshtump, the other kids used to tease me for not practicing photosynthesis.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, that's my spotlight! If anyone's pushing this dancer out of the way, it's me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hello, Perry the Platypus. Well, as they say in the film business, it's a wrap!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hey, now that we're agents, when do I get to use this thing? (launches a rocket launcher) Whoa! (The rockets crash into the OWCA headquarters.) Oops, sorry.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's okay, honey, it's on an orbit! It'll come back around! It's not all about you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, it's you! At first, I was like, "Who is that scrawny wimp?"

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (dressed as a sun) Ah, Perry the Platypus! Step into my orbit and be my satellite, permanently! Ha ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh. Well, if the press won't come to us, we'll go to the press. To the dance hall!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Actually, I guess it doesn't really specify pants anywhere, so I guess you're okay.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Psst! Perry the Platypus, over here. Hurry, hurry, it's- the show's about to start!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ay caramba! Perry the cha-cha gram? I mean, Platy... Obviously, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I never built an Amnesia-inator. I think I'd remember building something like that.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (reading the label) "Glycerol, glycerol, ester of rosin, yellow 15." I guess they had 14 other yellows.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus is due any second. (checking the time on his watch) Hey, it's getting a little late. Where is he?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank you. (to Perry) I'm gonna take this downstairs to Vanessa. Party on, Perry the Platypus! (he flips the switch and the music and disco lights resume)

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All right. Vanessa, Major Monogram. Major Monogram, Vanessa. There, you happy now?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't understand! How—how is it possible? Uh -- you did this, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yes, yes it is! It's nice to see you taking an interest in the family business.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mmmm, oh. That lining, delicious. I'm gonna be in my closet looking for more hats.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a second, You're singing? I know what that means! You're leaving, aren't you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha ha! At last! An inator above all other inators! The one that will finally...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz, but my friends call me.... (stops and thinks) I just got in such a funk.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So you're not mad at me for saying I'd rather have a son than a daughter like you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) Well, I guess I could warm up with this platypus. (He sticks the gun into Perry.) Here you go. (Perry gets away.) Hey, no—Hold still!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The Time-Straighten-Out-inator! It straightens out time and keeps it from looping.

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, Vanessa, are you looking forward to seeing Tokyo on our daddy-daughter trip?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? That's a... it's an arts and crafts project! I've got a life outside of you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-oh! Well, thank goodness for the plastic gas tank. (to Vanessa) Hey, Vanessa?! Is that you?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? But-but, but how did you get out of the Chinese platypus trap?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see, Perry the Platypus, a whole army of Doofenshmirtzs! Perfect copies of me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa? Vanessa! (runs to her) I need to talk to you about your, you know, wanting to move out.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Laughs) The home of my former nemesis. Time to kick a little sand, eh, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Just keep quiet over there. I've got a call from Rodney. (Doofenshmirtz answers) What do you want, Rodney?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm closing in on the key. I can feel it. (gasps) Perry the Platypus, how did you get out?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (rolling past him) Later! (A blue portal opens and the muffins get sucked into it) Oh, whooa... (bounces off the balcony) Maybe I'll get lucky and time will loop before (crashing noise) Oh! No such lu—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That was just my prototype Gigantinator ray. It's n-nothing to be concerned about.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a second, I just realized. That was a conscious choice! You peed on my couch!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, why, thank you, I have been trying to—Oh, wait, no, it's just the pheromones.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (angrily) I get it. Repulsive. I see. That's just the universe making a joke at my expense!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, heck no, I-I usually just pretend he's talking about recent movies I've seen.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Drusselstein. Hmm. Curse you, Perry the Platypus, and my wretched, wretched life.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, how did you do that? (Gets hit on back of his head again) Ow! Ow! Alright Come out in the open where I can... Ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, Perry the Platypus! (Cut to reveal Perry raveling up a towel.) Will you put that down right— (He smacks him with it) Ow! Ow, Oh that smarts! (Doofenshmirtz throws his shoe at Perry. Perry jumps as the shoe misses and hits the Monkey Enslave-inator off of the monkey. The monkeys all look angrily at Doofenshmirtz.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Communication! Oh, for cryin' out loud! At least tell him what your inator does!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Shut it, Norm. Whose side are you on, anyway? And the press will be here, Rodney.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (shakes Billy's hand) Great to meet ya, Billy! Tell me, (motions toward the back of the room) whadaya see over there in the back of the room?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This was actually productive. This... This food fight is gonna feed me for weeks.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, someday I'll get out of this cage, but your name will still be Francis.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (having been hit with the Age Accelerator-inator) Well, it's already 4:30; I think I'm going to bed. Curse you, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (carrying a flashlight) Now I've got to walk all the way down and flip the whatever that thing is called.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Tube socks? What is this, 1974? Well, it's too late now...oh! (Button beeps) What are you doing?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, my deface-inator! One blast and your face becomes incredibly forgettable.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, you're not Perry the Platyp- Sorry about that. (retracts the trap) I was expecting someone else.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I got her! She's down there on that craggy mountain. Quick! Let's land this bird.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Actually, I'm an evil scientist. A-A lot of people are confused by the lab coat.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-oh. (When he grows too much, Perry pushes his inator away, jumps onto it and escapes.) Curse you, Perry the Plat- (he groans, then spits out a chair) Why did I ever order such a large bedroom set? (Perry pushes the button on the Wrapped-Up-in-a-Nice-Little-Bow-Inator and the entire building gets wrapped up in a nice little bow.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Patience, Dr. Bloodpudding, they'll be here. When have I ever let you guys down?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, man, Roger's not on 'til the end of the show? Can't you get him back sooner?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Diminutive. I'd say it's nice to see you, but I'm an evil scientist, not a liar.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, speak for yourself, I'm gonna try to land on you, so you'll break my fall.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, nothing can stop us now. Hee-hee-hee-hee. (Doof gets thrown flat on his keester by Perry. Doof gasps) Aah! Hey, what was all that about?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no, I want you to hate it like I did! Tragedy builds character. Come on.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, can it, Rodney. I think we both know that I'm a better evil dancer than you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) He can talk! (gets blasted by the robot) And shoot, too! Ow! Save me! Save me, Perry the Platypus! AAAAAHHH!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, not only does this thing work, it has a sense of irony! (Perry punches Doofenshmirtz) Ow!... AAAAAHHHHHH!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Almost all of them. Remember Perry the Platypus. He's still out there somewhere.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on CB radio) Metal up? What kind of a... (Perry lands on the windshield with suction cups on his hands and feet; at Perry) Hey! (on CB radio) Cheeky Monkey, I'm gonna have to call you back.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on. Ooh, hey, random pounding works. Oh good, we're back on the Perry show.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? You're wearing headphones? So you haven't heard a thing I've said all day?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, well, well. Ohio Flynn and Rhode Island Fletcher. What are you doing here?

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: The mask makes me sound all creepy. Here, check this out. Fava beans... Fava...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I want you to shoot me. Hey, stop that! OH, you're just so difficult sometimes!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Those were lean times for my father and our beloved lawn gnome was repossessed.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, to pull the switch. (Perry jumps on him) Thanks for the headache! (Perry punches him in the eye) Thanks for the face-ache!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, I'm just gonna take the high road and use this as a backstory for some—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And if it was light, you would've seen us and run away, hence ruining the trap!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Take over the world? Tha-That's crazy! That-That's almost left-boot-trap crazy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: I just haven't seen a mirror for two months. Did my hair always look like this?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well, maybe that little friend of yours, too, 'cause she was inside the bubble.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why would you carry that in your wallet? Why would he carry that in his wallet?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, you're back! (walking up to the inator) I am never setting that puppy off again! (He presses a button, and, as usual, the inator activates and aims across town.) Oops.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But I feel... I feel a big emotional bit coming on. Maybe even a power ballad.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A birthmark! It's a balloon you idiot! "Colin". Come on Balloony, let's scoot.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) I have no way of knowing, because I've never been there, and...you don't talk.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, right there, I-I'm pretty sure that's my voice when I'm being sarcastic.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (after a long pause) Ah, I'm going to have to do the right thing here, aren't I? Fine. Here you go.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, my Downgrade-inator! (Doof fires his inator at a car and it becomes a goat and cart.) All right! Pothole here! (He fires at a woman coming out of a clothing boutique.) Potato sacks over there!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That we'll finally have that special daddy-daughter bond you've always craved?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know this balloon is actually– (He is cut off, as the balloon flutters about wildly) AHH! Curse you Perry the Platypus Balloon!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a minute, guys. Bear with me just a second here, okay. Watch this, ready?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Peter the Panda? And Perry the Platypus? You're working together to rescue me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (throws the lamp at Norm and it lands on Norm's head) Eat it yourself, Norm, I gotta get Vanessa, and we gotta do everything faster!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (facepalms; notices Perry) Oh, there you are, Perry the Platypus. (At Norm) Hey, Norm, look who decided to show up!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, when she says "habengusher" like that, it's easy to forget that it means--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Wow, you know, it's actually quite a bit roomier in here than you'd think. (When the inator hit the ground, it launches a ray into space, then it reaches a satellite and gets launched back to Earth.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, well, I may have enlarged it a little to make it a dry-it-off-inator, but—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, and a fine job you did, too. We are sharing the space with another event!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus! Y-Y-You know, those, those really work for you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! Holy Boy! Even the great Francis Monogram's my slave in this dimension!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm up here Perry the Platypus! (to the audience) You knew we'd end up up here eventually right?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: [still trapped by Perry/Candace] Great. Now I have this song stuck in my head.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, I am honored. And at the same time humiliated, so thank you and curse you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vogue. Vogueing. That's it. Look it up, kids. That's what the internet is for.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Have as many sheeples as you want, Perry the Platypus, I can always make more! (laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, could... could... could we have a word in my, uh, office?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ugh! Roger, Roger, Roger. Okay, fine. I just gotta take care of a few things.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, look at him. He's got a big head, suddenly some sort of marketing genius.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sing-song) I'm not saying a yes. (pause) Here, you can take this Pizzazzium locator. It'll help.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've got it! I've got it! (at Perry) There, you see? I told you it was water solu -- (Perry's capsule melts and he punches him) OH!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, stop chasing me; I'm supposed to keep my heart rate down!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: You know, I'm starting to see why you haven't become ruler in your dimension.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I vowed revenge. Cheap revenge. My first plan involved exploding pizza dough.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Teamwork makes the scheme work! I even convinced Vanessa to show her support.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, first thing's first, we gotta take down these robots that look like us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (holding up a branch) Seriously, I'll be able to eat this whole branch, but...y'know, like, slowly.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know, I'm starting to remember why I replaced you and put you in storage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh, well I guess I might have over-thought that solution, just a little bit.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (exclaims fearfully) Wait a minute. (pulls out magnifying glass from lab coat) Hmm, what do we have here? Oh, no, it's-it's Sergei the Snail!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, man, this had better be a dream because I don't like where this is going.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, did I just help Roger's reputation? (goes to the inator) I can undo it. I can still undo it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on the on-site TV) ...the wrong direction! The wrong direction! The wrong direction, I tell you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's just I'm used to doing all the talking with my nemesis. (Perry drops off the chair.) He's a platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, it's almost warmed up. Are you watching Perry the-- What? What the...?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: They'll be here, they'll be here.  Clearly, the buffet alone will bring them.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as Perry escapes from the trap) It's ironic, I built my Underwear-inator while actually in my underwear. Ha! (Perry attacks him and the Underwear-inator fires up)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, Perry the Platypus, when you get a minute, grab the controls, would you-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no. It just sort of sounded like that. Well, I mean, we could. We should!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa? Oh, no! Vanessa, get out of there! (Crawling inside) There's a huge bat on the loose!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Ah, great! Can you give me a hand moving my amplifinator out onto the porch?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Plummet-pus! 'Cause you're... 'Cause you're plummeting!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! (slams down the Sculptinator start button, then poses) You're too late, Perry the Platypus! Ooh! Make sure to get my good side!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Oh pooh. Oh, well. Time to start the invasion! (he goes, the bots follow) And somebody get me a muffin!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (jet-pack landing) Hey you, I got a question for you. How do you get your plants—What? Plastic! (pokes plastic man)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, you're right. He's not even my nemesis. H-H-He's more of a thwarty call.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, look, it's chickens! It's (groans) I guess chickens aren't as funny as I thought.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Well obviously YOU did not have to deal with MY nemesis, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (runs up to the inator but the arms pull him back) Noooooooo! Oh, you guys are so annoying. You're kinda cute, though. (two of the arms punch him) Get off!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) ...the coolest car of all was the Boomshlaka 320-I, run by my Uncle Simpkin!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, good, I'm early! And a killer parking space, too! Score! Time to set up.

Name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, it's always something. Turbulence, headwind, giant jump-roping robots...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ironically, she's still more nurturing than my own mother! Ow, off, quit it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, no, "Doofenshmirtz." Heinz Doofenshmirtz. Surely you've heard of me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...and done. Now with the—Hey! Where'd you go? What are you doing up there?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But I'm running way low on materials. I'm gonna have to get a bit creative.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, it was a huge honor. Hey, since you're here, you wanna sing a song?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But it was you! Start pedaling! It's leg day, people! Leg day! Whoop whoop!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: Wait, let me try something. Platyborg, do the same thing to those two boys.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's going crazy! It's shooting all over willy-nilly, both willy and nilly!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This apartment seems familiar. Hey, would you mind if I kick down the door? (he does so, proceeding to get his foot stuck)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No no, I made that mistake a couple of times, too, but that's him, I swear!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What are you... You've got it pointed at the suburbs! My face is over here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, don't give me the puppy dog eyes. You're gonna make me cry. Sheesh. (Perry jumps out the window.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, sometimes evil just cracks me up! (He hears Vanessa humming) Say where's that humming coming from?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Did ya' hear that high note? That was the A above middle C, not too shabby.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh? You may have survived that trap, but let's you escape the cage! Ha-ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: See you don't need her Norm, she's a know it all. Ugh. Ooh, look, corndogs!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no. It just-It just sort of sounded like- I-I mean, we could. We should!

Name: Doofenshmirtz-2
Dialog: So what you're telling me is you're still not ruler of your Tri-State Area?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, do something! He's going to emancipate my proclamation!
